seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: ACP Pradyuman, Daya and Abhijeet are an elite trio of officers who work for the CID. They seek the help of professional forensic expert Dr Salunkhe and solve various criminal cases.

episodes.name: Kissa Zeher Ka: Part 1
episodes.overview: A prominent lawyer is found dead in his posh high-end residence. What appears to be a case of suicide at first, soon turns suspicious when an officer investigating the crime-scene dies in a similar mysterious way. What possible explanation can there be? Can t…

episodes.overview: Following up on the lawyer and the CID Officer's mysterious death, ACP Pradyuman and his team manage to get some leads and inch closer to the suspect. It becomes clear that potassium cyanide was the choice of poison in both these cases. But is that enough inf…

episodes.name: Kissa Anjaan Aawazon Ka: Part 1
episodes.overview: The Police find an abandoned dead body and immediately become suspicious. They react quickly and hand the case over to the CID. Initial investigation helps them identify the victim and trace his residence and family members. During a thorough search of his ro…

episodes.name: Kissa Anjaan Aawazon Ka: Part 2
episodes.overview: Finding a piece of evidence in a sea of audio recordings is like finding a needle in a haystack. What does ACP Pradyuman manage to hear in these recordings that his team misses? Who does this lead to? What was the motive? Watch the concluding episode to find…

episodes.name: Kissa Raat Ke Shikar Ka: Part 1
episodes.overview: A series of murders within a quick span of time shocks the entire neighbourhood. It all starts with the murder of a professor, dying because of a fatal blow to his head. A few days later, a woman on her way back from work is killed in a similar manner. What d…

episodes.name: Kissa Raat Ke Shikar Ka: Part 2
episodes.overview: The mystery of the serial killer deepens when one of the prime suspects commits suicide, the crazy professor lives up to his reputation and takes his own life. But will the killings end after his death or was he just a misdirection to mislead the investigatio…

episodes.name: Case Of The Thief Within: Part 1
episodes.overview: A string of robberies startle the city. The process? Simple. Scout rich kids from night clubs and gather as much information about them as you can. Analyze the information and when the time is right, get the job done. But this case is a little more layered th…

episodes.name: Case Of The Thief Within: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP and his team have figured out the modus operandi of the group and how they function internally. But this is where the real test begins for ACP Pradyuman. With the possible involvement of his son, in this case, ACP needs to take some hard-hitting decisions.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Third Man: Part 1
episodes.overview: A waiter walks into a hotel room and finds a couple dead inside. The CID team is promptly called into action. Upon arrival, the team quickly notices foul play. It appears that the crime scene had been dressed up to look a certain way before the team’s arrival…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Third Man: Part 2
episodes.overview: The mystery of the third missing individual continues, all we know is the involvement of a deadly mixture of alcohol and poison. Ratan the prime suspect is on the run but the team is closing in on him with each passing day. How long will Ratan be on the run?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Second Statement: Part 1
episodes.overview: A victim releases a statement in front of the Doctors and the Police that the attempted murder on her was actually a careless mistake and there was nobody responsible for this accident. Her father, however, refuses to accept this statement and claims that his…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Second Statement: Part 2
episodes.overview: With investigation hitting a plateau and no further lead in sight, the team decides to backtrack and consult a doctor. What does the Doctor reveal that baffles ACP Pradyuman? What does the ACP find suspicious when he revisits that house and does a thorough sc…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Contract Killer: Part 1
episodes.overview: Pedestrians on the road find a dying man crying for help. A policeman nearby stops to check what the fuss was about. He immediately senses that this is no ordinary case, the man on the ground was in disguise and armed. He is rushed to the hospital on time. Po…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Contract Killer: Part 2
episodes.overview: Childhood rivalries often leave marks that are deep and hurtful, this seems to be the case with Nagesh and Vilas. Unresolved issues can come back haunt even the best of us. Was this the motive behind the attempted murder? Only ray of light seems to be the con…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Anonymous Threats: Part 1
episodes.overview: A family receives anonymous threats from a gang out of nowhere. Turning their lives upside down, the threat starts to influence every decision they take. The gang demanded a huge sum of money and threatened acid attacks, if the family doesn’t meet the demands…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Anonymous Threats: Part 2
episodes.overview: The threats continue but this time the team has audio recordings to analyze. The family is confined inside their house, living in constant fear of the gang. Every phone call is taped and every move being watched. Can the team crack this case and bring normalc…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Incomplete Letter: Part 1
episodes.overview: A lady finds parts of a letter stuck on her window. The letter was signed by a Pawan Kumar pleading for help. The letter claimed that Pawan was inside an old warehouse, being held hostage by people he knew. The Department is called in and the search for a Paw…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Incomplete Letter: Part 2
episodes.overview: A woman gets one part of a mysterious letter and goes to the CID for their help. ACP tries his best to crack the case.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Innocent Victim: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sr. Inspector Viren is celebrating his childhood friend Ajay’s success party. A seasoned athlete Ajay, was celebrating his captaincy with his team. But a night of celebration suddenly turns horrid when Ajay and the coach collapse after drinking some champagne…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Innocent Victim: Part 2
episodes.overview: As investigations progress on the arsenic poisoning case, Sr. Inspector Viren tries to narrow down on the culprit with the help of Dr Salunke. The forensics team eliminate multiple suspects but will they have enough evidence to nab the killer? Sr.Inspector Vi…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Last Wound: Part 1
episodes.overview: A hemophilic patient believes that his life could be in danger. He fears his wife is having an extramarital affair and wants him dead. Being as vulnerable as he is, any wrong move could lead to his death, so he calls in the CID. Sr. Inspector Viren and his te…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Last Wound: Part 2
episodes.overview: It appears that CID protection wasn’t enough to save Sudhakar's life. Succumbing to his injuries, Sudhakar passes away after falling off the staircase. How did the murderer manage to accomplish this feat under such close surveillance? His wife Suhasini pleads…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Deadly Virus: Part 1
episodes.overview: A lethal virus is let loose due to internal conflict at a pharmaceutical company. A virus deadly enough to spread through an entire city within 8 hours. The only good thing about this news is the fact that the authorities have been alerted early into the leak.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Deadly Virus: Part 2
episodes.overview: With the virus in the hands of a hardened criminal, the future of the city was in the hands of a lunatic. With no knowledge about his location, intentions or his possible next move, inspector Viren and his team were helpless at this point. CID’s search for th…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Burnt Letter: Part 1
episodes.overview: An old man living alone in his apartment is choked to death by an unknown assailant. The motive behind the case is unclear, who would have any sort of enmity against a man of his age. His neighbor and friend noticed that he was tensed before his death, and se…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Burnt Letter: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID arrives at Mr Sethia's office following a clue that will lead them to investigate further on the case of the burnt letter. They cross-question Mr Malhotra and his wife. Will CID be able to solve the case?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Talkative Skeleton: Part 1
episodes.overview: A group of women are cutting grass in an agricultural field when they discover a skeleton dug deep in the ground. The team of CID arrives to investigate the matter when a woman comes running and reveal that it's of her husband Venkat.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Talkative Skeleton: Part 2
episodes.overview: At the forensic lab, Dr Salunkhe and Inspector Vivek are trying to decode the mystery behind the skeleton and to whom does it belong if not Venkat. Dr Salunkhe comes up with a plan to test the clothes of the suspects in order to identify the skeleton.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unusual Alibi: Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Daya walks into the CID bureau with a man named Kishore Swarna who was sent to prison 9 years ago by ACP Pradyuman. He was caught peeping into a house that belongs to a jeweller. What is the motive behind this?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unusual Alibi: Part 2
episodes.overview: A court session is in place and Swarna reveals that he is not responsible for the crime and in fact, he was at ACP Pradyuman's bungalow listening to his conversations. ACP is in a fix.

episodes.name: The Case Of the Strange Hijack - Part 1
episodes.overview: Famous artist Shrikant suffers a heart attack and is admitted to the hospital. His friends and fans collect money to arrange for a new valve for Shrikant but before he can be treated, the valve gets stolen.

episodes.name: The Case Of the Strange Hijack - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID is on the lookout for the valve and the stolen money. A forensic report by Dr Salunkhe leads them to the glass of an imported car that was used for the hijacking and begin their investigation to find out the car to get to the hijackers.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Serial Killings: Part 1
episodes.overview: A killer calls the CID bureau and informs them about his killings prior and leaves the clues in a book. Famous actresses are his victims and CID are on the lookout for this unusual killer who has been killing actresses in the city.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Serial Killings: Part 2
episodes.overview: The actresses are called at the CID bureau and they are told to do as per the guidelines but as panic ensues the actresses demand police protection. CID is on the lookout for the serial killer but will they find him before he makes his next move?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Anonymous Informer: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID receives an anonymous letter that claims he has been a witness to the murder of a young girl in a national park. Upon finding out they reach to the murder site and discover clues related to the case.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Anonymous Informer: Part 2
episodes.overview: At the forensic lab, Dr Salunkhe reveals some hints about Amol's bike that was found at the National Park. CID investigate at Amol's house for some clues and talks to his father who raises some questions that cannot be ignored. Who killed the girl? Is she rea…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Closed Room: Part 1
episodes.overview: Kamal Grover is found dead in his room after his family returns from a movie. CID gets on the case and all fingers are pointed towards the family members. Did the family members kill Kamal or was it someone else?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Closed Room: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID finds out that Kamal did not die of an electric shock and instead they have been misled by one of the family members. While investigating Kamal's house Inspector Vivek finds a ladder under Kamal's room which can be a piece of crucial evidence for the case.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Stolen Gun: Part 1
episodes.overview: While saving a child, ACP Pradyuman loses his gun and the hints lead the team of CID to Paresh Kumar's house but he has already fled the scene. Has Paresh stolen ACP's gun?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Stolen Gun: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID is on the lookout for Paresh as they fear that he might kill Kundan Seth with the gun that he had stolen from the ACP. Can the team of CID catch Paresh before he kills Kundan Seth?

episodes.name: The Girl in Red - Part 2

episodes.overview: A man is killed in a joggers park and the watchman sees the culprit run away. The team of CID arrives and follows a clue given the dying man which says Valsad 180. A few of his belongings leads the team of CID into investigating the matter further.

episodes.name: The 500 Rupees Note - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID investigate Mr Mehnak, the manager of the bank who reveals that money was stolen from a blue van while they were on their way by two people. Who were they and are they related to the murder?

episodes.overview: Knowing that they might be dealing with an issue that involves national security, the team needs to be careful. Their raid at Pallavi Hotel was somewhat a success, and they nabbed one of the people involved in the trade, although he revealed very little infor…

episodes.name: Who Killed Ravinder - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two friends who were out on a casual fishing trip suddenly get the biggest shock of their lives when their hook gets stuck to a corpse underwater. ACP Pradyuman and his team rushes to the spot. A drinking permit and a token of some sort help Identify the vict…

episodes.name: Who Killed Ravinder - Part 2
episodes.overview: With the huge involvement of a under ground gambling scene, the motive behind the murder gets clearer. ACP and his team come to know about Rosy, who frequented one of these gambling dens and was known to the deceased. How does this affect the entire investiga…

episodes.name: Father's Revenge - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's attempt to trick kidnappers backfires when the kidnapper gets critically wounded in the altercation. The only person with any information about the kidnapped boy was this man in the ICU. How does the team go about retrieving information from a…

episodes.name: Father's Revenge - Part 2
episodes.overview: With revenge being one of the motives, it becomes significantly harder for the team to trace the child. Investigation leads to a factory where at some point the child was kept hostage. But with the accused dead and the victim missing, the team hits a wall and…

episodes.name: The Blackout - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman goes missing from her in-law's boutique. The store manager claims that she left in a white Police jeep. CID trace the car to a remote location and eventually stumble upon an abandoned corpse but not of the woman who went missing.

episodes.name: The Blackout - Part 2
episodes.overview: The alcoholic husband remains clueless about his wife's disappearance and he lives in complete denial. CID are however convinced that car found outside the bungalow was the same car that left tire tracks in the jungle.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Last Show - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man is shot inside a movie theatre. The CID arrive and find out that the man was a famous actor in disguise. Knowing it will bring in a lot of media attention, the CID play it safe. The house help and people who knew him are questioned.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Last Show - Part 2
episodes.overview: The blind owner of the PCO is the only witness who can identify the culprit. Interrogating the people who had booked seats behind the deceased actor became crucial in this case. Were they involved or can they lead the CID to the culprit?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Four Rinas - Part 1
episodes.overview: A criminal terrorizes the city when he commits a spree of attacks on anyone named Rina Raj. With the help of a telephone directory. ACP Pradyuman and his team trace a possible victim and reach just in time to prevent anything unfortunate from happening. Who i…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Four Rinas - Part 2
episodes.overview: The close call at the terrace reveals two things. The killer mentioned come one called Shashikant and the fact that he was in search of some diamond. The mystery around Shashikant and the missing diamonds deepens as the team decides to put Asha as a bait and…

episodes.name: The Case Of 48 Kms. To Mumbai - Part 1
episodes.overview: An Intelligence officer is found dead in the jungle. It appears that the body was tortured and there are visible signs of combat before death. With no information about the people he was fighting, the team decides to contact higher officials in the Intelligen…

episodes.name: The Case Of 48 Kms. To Mumbai - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case has taken a new direction after the Doctor's murder. Investigations around the clinic helps the team find out more about the culprits and their possible exit route. Forensic analysis of the stomach contents reveals a piece of paper with something wri…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Strange Clues - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's wedding proposal gets interrupted when the girlfriend spots an abandoned corpse inside a car, on the opposite side of the road. The CID team is called into action for further investigation of the dead body. It becomes obvious that a blunt object was u…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Strange Clues - Part 2
episodes.overview: With information about the relationship with Sheila, ACP Pradyuman and his team dig deeper into the records and find out more about the will that was left behind. Everyone from Jagdish to Sheila have good selfish reasons to take someone's life. With such weal…

episodes.name: The Case Of LOCKER NO. 42 - Part 1
episodes.overview: A blood-stained letter is sent to the Bureau. Closer inspection reveals that the key opened one of the lockers in a local bank. The team rushes to the bank to find out more about this mysterious key. They open the locker and find 9 Lakh Rupees. This makes the…

episodes.name: The Case Of LOCKER NO. 42 - Part 2
episodes.overview: With Kamal dead in his house, the team struggles to put pieces together. The introduction of all these new characters doesn't make it easier for the team. Kamal's previous employers refuse all the claims made by the CID team. His friends claim that he'd been…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Clinching Evidence - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe gets into a traffic altercation. Things get heated up and he draws his gun at the man. A few days later, the man is found dead and the fingerprints on the crime scene match Dr. Salunkhe's prints.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Clinching Evidence - Part 2
episodes.overview: With fingerprints on one side and just a broken piece of glass on the other, the case is heavily tilted towards prosecution. The CID sense that Dr. Salunkhe is being framed in a larger conspiracy.

episodes.name: The Case Of The 639 Coins - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man mysteriously dies of a heart attack in a shopping market. CID find multiple fake IDs with him, hinting that the man was either a con man or a terrorist. Meanwhile, a famous actor gets kidnapped. Could these two cases be connected?

episodes.name: The Case Of The 639 Coins - Part 2
episodes.overview: With clear indication that the calls were made from PCOs, CID do a thorough fingerprint scan of all the coins in those 3 portable public phones, hoping for a match.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dishonest Cop - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya's friend, a TV show director, invites him over to discuss a murder mystery script that he was working on. While eating dinner and discussing, Daya's friend calls his wife, but nobody picks up.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dishonest Cop - Part 2
episodes.overview: With some people in the industry pointing at Daya, there is a huge lack of internal trust in the department. Daya is ready to go against everyone in the Bureau to clear his name.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Girl - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet goes through a temporary phase of 'memory loss' due to his combat injuries. On his way to recovery, he comes across a woman looking for help in the middle of the road. She claimed her life was in danger and someone from the adjacent buildin…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Girl - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet is on the lookout of an unknown girl who is believed to be dead five years ago. Will he find her? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Matrimonials - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman hits a man with her car but upon investigation, it is found that the man was killed by a gunshot. Who killed him and why? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Matrimonials - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr Salunkhe is a suspect in a murder case and CID find this about him. How is he related? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Bullet - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is a suspect in a murder case and CID find this about him. How is he related?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Bullet - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is accused of hiding the bullet that is used for the murder. Meanwhile, a junior doctor informs Salunkhe, that she has been the given the charge to do the postmortem of the body of the victim. Is Salunkhe guilty or not?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Jayant is killed after he gets a death threat from a kid named Avinash who is known to be dead from the past 20 years. How is it possible? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID interrogate Shruti who is in the hospital after being attacked. Inspector Abhijeet has also been attacked. Will CID solve the case of this dead murdered? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Attacker - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man received death threats through letters and texts. CID investigated the case and interrogates the inmates of the house as they're the major suspects.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Attacker - Part 2
episodes.overview: Niranjan gets a heart attack and CID reaches to investigate. The culprit is still on the run and it's found that his medicines were quoted with an allergen. Will CID find the culprit?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Flashing Light: Part 1
episodes.overview: Residents of a society in Borivali are suspicious of an unknown person in their area. Upon investigation, it's found out that a guy named Raj has been killed and Neha has disappeared.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Flashing Light: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID finds and unknown skull buried in the ground. They suspect that it's linked to Raj's death and interrogate a transporter who knew Raj. Will they find the killer?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Bomb Scare - Part 1
episodes.overview: A bomb explodes outside actress Ranjana's house and CID is on the case to investigate who did this. They find a burnt finger and burnt skin at the site of the blast. All eyes are on producer Vipin Kumar, but he is nowhere to be found. Will CID catch him?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Bomb Scare - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID finds producer Vipin Kumar and his wife along with actress Ranjana. On the other hand, clues lead them to a man named Gangu who is on the run. Will CID catch him? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Killings Of The Panther - Part 1
episodes.overview: A young kid witnesses the murder of a girl by a panther. CID is informed about this. Upon investigation, they find an unknown key. Who does it belong to?

episodes.name: The Killings Of The Panther - Part 2
episodes.overview: A kid spots a man-eating wild animal in the forest. A woman is attacked by the animal and she dies. Meanwhile, a man enters the forest and drops a key right outside his car. CID is called in to investigate. What looks like a wild animal attack has something m…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Green Paint - Part 1
episodes.overview: A nurse is found dead in her house with green paint smeared all over her face and also on the serving dishes. This unique murder case puts the CID in turmoil. Will they find the killer?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Green Paint - Part 2
episodes.overview: Nurses are being killed with green paint on their faces. Dr. Yash is considered a suspect for these killings. Meanwhile, another nurse named Sandhya dies. Will CID catch the killer?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Frame Up - Part 1
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in the backseat of a car. All eyes are pointed on Sudhakar when a bag full of money is also retrieved from there. Sudhakar is on the run. Is he the culprit or is he being framed?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Frame Up - Part 2
episodes.overview: Sudhakar meets his informant and asks for a place to hide where CID cannot find him. Why is he hiding when he has not done anything?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Deaths - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Utkarsh who has been missing from his home since the last three years enters a gift shop and threatens the shopkeeper for one lakh rupees. Later he's found dead in a hotel room where he was staying. Who killed him? Watch this episode of CID to fin…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Deaths - Part 2
episodes.overview: Utkarsh's parents reveal about their son's drinking problem and just then CID find a dead body of another man named Abhimanyu who was also missing from his home, just like Utkarsh. Are the deaths of the Utkarsh and Abhimanyu linked? Watch this episode to find…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Juicy Poison - Part 1
episodes.overview: Malini dies after being given poison through juice. Her husband is the prime suspect. Upon investigation it is revealed that someone has been poisoning all the juice bottles. Who is it?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Juicy Poison - Part 2
episodes.overview: A syringe is found in the juice factory and CID are called in to investigate. The syringe was used to inject poison in the juice bottles. Will the culprit be found?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Predictions - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Purshottam dies and his death was predicted by a patient who has Alzheimer's. Upon investigation, it is found that an astrologer is a regular visitor of the patient.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Predictions - Part 2
episodes.overview: Another accident takes place at Kings Circle and it was also predicted by the Alzheimer's patient. CID investigate the accident to find out the culprit behind these killings.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Wedding Blues - Part 1
episodes.overview: On the eve of Karthik's marriage his ex-girlfriend Shalakha is bitter and threatens her. His friend, Ashok, knows Daya whom he asks for help. Shalakha enters with the lights switched off just then and a shot is fired. The girl is dead.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Wedding Blues - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twists and turns continue making the case even more intricate. The suicide note of Karthik doesn't match with his handwriting and what's even more surprising is that the same gun has been used to kill both Shalakha and Karthik.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Tempting Diamond - Part 1
episodes.overview: Ranveer an aging patriarch calls his entire family to explain that he is now broke. All he is left with is a Rs.2.5 crore diamond which he intends to sell and square off his debt and distribute the remaining amount among his children leaving all of them dis-s…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Tempting Diamond - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID starts investigating the murder case and finds that all members of the family including the maid and her daughter are driven by greed and had a reason to kill the patriarch. The twist in the case comes when the sniffer dog finds the dead body of Durvesh,…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Red Water - Part 1
episodes.overview: A housing society is experiencing panic due to red tap water, suspected to be blood. CID investigations reveal a body with a slit throat in the overhead water tank, belonging to Mr. Rana, who was supposed to return from a night tour.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Red Water - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are investigating Mr. Rana's mysterious murder, but society are shocked when the kitchen water line turns red and the killer dumps the body and Mr. Rana's bag in a second water tank, causing further shock for the community.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Frightened Men - Part 1
episodes.overview: Piyush, a writer specializing in murder mysteries, becomes the prime suspect when one of the five friends, Rishab, gets murdered in his presence shot with his own gun in his own house. All of them were getting unsigned letters warning them that now it was the…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Frightened Men - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twist in the story comes when it comes to light that Chander, one of Rishab's friend had a motive to kill. He owed ten lakh rupees to Rishab and was not in a position to pay. However, very soon Chandar and one more of his friend too die of poisoning.

episodes.name: The Case Of 1030 AM - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man in a mask enters a bank to rob it. The robbery goes haywire when he gets a heart attack. He is then rushed to the hospital and is later declared dead. The team of CID reaches the bank and is informed of the case. Dr. Jayant fills them with the informati…

episodes.name: The Case Of 1030 AM - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID gets a call from a girl from the club that she has seen Raghu talking to a woman who workd there, but had quit only a day before. This woman, Kalpana, refuses to know Raghu or that she had anything to do with him. But the truth can not stay hidden and the…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Nightmare - Part 1
episodes.overview: Sidharth is prone to seeing nightmares. He witnesses a murder in a bungalow with the body being disposed in a wardrobe. When he narrates it his colleague she calls in the CID because Sidharth has bruises on his body and also has the key of the wardrobe. Just…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Nightmare - Part 2
episodes.overview: The initial suspicion is on Sidharth as he has with him the key of the wardrobe where the corpse was hidden. However CID decides to utilise the services of a specialised psychiatrist who helps Sidharth to go on an induced sleep so that he can see the nightmar…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Chasing Butterflies - Part 1
episodes.overview: At a motel in the outskirts of the city a car is parked in such a way that it obstructs others driving out. The watchman is alerted and very soon they all hear the a ticking sound as if a bomb is about to go off. CID is called in and so is the bomb disposal s…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Chasing Butterflies - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID investigates the lead given by the forensics and try to find out the specialty of the butterfly eggs This leads them to a particular jungle in the outskirts of Pune. It is a slender lead but CID manages to outwit the killer and trace him using all their a…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: During a party, a man named Shailender plans to make a new will that deprives his family members of taking his money after his death. Before he can sign it, he's killed. CID tries to investigate and doubts the relatives at the party.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: With Dr. Salunkhe's help, CID were able to track down the weapon used in the murder. They go back to the crime scene to find more evidence to apprehend the culprit.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Blast - Part 1
episodes.overview: A taxi gets blown up in a blast with the bomb planted in a suitcase left on the back seat. Eyewitnesses say that the driver seemed to be in a hurry. Either the driver was delivering the bomb or the bomb was left behind by the bomber.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Mysterious Blast - Part 2
episodes.overview: The sticker on the teddy bear leads CID to a hotel and suspect who had checked out the day after the blast. CID manages to get wind of a drug mafia and begins the intricate job of laying a trap for the drug dealer.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Elusive Bomber - Part 1
episodes.overview: A film shooting is in progress. The man in charge of explosives is short of trained men. The mock blast scene goes wrong as someone has used real explosives to sabotage the project killing the blast master.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Elusive Bomber - Part 2
episodes.overview: The intricate web of deceit and betrayal takes the CID back to 25 years when 75 lakh rupees were looted. CID finds out that the blast master was involved in this loot along with his partner who gets jailed for 5 years.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Red Rain - Part 1
episodes.overview: An elderly gentleman is seen driving the car erratically and dashes against the sidewalk. He gets out of the car and after taking a few unsteady steps fall down dead. CID finds out that it is not a case of drunk driving but a cold blooded murder as someone ha…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Red Rain - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensics conclude that the killer has a burnt hand because of which he has a peculiar finger print which were retrieved from the letters and the umbrella used to inject the poison. The third business partner too just before dying was trying to convey to the…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Poisonous Cigarettes - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two friends suffer from heart attacks. One of them dies. Forensics suspect it to be a case of poisoning and trace it to a cigarette which they both had shared which was meant for someone else and they had accidentally borrowed it.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Poisonous Cigarettes - Part 2
episodes.overview: The young couple who were having the poisonous cigarette clearly were the killer's targets. CID's investigation leads them to a bunch of friends and acquaintances who were there and they're suspects of mixing the poison in the cigarette.

episodes.name: The Case Of Two Blackmailers - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man is stabbed and thrown from a van outside an ATM. He desperately wanted to say something to a lady coming out, but he dies. CID pick up the event from the CCTV and find out that the man was a photographer who blackmails people.

episodes.name: The Case Of Two Blackmailers - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID come across a mysterious phone number, which leads them to a man who claims that the victim was blackmailing him. Will these clues be enough for the CID to solve the case?

episodes.name: The Case Of Nailing The Suspect - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead at her office desk, strangled by someone with long nails, no signs of struggle. CID officers suspect someone in the office and begin inspecting every employee.

episodes.name: The Case Of Nailing The Suspect - Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet suspects the killer cut the office employees' nails, leading to a search of office's dustbins to find the nail cuttings. Meanwhile, a mysterious new forensic doctor gets assigned to the case.

episodes.name: The Case Of Flat 211 - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's body is found in a flat where he does not live. Forensic work reveals that he was killed by an electric current, likely passed through the key used to open the door of the flat. Is this a murder or an accident? And if it is a murder, will CID find the…

episodes.name: The Case Of Flat 211 - Part 2
episodes.overview: Further forensic investigation reveals that marks from the fingers of five different people are on the door- which means the man was not alone, and likely murdered. A search begins for the locksmith who gave the victim the key that lead to his death. It turns…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Spitting Cobra - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's corpse is found floating in a river by a family out on an excursion. The victim's eyes are swollen due to, it turns out, snake venom.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Spitting Cobra - Part 2
episodes.overview: An investigation reveals that all three men who were bit by a splitting cobra landed up in the jungle after having a meal together, and that the one who survived seems to have some kind of amnesia.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Horryfying Viruse - Part 1
episodes.overview: A prisoner escapes from jail and robs and kills a man. CID is called to the scene to begin searching for the man. But a seemingly ordinary case goes awry when a deformity on the victim's body, first thought to be cause by acid burns at the hands of the prison…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Horryfying Viruse - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID question the prisoner's kin and find out that he plans to visit someone in the city. They soon find the man, infected with the virus but not dead yet, and find out he gave the prisoner some money. CID soon deduces that the prisoner plans to sell the virus…

episodes.name: The Case Of Missing Money - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's corpse is found, killed by drowning after being knocked out by a hit to the head. With very few leads to work off, CID officers begin to investigate a strange tattoo on the man's shoulder, and use it to begin searching for the man's identity. Will the…

episodes.name: The Case Of Missing Money - Part 2
episodes.overview: It is revealed that the victim was a state agent who intended to buy a property near Ranipur- and was carrying 40 lakh rupees with him before he died, all of which is now missing. An investigation at hotels in the Ranipur area reveals that the victim got into…

episodes.name: The Case Of Robbery After Death - Part 1
episodes.overview: A scientist's body is found at a private science lab, where a six-month vaccine for anthrax has just been developed- and now, stolen. An investigation of the crime scene reveals that the lab was only accessed by one person before the victim, one Dr. Carlton,…

episodes.name: The Case Of Robbery After Death - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID officers deduce that a rival pharmaceutical company must have ordered this killing in order to be able to steal the vaccine but have no evidence to support this theory. It is also found that Dr. Carlton is indeed dead after his body is found in a storage…

episodes.name: HOWZZAT - Part 1
episodes.overview: A gun is found in former cricketer Kapil Dev's bag at an airport security check, and he swears it's not his. The CID suspect he left it unattended in a changing room. A sniffer dog finds a dead body shot in the chest.

episodes.name: HOWZZAT - Part 2
episodes.overview: A forensic investigation reveals the victim was shot by the same gun found in Kapil Dev's bag, Later, a phone belonging to the victim is found nearby, revealing that the victim had tried to call Kapil Dev thrice over the past day.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unusual Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID is called to a seemingly ordinary crime scene. There seems to be a clear murder weapon at the scene with fingerprints and the victim's blood on it, a footprint near the body, as well as an eyewitness report of someone running away from the scene. But thin…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unusual Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: All the clues seem to be pointing to a suspect name Daria- the eyewitness recognises him and his shoes match the footprint at the scene. The problem is, however, Daria was dead long before the victim was killed. To make things even stranger, a forensic invest…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Serial Threats - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man's family keeps receiving death threats, and when his front door is fired at as he's returning home, he requests the help of the CID. The man suspects that an old business rival is behind these threats, and the investigation begins.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Serial Threats - Part 2
episodes.overview: Investigation reveals partially destroyed letter from Rajesh to Sheila, who fancied each other but her husband found out. Search narrows to three people, but ACP Pradyuman suggests investigating Rajesh's wife, Pallavi.

episodes.name: Better Safe Than Sorry - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man on an amusement park ride makes a phone call crying out for help. Moments later, he is thrown off the ride and killed. CID trace the call he made to a banker, who is soon found shot dead at his office.

episodes.name: Better Safe Than Sorry - Part 2
episodes.overview: The banker had opened two safe deposit boxes that belonged to him and his wife before he was killed. His wife reveals that she had recently bought some jewels, and that her husband was perhaps trying to put them into the safes.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Kidnapped Girl - Part 1
episodes.overview: Two men kidnap a girl in broad daylight at a shopping centre, despite her crying out for her friend's help. The only piece of evidence is a matchbox from a disco, found inside the girl's purse. Will CID be able to find the kidnappers and save the girl? Watch…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Kidnapped Girl - Part 2
episodes.overview: The kidnappers' van is found abandoned near the shopping centre. Eyewitness reports suggest that the kidnappers hit Manisha on the head with something to make her stop shouting for her friend's help. ACP Pradyuman reckons that she might be as good as dead, bu…

episodes.name: Target - CID - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya gets shot by a gun sent in his nephew's birthday party. Later, Asha almost dies when her lift's chain breaks. Abhijeet and Sudhakar also face an accident when the car brakes fail. Though they survive CID wonder who is behind all this.

episodes.name: Target - CID - Part 2
episodes.overview: A mysterious gas is released from a package in the CID bureau, temporarily blinding all the officers. Further investigation reveals that somebody deliberately cut the car's brakes. A handprint is found with one finger missing.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dazed Man - Part 1
episodes.overview: A kid playing by himself in the shopping center finds a man drenched in blood. He is rushed to the hospital, and the CID is called upon. ACP Pradyuman and his team realize that the man wasn't in his best possible mental state and is blabbering like an abeceda…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dazed Man - Part 2
episodes.overview: After finding the teacher's dead body, the CID are put in a catch-22 situation. They know they can't create a mass panic by releasing news about the death of the teacher to the press. Clue by clue CID inches towards the missing bus. Can it be found? Watch now…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Bomb - Part 1
episodes.overview: Criminals manage to pass through high level security and detonate a bomb. ACP and his team fail to understand how someone can bring in and explode such a massive amount of explosives and successfully blow it. Only ray of light happens to be a cockroach who su…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Invisible Bomb - Part 2
episodes.overview: Unfolding the mystery and finding another layer of poisoning in the case. It is found the poison was in the Samosa and the chai. Further investigation reveals that the culprit wears black glasses, even at night. And so begins, CID's search for this mysterious…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Suicide-That Was Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls off the building and dies. The closest person there happened to be Inspector Daya's friend, who becomes the prime accused in this case. Forensic team is convinced that Daya and Abhijeet are trying to protect the culprit. Is that really the case?Wa…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Suicide-That Was Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: With the team still trying to figure out the exact chain of events that led to the death. The forensic team gets its hands on some crucial evidence that changes the whole direction of the investigation. Can Daya clean his name and show the world duty comes fi…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Deadly Proposed - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman keeps getting phone calls from an unknown admirer. She insists that she loves him, and they should get married. She even threatens to kill a person if her proposal wasn't accepted. What does ACP do in a situation like this?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Deadly Proposed - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case shifts when ACP Pradyuman discovers that the woman who called him was just a pawn in the bigger picture, while Dr. Anjalika secures evidence to prosecute ACP Pradyuman for allegedly killing her husband.

episodes.name: Trust Me Not - Part 1
episodes.overview: A thief caught in a raid reveals that he saw a dead body in one of the houses he looted. ACP Pradyuman and his team take this matter seriously and rush to the house. But to their surprise, the woman, who the thief claimed to be dead, was in fact alive and que…

episodes.name: Trust Me Not - Part 2
episodes.overview: After shedding light on the blackmailing nexus, ACP Pradyuman and his team get into some dangerous territories, when Senior Inspector Abhijeet goes under cover and risks it all. What started off as a case involving a thief, has now taken a completely differen…

episodes.name: The Case Of Kidnapping Star - Part 1
episodes.overview: A famous film star Kamlini gets abducted from a five start hotel. ACP Pradyuman and his team are called in to investigate the matter. Kidnappers have demanded 5 crores in ransom. But things start looking suspicious really soon. What really happened? Who kidna…

episodes.name: The Case Of Kidnapping Star - Part 2
episodes.overview: The manager reveals that Kamilini was part of the plan, but the second kidnapping wasn't part of their plan. The CID is not convinced by this story. The kidnappers call CID and demanded that they pay up or witness Kamalini falls from a high rise. How does ACP…

episodes.name: The Case Of the Mistaken Identity - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID get baffled when they find two women who looked exactly like the deceased in their latest case. A bit of investigation leads them to a plastic surgeon who changes some of his patient's faces to match his daughter's face, who passed away a few years back.…

episodes.name: The Case Of the Mistaken Identity - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's car gets stopped by a girl in the middle of the road, she says her car has broken down and would appreciate some help. ACP drops her to her house but gets an ominous vibe. He speaks to the caretaker, but the caretaker tells him, the girl he sa…

episodes.name: ACP In The Game Of Death - Part 1
episodes.overview: After coming to know about the flash mob, ACP goes looking for the girl he gave a lift to. As it turns out, the girl died under unusual circumstances. This dangerous game just got real for everyone. Watch this special episode here.

episodes.name: ACP In The Game Of Death - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the forensic team reveals that the death was dude to being bitten by a venomous snake, officers are put in a fix as they didn't have suspect. It appears that the killer had made two holes in the bag and made sure that snake had enough oxygen to survive. Wh…

episodes.name: The Case 15 Years Old - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman recollects his first case in the department involving a murder because of mistaken identity, the immediate death of the murderer that followed, and the resurgence of the same murderer after years of inactivity.

episodes.name: The Case 15 Years Old - Part 2
episodes.overview: The case becomes more complex when the CID recognize the significant role facial reconstruction surgery plays, with multiple characters with their own motives. ACP Pradyuman couldn't have asked for a better welcome to the department.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Comatose Victim - Part 1
episodes.overview: A patient in a critical condition with her life at constant risk for some odd reason is being treated in a hospital. An unknown man made an attempt to cut off her life supply. The CID are called in and are promptly updated on the issue.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Comatose Victim - Part 2
episodes.overview: The mystery continues as new information about an address possibly fake but true emerges. Daya uses modern technology to search for the suspect. Knowing the fact that the suspect has already broken in twice becomes unsettling for the CID.

episodes.name: The Bloody Trail - Part 1
episodes.overview: A long trail of blood leads to a murder. It appears the victim had hidden a key of some sort in his bullet wound. What kind of key is it? What does it lead to? There must be a reason why a dying man decided to hide this key. Watch now to find out.

episodes.name: The Bloody Trail - Part 2
episodes.overview: With a key but no locker CID had to do a thorough search of the city to locate the gym where the key could be used. What did the team find inside the locker? Meanwhile, a watchman gets brutally assaulted by unknown assailants. Could these cases be connected?

episodes.name: Daksh Comes Back - Part 1
episodes.overview: Officers Daksh's almost lifeless body is found in the jungle by Senior Inspector Abhijeet and Daya. Dakhsh's lifelong mission to avenge his brother's death made him cross paths with dangerous people. Daksh who is currently fighting for his life needs ACP and…

episodes.name: Daksh Comes Back - Part 2
episodes.overview: Ever since their informer's death, the team has been tracking a package from Mongolia which was supposed to arrive along with a guy called Cheena. Will the team be able to crack down on this international nexus? Watch now to find out.

episodes.name: The Faceless Killer - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man dies in a hotel in mysterious ways. There seems to be video footage of the murderer, but with the head cropped out. What's even more intriguing is the fact that the poison-filled sweets went missing even with the camera rolling. Who is this faceless kil…

episodes.name: The Faceless Killer - Part 2
episodes.overview: Trying to clear its name off the controversy, our team traces Chandrakants wife and questions her. It's revealed that Chandrakant was an art seller was doing so behind his wife's back. Did she have enough motive to get him killed? Or was she even involved?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 1
episodes.overview: Dead bodies are found in a hotel and no one has any clue about it. Where did these bodies come from? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Dead Murderer - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic reports reveal poison to be the death of the manager and Vijay. Where did the poison come from?

episodes.name: Abhijeet In Danger - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet has been framed for the death of Riya. Abhijeet does not remember anything at all but his gun is found at the site of the crime. Is he guilty?

episodes.name: Abhijeet In Danger - Part 2
episodes.overview: Upon investigation, it is revealed that Riya's blood was stolen from the blood bank and spilt outside Ashok's house. Abhijeet is still struggling to find out his involvement in the case. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Haunted Building - Part 1
episodes.overview: A couple enters a building but soon the boyfriend runs out screaming. The watchman comes to inquire and is told that the flat in the building was haunted and he has no clue where his partner went missing.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Haunted Building - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID get to know that the only way to find the killer is to find the secret behind the medicine. They get to the prime distributors' location. Meanwhile, Dr. Salunkhe returns and challenges ACP's theory and analysis.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Conspiracy - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is suspended from CID due to his involvement in the killing. CID investigates the case of a girl who was kidnapped in a godown. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Unknown Conspiracy - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID interrogates Sushmaya who is at the funeral of her father in law. She is a prime suspect of the death of Kiran and in the meanwhile, forensics reveal that Kiran did not die due to accident. Will CID solve the mystery?

episodes.name: Man On The Bus - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls from a running bus and dies. Forensics reveal that his hand was burnt by a cigarette and then he was pushed out of the bus. Meanwhile, a girl is also found dead.

episodes.name: Man On The Bus - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID tries to tie loose ends of the death of the girl and the guy. They interrogate the manager of the restaurant where they had lunch. Will they find anything? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Deadly Betrayal - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Daya has been shot after he was investigating at a discotheque. The killer is unknown and looks like a betrayal. Watch this episode to know more.

episodes.name: The Deadly Betrayal - Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr Ranjanika at the forensics finds the fingerprint marks on the bricks that takes the team of CID closer to the killer who has also kidnapped Inspector Daya. Will CID find him? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Secret In The Ashes - Part 1
episodes.overview: Sentosa Bar gets burned down and CID finds a skeleton at the site. A girl named Reshma goes missing after the fire. Is she involved in the fire? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Secret In The Ashes - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Aditi is linked to Reshma and the team of CID finds out. Aditi does not let CID investigate Reshma who had run from her house a few years ago. How is Reshma linked? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Ticket Window - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are investigating the case of a ticket window where two people die after taking a ticket from the counter. Meanwhile, CID Special Bureau set out to punish the criminals that have been convicted but not yet punished.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Ticket Window - Part 2
episodes.overview: Sudhakar is taken to the hospital due to his critical condition after he smelled a capsule containing poisonous gas. Forensics also reveal that the two victims also died after inhaling the capsule. What does the capsule contain?

episodes.name: The Case Of The Murder In The Interrogation Room - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID is framed for the murder of two businessmen. Forensics reveals CID's involvement in the murder and strict action is taken on CID. Is CID guilty? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Murder In The Interrogation Room - Part 2
episodes.overview: Inspector Daksh is trying to steal evidence from the forensic lab and Dr Anjalika catches him. Dr Anjalika also reveals about the involvement of the family members in the murder of Dinanath. Will CID catch the real culprit? Watch this episode to find out.

episodes.name: Murders At Sunrise - Part 1
episodes.overview: A TV actor is killed while swimming at the sunrise hotel. Meanwhile, another actor has been killed. The clues lead the team of CID to the security guard who is in a critical condition.

episodes.name: Murders At Sunrise - Part 2
episodes.overview: The security guard has been tied up and CID finds a shoe mark at the site that will lead them to the killer.

episodes.name: The Case Of The One Face Two Men - Part 1
episodes.overview: Tanuj is a multi-millionaire and is found dead. Upon investigation, it is revealed that someone else has disguised himself as Tanuj and taken over the company. Forensics reveal that both the DNA's match.

episodes.name: The Case Of The One Face Two Men - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID is not convinced with the identity of Tanuj and Rupali is also killed. CID is in a fix.

episodes.name: The Final Showdown - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's car is found stranded at a spot. Upon investigation, there is blood found inside it and a girl is dead. ACP is the suspect of the murder. Is he the culprit or has someone framed him?

episodes.name: The Final Showdown - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP's son Nakul kidnaps him but ACP manages to escape and brings him to the bureau. His son pleads not guilty but ACP does not listen. Who is the real culprit if not Nakul?

episodes.name: The Case Of The 17 Lakh Suspects - Part 1
episodes.overview: A young man is found dead on Bandra flyover. The investigation leads the team of CID to his office where his colleagues reveal that he had gone to an exhibition.

episodes.name: The Case Of The 17 Lakh Suspects - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID suspect that when the motorcycle collided against the auto the knee of the rider got rammed against the headlight with considerable damage and bleeding.

episodes.name: The Case Of Jewel Thief - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP shot 3 bullets in Nakul causing severe injuries but he again manages to escape. A party takes a dramatic turn when during a game one of the friends gets killed. The parents return just then to find all the jewels in his locker missing.

episodes.name: The Case Of Jewel Thief - Part 2
episodes.overview: There is a terrible twist in the proceedings. The ambulance carrying the two bodies does not reach the forensic department. It is found abandoned on the highway with the ward boys killed.

episodes.name: Murder By Number - Part 1
episodes.overview: A dead body with a number 2 on its forehead is found and CID is called in to investigate. Another dead body turns up with the number 3 on its forehead. Is there anything common in these murders? Episode continues to Bullet .11mm: Part 1 (2005).

episodes.name: Murder By Number - Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from Bullet .11mm: Part 2 (2005), RJ Sagarika's murder investigations get a sensational twist when Daksh shoots down Inspector Arjun and is unable to prove his innocence. The killer strikes again and witness no.4 too gets shot and killed.

episodes.name: Double D.N.A. - Part 1
episodes.overview: Within a week there are two identical murders. The body is cut open and then expertly stitched back for no apparent reason as neither the heart, kidneys or liver have been removed from it. What could be the motive?

episodes.name: Double D.N.A. - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID continue to investigate based on 2 clues given by forensics. The stitching up job seems to have been the handiwork of an expert and secondly all of them were brain dead first and its DNA was different from that of the rest of the body.

episodes.name: The Fortune Teller - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called for investigating the mysterious deaths of two men. Their respective wives inform them that their death was predicted by a Baba. The Baba is called for interrogation who predicts that one of the cops is going to die soon.

episodes.name: The Fortune Teller - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues, Daya gets shot but is able to survive with some injuries. CID later realize that this was the work of the fortune teller who is a fraud but denies anything to do with the murders. Who is behind the murders?

episodes.name: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 1
episodes.overview: A man seeks help of someone travelling from Jodhpur to Mumbai, by sending a bag full of rice grains to the office of CID. Once team realizes that these rice grains have a cryptic message on them. This clue leads the team to Jodhpur.

episodes.name: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 2
episodes.overview: The team finds out that a group of some outsiders are responsible for the smuggling of Uranium and also the Judge's daughter is involved in the racket. On further investigation, the team then reaches Jaisalmer from Jodhpur.

episodes.name: The Case Of Engraved Rice Grains - Part 3
episodes.overview: In hot pursuit of uranium, CID reach Jodhpur and continue their investigation. A key is retrieved and all they can make out of it is that it has some connection with a haveli in Jaisalmer.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Stolen Ring - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet informs ACP that Pantella has trusted him with son and lef him in his custody. The kid becomes really close to Abhijeet and is inseparable. Hence Abhijeet had to bring him along to work. Abhijeet is also the head of security and is in charge of a pre…

episodes.name: he Case Of The Stolen Ring - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues, the team finds a strange tattooed man in the video chewing a gum. It is later learnt that the ring was stolen with the help of the chewing gum and the kid's yo-yo. The kid then confesses that he was helping those criminals as t…

episodes.name: The Case Of The Killer Lake - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya is held responsible for a colleague's death in the bureau, while the CID team investigates a taxi driver's death near Mansa lake, where a film unit is shooting. They find dead bodies of girls.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Killer Lake - Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet conducts the hunt of the hero only to find him dead too. Since the death of these girls took place 2 days ago and the film unit had started shooting 5 days ago, CID are convinced that the culprit is someone from the unit.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Staged Murder - Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID investigate a play accident involving an actor who was accidentally stabbed by an actress, discovering that the cause was not a stab, but a different factor.

episodes.name: The Case Of The Staged Murder - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID are taken aback to know that a lot of people had reasons why they would want the actor dead. They all had various opportunities and means to take the actor's life.

episodes.name: Abhijit Sawant Under Arrest - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP receives a tip that one of his team members is planning to take on another member. He conducts a search of their houses to avert the eventuality. Later, Abhijeet Sawant, the winner of Indian Idol 1 is charged with the murder a girl.

episodes.name: Abhijit Sawant Under Arrest - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID team learns of other possibilities involved in the girl's murder. The doctor and the girl's father, both are now suspects. Meanwhile, Abhijeet manages to trace Daya's bike with clear signs that he was in an accident.

episodes.name: Code Name Banjara - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet investigates Daya and Daksh. Two dead bodies turn up one by one, both belonging to a man called Colonel Banjara. Who are these two Colonel Banjaras? What could be the reason behind Daksh's odd behavior?

episodes.name: Code Name Banjara - Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID discover Colonel Banjara's body with 11-digit numbers on his arm, linked to Daksh's account. ACP Pradyuman gets very angry and asks Daksh, who later seen to be meeting a dubious character. Meanwhile, Daya is found with lost speech.

episodes.name: The Case Of Mysterious Truck - Part 1
episodes.overview: On a busy street a lady's bag is found that was smelling of gun powder. Fearing that it could have a bomb,CID team is called for investigation. Later in the office ACP Pradyuman receives a call from Varun requesting if Aditi could have a day off. A key inside…

episodes.name: The Case Of Mysterious Truck - Part 2
episodes.overview: As the investigation continues,it is revealed in the forensics lab that both the murders took place in different places.One of the murders took place in or near a place where painting was done.Just then Aditi asks the team to rush over to Varun's showroom whe…

episodes.name: Man Eater - Part 1
episodes.overview: Someone is going around kidnapping women from a set of a TV series. The bodies of these women soon turn up, half eaten. With no idea who's behind this atrocity, CID send one of their officers undercover to find out who this man-eater is.

episodes.name: Man Eater - Part 2
episodes.overview: While undercover, Aditi begins searching the set suspecting the cameraman. However, she is shocked to find boxes filled with ice, and the body parts of the missing women, in the director's room, but it's too late as the director finds her.

episodes.name: MAD BOMBER - Part 1
episodes.overview: Subbu calls people imitating celebrities' voices and robs them. Meanwhile, a mad criminal Bandora sends a letter to CID that a bomb will explode every 4 hours if he's not paid 5 crore rupees. Episode continues to Mad Bomber: Part 1 (2005).

episodes.name: MAD BOMBER - Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from Mad Bomber: Part 2 (2005), The bombs are now going to go off even if the CID pay the 5 crores, since Bandora won't be able to tell his men to deactivate them. CID begin to search for the bombs, with some help from Subbu.

episodes.name: Anokha Intequam - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is accused of destroying evidence from a murder case to save his friend a film star. The case is given to the CID Special Bureau to solve. Is Abhijeet innocent? Episode continues to Anokha Intequam: Part 2 (2005).

episodes.name: Anokha Intequam - Part 6
episodes.overview: Continuing from Anokha Intequam: Part 5 (2005), the Special Bureau's investigation reveals that Rakhi has been hiding at her hairdresser's home and has recently left to go to a coffee house to take money from someone.

episodes.name: Watery Grave - Part 1
episodes.overview: When the monsoon rains cause floods in Mumbai, dozens of bodies of people who have drowned are found by the CID. All the bodies get claimed by kin, except one, a man whose face has been severely facially deformed. A forensic investigation reveals that the bod…

episodes.name: Watery Grave - Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic investigation of the victim's body reveals that the water inside his lungs is not rainwater, but rather tapwater, likely from a bathroom somewhere. Officers also find a bob in the mans hand, that is commonly used as a clown's nose in a circus. Meanwh…

episodes.name: The Case Of Dead Waiter - Part 1
episodes.overview: A model is in the middle of a photoshoot at a hotel, when a man falls off a balcony into the hotel swimming pool, dying. CID finds out that the man is Ganpath, a former waiter at the hotel, who was fired after being accused of stealing. On the balcony, office…

episodes.name: The Case Of Dead Waiter - Part 2
episodes.overview: An investigation into Ganpath life reveals that he had recently brought his sister 3 lakh rupees for her wedding, very mysteriously. Meanwhile, the model, Jahnvi is forced to move into a different room when she finds her room ransacked. Could she be in danger…

episodes.name: 3 Rat Cat 3 - Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are summoned to a house fire, where they find multiple burnt bodies, and a man, whose life they save on the verge of death. They find out that he arrived in India from abroad, just 9 days prior to the incident.

episodes.name: 3 Rat Cat 3 - Part 2
episodes.overview: A strange ring is found. When scanned, CID find that it has an extra coat on it hiding a phrase underneath saying, "3 Rat Cat 3". When Max hears this phrase in the hospital, he immediately dies of shock. What does this phrase mean?

episodes.name: Face Off - Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet and Daya receive a message from the DCP, summoning them to a special location, where they find out that a CID officer is being investigated for a suspected conspiracy. They are shocked to find out he's none other than the ACP.

episodes.name: Face Off - Part 2
episodes.overview: A man is found on the verge of death. He is rushed to the hospital. When asked who did this to him, he points to the ACP. The CID cannot believe that the ACP could possibly be involved in treason and now murder.

episodes.name: Face Off - Part 3
episodes.overview: The ACP shoots at Daksh and flees much to the CID's shock. Daksh, fighting for his life, tells the DIG that his life is in danger because of the ACP. The DIG responds by telling Abhijeet and Daya to kill the ACP in an encounter.

episodes.name: Face Off - Part 4
episodes.overview: Amidst orders from the DIG to kill ACP Pradyuman, Abhijeet finds out that the ACP has left for London. Abhijeet lies to the DIG that the ACP has left for Uganda. Meanwhile, the DIG puts a new ACP Prithviraj, when a new case reaches them.

episodes.name: Trail In London - Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman is in London searching for a criminal named Degendu to no avail. Meanwhile in Mumbai, Nakul attempts to murder Daksh on his hospital bed but is saved in time. With more proof against him could ACP Pradyuman still be innocent?

episodes.name: Trail In London - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman finally finds Degendu, who has now become a simple man leading a life away from crime. He asks him to identify the men in a photograph he found, and although he can't do that, he does identify the café where they are sitting.

episodes.name: Trail In London - Part 3
episodes.overview: Degendu betrays ACP Pradyuman and calls the local police on him. But before they can catch the ACP, he escapes, and manages to find the café from the photograph. Back in Mumbai, ACP Prithviraj attempts to find Nakul.

episodes.name: Murder By Marriage - Part 1
episodes.overview: A groom is shot and killed at a wedding parade. An investigation reveals four guns that were used recently. Who could be behind this tragic murder. Could there be a family grudge in the midst of this wedding?

episodes.name: Murder By Marriage - Part 2
episodes.overview: Further investigation reveals that the gunshot came from the bride's home, not far away, from a gun belonging to the bride's father. The father insists that he hasn't used the gun in many years.

episodes.name: Poison In The Nail - Part 1
episodes.overview: A fight between two women models begins at a fashion show. Things turn sour when one of them collapses and dies. Initial forensic evidence suggests that she was strangled to death. Could the fight really have led to this woman's death?

episodes.name: Poison In The Nail - Part 2
episodes.overview: A twist in the tale develops when it's found through a deeper forensic investigation that Reva, the model, died by ingesting poison. While searching her room, a CD is found containing inappropriate photographs of several women.

episodes.name: Mental Cruelty - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman named Kalpana publicly screams that her husband wants to kill her. But as her husband arrives, her behavior changed completely, shocking Abhijeet, who is present there. Was she truly crying out for help or just making a scene?

episodes.name: Mental Cruelty - Part 2
episodes.overview: As Abhijeet questions Kalpana's husband, on the other side of Mumbai, a woman finds a man's finger inside her drink. While CID are investigating, Abhijeet gets a call, informing him that Kalpana's husband has been murdered.

episodes.name: Yellow Roses - Part 1
episodes.overview: Rita threatens Peter by saying if he marries anyone else, she would commit suicide. This angers Peter even more and he in return challenges her that he will get married in week. On the day of the wedding, a mysterious murder happens. Who gets killed? Who kill…

episodes.name: Yellow Roses - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman needs to know the mystery of the flower. How come there were two bouquets instead of one? Was it all Peter's plan? He investigates and reaches the florist and takes him in for interrogation. What does the florist tell him that changes the whole…

episodes.name: Killer Whistle - Part 1
episodes.overview: A tune playing next to the scene of crime takes the CID to a studio owned by famous musician Baba Sehgal. It convinces the CID that either Baba or someone from his team is guilty in this case. But Baba refuses all allegations and Dr.Salunke is called in to so…

episodes.name: Killer Whistle - Part 2
episodes.overview: The forensic team needs to match Baba's whistle with the recorded audio to have any sort of case against him. With the case being a double murder now, all eyes are on ACP and his team. What’s the mystery behind this tune? Are more people involved who aren’t c…

episodes.name: Return of the Jewel Thief
episodes.overview: Tipu Sultan's ancient jewelry is up for auction, but a famous jewel thief has his eyes on it. A seasoned group of jewel thieves strike overnight and get away with valuables worth crores. It wasn’t long before the thieves got in touch and demanded money in ret…

episodes.name: Maut Ka Saudagar
episodes.overview: While a serial killer terrorizes the city, a psychic gets in touch with ACP Pradyuman, wishing to predict a death. Meanwhile, Dr. Vinay a practicing doctor with some side interest in a supernatural phenomenon was asked by his colleagues to stay off unscientif…

episodes.name: Letter from the Past
episodes.overview: A woman who was house hunting was warned by her neighbors to not buy the house she liked, as it was ominous according to them. She claimed that the house belonged to a famous model who was pushed off the edge by her photographer boyfriend. Further investigati…

episodes.name: Yeh Phool Chaman Mein Kaisa Khila
episodes.overview: A man wakes up next to his dead wife without any recollection of what happened the night before. He faintly remembers having a nightmare about attacking his wife but was certain he did not commit the crime. Did he or did he not? Or was he made to? The only cl…

episodes.name: The Case of the Baby Killer
episodes.overview: A blind, a deaf and a mute man witness a crime in a grocery store. A person wearing a Burkha chases a woman carrying a baby, she gives the baby to the deaf man and escapes. The friend's panic with a baby in hand and call the CID. What happens when a team of s…

episodes.name: The Case of the Mysterious Shadow
episodes.overview: A blind woman reaches out to the Cid and informs them about an intruder who visits her room at night and looks for some documents. She strengthens her claims when she correctly guesses how many people were around her in the office. ACP Pradyuman take it upon…

episodes.name: Dynamite
episodes.overview: A truck full of dynamite goes missing and a huge explosion takes part in a different part of the city. A famous builder and his wife go missing after the explosion. With no leads and fingerprints, investigation reaches a halt, but there’s new hope when a palm…

episodes.name: Murder at Midnight
episodes.overview: Mumbai wakes up to a shock when a body wrapped in a mattress is found. Forensic analysis reveals that the reason for death was Hypothermia. How can a body be frozen to death in Mumbai weather? Investigation leads to a lab somewhere in Mumbai where something v…

episodes.name: Murder on 97.1 FM
episodes.overview: Mumbai wakes up to a shock when a body wrapped in a mattress is found. Forensic analysis reveals that the reason for death was Hypothermia. How can a body be frozen to death in Mumbai weather? The investigation leads to a lab somewhere in Mumbai where somethi…

episodes.name: Murder in the Safety Vault

episodes.overview: Ayesha and Shaurya receive a house in inheritance from a distant relative whom they are not so familiar with. When they enter the house, Ayesha seems to have been here in the house before and discovers bones in the house. Shaurya informs CID and the investiga…

episodes.name: Gayab Goli
episodes.overview: A wealthy businessman Dhanraj was on his way to put his diamonds in a safe but before he could do that, the diamonds are stolen and he is shot dead in the parking lot. CID is informed and upon investigation, they find out that Dhanraj never told anyone about…

episodes.name: Katte Pairo Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A girl and her boyfriend find a shoe with the feet cut and soaked in blood. CID is called in to investigate and the forensics reveal that the foot has been lying there from the past 3 days. Is it a case of serial killing?

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Bansuri
episodes.overview: A newly made bridge is made on the highway and is the recipient of the sound of a flute and whoever listens to the flute, he/she is never found again. CID investigates the matter and the clues lead them to various skeletons. Watch this episode to find out abo…

episodes.name: Raaz Necklace Message Ka
episodes.overview: Seven people arrive at an isolated spot as they receive an SMS from the same number. Meanwhile, a professor is killed in the washroom of an airport when he is about to leave the country. Are the seven people linked to the professor?

episodes.name: CID Aur Nanhe Detectives
episodes.overview: Kids and teachers in a school become hostage to terrorists but somehow manage to call CID for help. Will CID save the kids and teachers?

episodes.name: Raaz Wristband Killer Ka
episodes.overview: Three kids spot a girl in danger and call CID for help. Upon interrogation, it is found that the girl was missing and they also find the dead body of Akhil. Who killed Akhil? Is Akhil linked to the girl?

episodes.name: Bhootiya Khooni
episodes.overview: Nihaal and family are out to spend a weekend to a mansion but their car breaks down in the middle of the road. Nihaal's sister hears a whispering sound but Nihaal doesn't pay attention. The next morning she is found dead. Who killed her?

episodes.name: Raaz Khooni Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: Abhijeet and Daya are undercover to catch a culprit named Babu who is involved in a drug-smuggling racket. They chase him but before they can catch him, he is shot dead leaving a clue of a plain paper. Who shot him and why?

episodes.name: Dhobi Ghat Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Jiya is about to get married. Hell breaks loose when an unknown dress comes back from the laundry that doesn't belong to Jiya and upon finding out, it's revealed that the worker who dyed the dress is murdered. Who killed him and why?

episodes.name: Victoria Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Three youngsters find a dead body lying at Marine drive. The cut marks on the body match with three other deaths in a month. What seems to be a case of serial killing of beggars has changed its modus operandi to killing a rich girl.

episodes.name: Rahasya Qatil Kidnapper Ka
episodes.overview: Shobhit is walking on a lonely road with a suitcase and gets into a fight with two men and ends up killing one of them. CID comes to arrest him but he reveals that his son has been kidnapped and is later found dead in their own house.

episodes.name: Raaz Khooni Chetawni Ka
episodes.overview: Manu's servant is killed in his house. Upon interrogating Manu, he reveals that he was asleep when someone sneaked into the house and killed him leaving a threat message to kill Manu. CID suspects his stepbrother and wife.

episodes.name: Qatl Ka Raaz Mare Hue Qatil Ke Paas
episodes.overview: Gayatri, a widow hears a whistle in a mall and follows it but goes into a shock after seeing the man. Later, a thief enters her room, and she shoots him. CID follow the blood trail only to find his dead body a couple of meters away.

episodes.name: CID Maut Ke Kagaar Par
