episodes.overview: CID are waiting for their informant and as soon as he arrives, he dies after coming in contact with lightning. Upon investigation, it is found out that the informant was killed deliberately. Who could have killed him?

episodes.name: AC Duct Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A strong stench smell is noticed in Kashyap's office, but the source is nowhere to be found. Upon searching, they find Kashyap's dead body in the AC duct. CID are informed.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki DVD
episodes.overview: While watching a horror movie, Sid and Tanya see a real footage of a girl being shot dead. The girl is Tanya's sister Meenakshi, who had gone missing a few years ago. CID are informed about this and they find a skeleton at the murder site.

episodes.name: Peephole Murder
episodes.overview: On the night of Ritwik's birthday party, Maya sees Ritwik in an argument with a girl. Later in the night, she sees Ritwik being killed, but later Ritwik is found alive. Who has died if not Ritwik?

episodes.name: Stuntman Murder
episodes.overview: During a karate rehearsal, a man starts fighting with Sameer. Later, a man's body is burning and Sameer is found dead. Why did the two get into a fight? How did Sameer die?

episodes.name: Raaz Qatil Hatyar Ka
episodes.overview: Real estate agent Nitin is found dead in the house he has come to deal for. CID are informed. Nitin was killed in a very strange manner where a part of his flesh is lying near his dead body. Who killed Nitin so brutally and why?

episodes.name: Kissa Paagal Ashiq Ka
episodes.overview: Famous actress Pia is kidnapped, and all eyes are on the cameraman Devesh who had a fight with her. Before CID could catch Devesh, he runs into a makeshift lift that crashes down and kills him along with an unconscious girl. Where is Pia?

episodes.name: Paagal Aashiq
episodes.overview: During Payal's farewell party, her friend Karan is worried. He sees Payal crying while talking to Manish and gets furious on Manish. Next day Payal is found dead in Karan's car and Karan says that he is innocent. Who killed Payal?

episodes.name: Kissa X-Ray Suraag Ka
episodes.overview: A radiology staff is stabbed to death during a false fire alarm in a hospital. He was attending an old man who is now missing. The clues lead the CID to the case of performance-enhancing drugs. How was he involved and who killed him?

episodes.name: Aazadi Ki Jung ACP Pradyuman Ke Sang - Part 1
episodes.overview: Vivek is on a special mission to find the whereabouts of a convicted terrorist who is planning an attack on Independence Day. Vivek goes missing and CID are on the lookout while on the other end a victim asks CID for help.

episodes.name: Aazadi Ki Jung ACP Pradyuman Ke Sang - Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman and Fredricks are the only two officers left of CID after all the other members go missing. The plan is laid down by an old criminal who was arrested by them. Will CID save the city?

episodes.name: Daya Ek Qatil
episodes.overview: Judges of a food competition show are poisoned but doctors manage to save them. Sanket, the organizer feared that a killer is trying to ruin the competition. Daya enters this show undercover. However, Sanket is killed and Daya is framed.

episodes.name: Highway Killers
episodes.overview: Jigar, a hot-tempered guy, goes on a road trip with his friends and they all go missing. Investigations lead CID to a village nearby where they find Jigar's car with bloodstains.

episodes.name: Kissa Double Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Two women are mysteriously killed. The twist in the case comes when they find out that one of them was having an illicit relationship with a married man. Who is the killer? And if the affair was the cause, then why a double murder?

episodes.name: Raaz Khooni Ke Kidnap Ka
episodes.overview: Mitali, a famous model, kills a man Ravi on a busy street and then she disappears. Investigations reveal that her friend Vicky and Ravi were enemies. Cops doubt Vicky but he claims innocence.

episodes.name: CID Mission Goa - Part 1
episodes.overview: Vijay, who is posted in Goa as a police officer, gets killed while following the case of Carlos, a notorious drug mafia. Before dying he is able to contact his friend ACP Pradyuman who rushes to Goa only to be trapped and gets kidnapped.

episodes.name: CID Mission Goa - Part 2
episodes.overview: The twist in the case comes when Abhijeet falls off a cliff, looses his memory and made to believe by the mafia that he is Carlos.

episodes.name: Ganesh Utsav Special
episodes.overview: Yaksh, a young businessman dies in a bomb blast in his office on the eve of Ganesh Chaturthi. Meanwhile, the CID team that was investigating the murder of a man find out that both the cases are connected.

episodes.name: The Case of Memory Loss
episodes.overview: Saloni is abducted by gangsters who want to know the whereabouts of a pendrive. However, she doesn't know about it. She manages to escape and meets with an accident. What's so special about that pendrive?

episodes.name: Bandra Fair Mein Sareaam Maut
episodes.overview: A small-time thief, Kimmi, gets shot on the ferry wheel in the Bandra fair. CID investigations lead them to a robbery of expensive jewels. A twist is added when it is revealed that Kimmi was actually working undercover for cops.

episodes.name: Aakhein
episodes.overview: Meera's birthday takes a dark turn when she receives a seemingly innocent doll ordered by her father. However, the discovery that the doll contains actual human eyes unravels a sinister tale.

episodes.name: Raaz Paani Mein Jale Haatho Ka
episodes.overview: Mahinder is found dead in the basement of his ice cream parlour with burnt hands. On further investigation, cops come across a room where drugs are being processed. CID have to find out not just the murder weapon but also bust the racket.

episodes.name: Adrush Zeher
episodes.overview: A man is found dead in a taxi. Another dead body is found in a forest. Dr. Salunkhe finds out that both of them had paan before they died. CID's investigations lead them to an isolated gambling den.

episodes.name: Jale Murde Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: An old lady burns to ashes but the chair on which she was sitting is intact.

episodes.name: Maut Ki Aawaz
episodes.overview: A father gets a ransom call about his son, but he thinks this to be a prank as his son is in front of his eyes. The next day his son is found dead in his room.

episodes.name: Kissa Raavan Dehan Ka - Part 1
episodes.overview: A headless body is found in a jungle with a cinema ticket. It is revealed that another man visited the theatre briefly and left a bag with old newspapers. The trail leads to a kidnapping case, but CID must find the murderer.

episodes.name: Kissa Raavan Dehan Ka - Part 2
episodes.overview: CID gathers all the evidence that they found in the jungle. They also find a motive and a pattern that keeps the case on the hook. Every victim of the killer has committed a crime but got away.

episodes.name: Tasveer Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: A man is murdered and his body is found in antique furniture. When the body goes for forensic analysis, they find a photograph in his body with a plea to save someone holding the secret to another murder.

episodes.name: Bank Robbery Se Bada Shadayantra
episodes.overview: A robbery attempt of a jewellery shop goes haywire when the security guard tries to stop it and gets killed. But the robbers were carrying fake guns. Then who shot the security guard? Though robbers escaped, they're found dead.

episodes.name: Bezubaan Gavah
episodes.overview: 5 girls are playing hide and seek at a bungalow when 4 of them get brutally killed. The CID to their horror finds an organ trafficking racket behind these murders as they find more dead bodies buried with their vital organs missing.

episodes.name: Aaropi Dr. Salunkhe
episodes.overview: A young woman's body mysteriously disappears from forensic lab and Dr. Salunkhe keeps quiet about it and lies to the CID.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Diwali
episodes.overview: On Diwali night, Rhea and Tina, two cousins, play a prank on the assistant director Poorak by making a prank call, threatening to expose his misdeeds. However, their joke takes a turn when Rhea is found murdered shortly after the call.

episodes.name: Kolkata Mein Target – Daya
episodes.overview: An injured Daya is chased by some goons in Kolkata. Meanwhile in Mumbai, CID are lead to clues that make them believe that Daya has killed someone. They go to Kolkata and realize that Daya is trapped in a web of a conspiracy.

episodes.name: Shaadi Ka Khooni Haar
episodes.overview: A woman shows up at a jewellery store with a bag of jewels she wants to sell desperately. During the checking of jewels for authenticity, they find a patch of blood on its back. Terrified, he rushes to the CID with the jewels.

episodes.name: Aatma Ka Khel
episodes.overview: A tensed Deepak faints during his marriage rituals and is found dead when his would-be wife Tanya had come out of the room. Cops get to know that he was under the treatment of a psychiatrist according to whom Deepak used to see ghosts.

episodes.name: Rakht Chinha - Part 1
episodes.overview: Shruti dies in front of many people in a disco. She was bleeding from eyes, nose and ears.

episodes.name: Rakht Chinha - Part 2
episodes.overview: A woman's body is found on the outskirts of the city. Her head is shaved, there is blood everywhere and mutilated marks all over the body, and her eyes are glued open.

episodes.name: Khoon Peene Wala Qatil
episodes.overview: A corpse is found with all of its blood sucked out. According to an eyewitness, the blood was sucked out by a person. The investigation starts and CID find out that the culprit at the crime scene is a man named Ratnesh, who is on the run.

episodes.name: Rakht Chinha - Part 4
episodes.overview: Palash gives a flat in a renovated building to his friends Aarav and Mihika, a newly married couple. But on the first night of their stay, they discover a leaking ceiling. To their horror, the ceiling is not dripping water, but blood.

episodes.name: Gumraah Saboot
episodes.overview: A businessman staying in a hotel is murdered. Interestingly, CID investigates to find the owner of the company to be alive leading to a confusion, as to who is alive and who is dead. CID is left with clues that seem useless.

episodes.name: Masoom Suraag
episodes.overview: CID find a woman's dead body is found in the road near a jungle, with her face completely destroyed. They hear a baby crying and follow the sound to a cave, where they find another woman's dead body with the baby underneath it.

episodes.name: Raaz Khooni Aawaaz Ka
episodes.overview: On a film set, an actress falls and dies. However, the cameraman has a dream that she was actually murdered. CID's investigation confirms this. In fact, someone came that day in disguise and killed her.

episodes.name: Zehrila Dart
episodes.overview: Nitin reaches a club and meets a man named Gattu. Both of them are up to something inquisitive and look tensed. When Nitin returns home he finds his father dead. CID find a dart near the collar bone as the murder weapon.

episodes.name: CID Ne Kiya Apharan
episodes.overview: CID find a girl running from a person who claims to be her father. They save the girl from the man and she tells them that she's seen a dead body, but she will only tell them more about it if they'll help her kidnap a boy.

episodes.name: Badli Laash Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: Girish's wife comes crying to CID fearing for his life from Rakesh who was sent to jail because of his testimony. CID manage to catch Rakesh and find Girish's dead body along with another man's dead body at the same place.

episodes.name: Khush Aatmahatya
episodes.overview: Mohit wins 50 lakh rupees lottery, but the same day, has a stone thrown at his house with a message attached which he doesn't show to his wife. That night, he falls from his balcony of his apartment and dies.

episodes.name: Kissa Jaadui Kamre Ka
episodes.overview: A wealthy couple have bought the controversial and haunted mansion of a notorious magician of the 1930s to turn it into a heritage hotel. But their plans are thwarted by stories of the magician's 'magic room', from where people go missing.

episodes.name: Khooni Tohfa
episodes.overview: Kashyap, is celebrating his daughter Shimona's 20th birthday with a Christmas-themed party. But this happy celebration turns sour when his daughter dies in a blast on the day of her birthday and his wife is kidnapped by the killer.

episodes.name: Khatra Radioactive Gas Ka
episodes.overview: A hospital receives 4 patients in critical condition. They're diagnosed with radioactivity exposure. When they suddenly die, the hospital is vacated immediately in panic. CID must find how they came in contact with radioactive elements.

episodes.name: Khooni Ka Pardafaash
episodes.overview: The CID is called to a theatre where a senior actor dressed as a vampire is found dead. His death is very mysterious, as his body is paralyzed, but there is no visible cause of death.

episodes.name: Happy Hew Year
episodes.overview: A few of the guests during a New Year Party in a hotel outside the city, receive a phone call, making them leave the party in panic. As the CID is about to leave for New Year celebrations, they receive a call on a series of accidents.

episodes.name: Holiday Murder
episodes.overview: Fredricks invites the CID team for a holiday in his village. But, in this village lives a boy who has seen a few people doing evil deeds. Will Team CID find this boy and solve the case of that mysterious night?

episodes.name: Kissa Lift Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Piyush, a disco owner is found murdered in a lift without any wound on his body or evidence for a cause of death. On top of that driver on the ground floor did not see the lift stopping at any level or see anyone getting in or out of it.

episodes.name: Raaz Safed Shirt Wali Ladki Ka
episodes.overview: A scared girl gets onto a bus, but a robber follows her. She jumps off the bus, but the robber snatches her bag and is caught and beaten up and in the scuffle, the contents of the bag fall out: blood-stained tissues and a dagger.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: A psychic who can read minds finds that one of the guests on his show is a killer and is going to kill a girl. CID don't believe this, but they can't take a risk. They round up every girl. But still, one of the girls gets attacked.

episodes.name: Kissa Daya Aur Lapata Bacche Ka - Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman comes to the CID saying that her baby has been kidnapped, and her husband who went to pay the ransom has gone missing. CID go to the location and find him lying dead and Daya unconscious, insisting that he did not kill the man.

episodes.name: Kissa Daya Aur Lapata Bacche Ka - Part 2
episodes.overview: The kidnapped baby is found in Daya's house. CID realize that somebody is trying to frame Daya. They follow the informer who told Daya to go to the location where the husband's body was found but he also gets killed.

episodes.name: Bhootiya Hospital
episodes.overview: A series of deaths due to brain haemorrhage happen in a hospital which is rumored to be haunted.

episodes.name: Raaz Newspaper Ka
episodes.overview: A journalist is killed in the newspaper office. CID find that the newspaper had a secret code that was used to communicate with terrorist groups. An attack on CID and further investigation reveal another bomb blast attempt on Republic Day.

episodes.name: Raaz Chalte Ped Ka
episodes.overview: Vicky and his friends are in his uncle's bungalow for a picnic. The caretaker warns them not to go to the jungle behind the bungalow since it is haunted. However, they still go there, and Vicky gets killed mysteriously by a tree.

episodes.name: Raaz Bandh Kamre Ke Khooni Ka
episodes.overview: A party is going on at Monica's farmhouse, and they are playing a card game. Soon a chit comes up that says that "M" will die that night. Everyone thinks this is a joke but things soon turn sour when Monica dies in a closed room.

episodes.name: Abhijit Ki Maa
episodes.overview: A woman and her son get attacked by an unknown assailant next to a pay phone. CID reach there and rush the lady to the hospital. When she opens her eyes, she recognizes Abhijeet. Abhijeet, however, has no recollection of her.

episodes.name: Pyaar Ka Khooni Tohfa
episodes.overview: Rishabh and Akshit get into a fight on Valentine's Day. Akshit pledges that he'll teach him a lesson. The next morning, Akshit's dead body is found in the swimming pool and CID are called in. They inquire about Rishabh, but he's missing.

episodes.name: Khel Andhvishwas Ka
episodes.overview: A superstitious man gets worried when his wife makes a series of mistakes that may lead to something terrible. Next morning, she falls off the balcony and CID are called in. He blames everything on the omens, but they don't believe him.

episodes.name: Raaz 25 Saal Purani Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A builder trying to sell his property gets shocked when a storm uproots a tree and a corpse is found under the stump. CID's investigation reveals that apart from an upturned chair, everything else had sheets covering them from dust.

episodes.name: Kissa Anjaan Caller Ka
episodes.overview: Daya gets a call from an unknown girl who says a murder has taken place. The CID find out the phone number belongs to Ajay Kumar. Later, a man named Vishesh is found dead in the same housing society as Ajay Kumar.

episodes.name: Khoon Ka Deewana
episodes.overview: A stalker makes Kamya's life miserable. One night, Kamya comes back home to find her maid murdered. The stalker asks her not to inform the cops or else she and her friends would have to pay the price. How does Kamya deal with the stalker?

episodes.name: Gayab Gawah
episodes.overview: Ballu, a thief attempting to break into a car finds a dead body in it. Panicked, he calls the CID. However, upon the CID's arrival, both the car and Ballu, are nowhere to be found. Eventually, they find Ballu shot in the stomach.

episodes.name: Khooni Keel
episodes.overview: A group of friends accidentally push a man by their car. The dead man's wife believes he was killed so CID investigates from a different perspective. Closer inspection of CCTV reveals the deceased to be running from something or someone.

episodes.name: Khooni Gulaal
episodes.overview: Guests at a Holi party get shocked to see a dead body next to a tree. CID is called in to investigate and find that only the face was terribly burnt. Investigation reveals that some dangerous chemical laced with the color.

episodes.name: Bank Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: Officials at the bank panic when they find a man choking to death. The nephew of the deceased tells CID that he had suspected that something might go wrong with his uncle as he was acting strange for a before his death.

episodes.name: Dahej Ka Danav
episodes.overview: A woman gets tortured by her in-laws for dowry. Her sister-in-law calls the CID and they reach on time and save her. However, her life was still not out of danger; somebody makes another attempt to kill her in the hospital.

episodes.name: Chota Sainik
episodes.overview: A boy saves a man from drowning. While trying to save the man, the boy faints due to his asthma problem and is admitted to the hospital. Who pushed the man in the pool and why?

episodes.name: Buland Hosle
episodes.overview: 3 statues that were recently auctioned become the reason behind murders. The ancient statues are being stolen from the buyers after killing them. 2 are already dead; can CID get to the third on time? What's so special in these statues?

episodes.name: Choti Si Asha
episodes.overview: In a mugging case that goes wrong, the robbers take everything and still kill the couple. The nanny and the infant escape and inform the CID. No blood is found in the front seat of the car, despite the murder. Will CID find the culprits?

episodes.name: Veerta Ki Jung Dacait Ke Sang
episodes.overview: A group of tourists, travelling inside dangerous territories, ask the driver to take them deep in the jungle. He refuses but he bribes him and takes over the wheel. They drive through the jungle only to be ambushed by dacoits.

episodes.name: Raaz Wheelchair Ka
episodes.overview: Neighbours hear a couple screaming for help. They see them badly bruised, but the attackers escape. Immediate medical attention is given to them and CID are called in. But to their surprise the couple refuse to file a case.

episodes.name: Mission Shirdi Part 1
episodes.overview: A man, who was on an office tour goes inside the restroom and gets attacked and his bag gets snatched. The bag is found empty so he leaves him for dead and disguises himself as one of the colleagues. What was he looking for in the bag?

episodes.name: Mission Shirdi Part 2
episodes.overview: With the knowledge that the bus is going towards Shirdi, CID is trying to get ahead of them and stop the bus. Knowing the bag contains some sort of explosives, they race against time to stop it getting it into the wrong hands.

episodes.name: Raaz Boondighat Ka
episodes.overview: Two set of accidents happen where the victims are mysteriously killed in a place named Boondighat where people get disappeared. CID decides to venture to find out the truth.

episodes.name: Raaz Heart Attack Ka
episodes.overview: An owner of a call center dies mysteriously inside his office. CID investigates to find no traces of blood. Forensic analysis reveals that the man died because of a heart attack but something felt off. Is the heart attack a murder?

episodes.name: CID Mein Daraar - Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya sees ACP in a restaurant with a woman carrying a gun. He gets suspicious but ACP rejects his calls. Daya gets worried and follows him. Daya notices ACP's strange behavior and he seemed to be interacting with questionable characters.

episodes.name: CID Mein Daraar - Part 2
episodes.overview: With ACP on the run and missing, the DCP orders the team to find him as soon as possible. The DCP looks fidgety but insists he is worried for Pradyuman. Abhijeet is convinced that the ACP has been kidnapped, but the DCP doesn't agree.

episodes.name: CID Mein Daraar - Part 3
episodes.overview: A phone next to a dead body with the last dialed number creates more suspicions. Abhijeet tracks down on ACP Pradyuman's phone and manages to find the chip and more information on the ACP's whereabouts and his vehicle.

episodes.name: CID Mein Daraar - Part 4
episodes.overview: The rift in CID deepens. With DCP on the hunt for the ACP, he interrogates all the junior members but none of them reply. Abhijeet and Fredricks reach the location where the ACP was last seen hoping to find clues on his whereabouts.

episodes.name: Raaz TV Reporter Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: On a live show, Malay is interviewing an astrologer who predicts his death and Malay dies in some time. Vivek who is also there for an interview, hears the commotion and rushes to check in. He sees Malay's body frozen.

episodes.name: Raaz Aatmahatya Ka
episodes.overview: People are taking their own lives without any apparent motive. Witnesses recount that the victims appeared to be entranced before their fatal actions.

episodes.name: Raaz Bad Uncle Ka
episodes.overview: An old couple returning from a holiday find a terrified 4-year-old child in the boot of their car. CID is informed about this and they start searching for the kid's family and reach his house where they find his elder brother missing.

episodes.name: Raaz Khidki Pe Bache Ka
episodes.overview: A family shifts into a new neighbourhood where stories are rife about a deserted house from which a family disappeared 3 months ago. The daughter of the family sees a boy at her window asking for help from the deserted house.

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Bacche Ka
episodes.overview: Aryan and his mother Niharika have been kidnapped and are hiding in the jungle. Aryan's friend Riddhi informs CID about this. Investigation leads them to the place where the two have been hiding from the goons.

episodes.name: Raaz Kate Kaano Ka
episodes.overview: The CID team finds four murder victims and the one thing common between all of them is that their ears have been chopped off.

episodes.name: Operation Theatre Ka Khooni Raaz
episodes.overview: Vijay is brought into the operation theatre. Dr. Mayur instructs Sonia to get the oxygen cylinder but she doesn't respond and it kills Vijay. When the furious doctor approaches her, he realizes that she is not Sonia as she falls and dies.

episodes.name: Raaz Accident Ka
episodes.overview: A girl named Richa dies due to an accident while she was on her way to the CID bureau to reveal a secret. Upon investigation, it is found out that the accident was a pre-planned murder.

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Maa Baap Ka
episodes.overview: In this special episode, Rowdy Rathore rescues a child.

episodes.name: Raaz Kaatne Wale Qatil Ka
episodes.overview: A group of college friends are refreshing their old memories. A heating argument takes place between Preeti and Sheela. Angered, Sheela leaves and Riya and Naina try to stop her but she gets murdered. Her corpse is found with bite marks.

episodes.name: Raaz Chandi Ki Goli Ka
episodes.overview: Jairaj, along with his wife and daughter, is packing their bags to escape financial troubles. During an argument with investors, a power outage occurs, and Jairaj is shot dead while his daughter is kidnapped.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Bulawa
episodes.overview: CID gets a call from a stranger who is under attack but before he can say anything the call gets disconnected. CID tracks down the call and reaches a bungalow where they find the man dead.

episodes.name: Laash Pe Laash
episodes.overview: Deepak, Jatin and their other friends witness a man falling from an under-construction building and call the CID. Did the man commit suicide or was he killed?

episodes.name: Raaz Dum Dum Bullet Ka
episodes.overview: This episode deals with the infamous DUM DUM bullet that was invented in Kolkata and used in the Norway shootout.

episodes.name: Raaz Kidnapped Scientists Ka
episodes.overview: A vegetable vendor spots a man falling from a running bus. The man is still conscious but dies in front of the vendor. CID is called in to investigate. Who killed him? Why was he thrown from the running bus?

episodes.name: CID Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: The residents of a society call the CID on their resident named Vikram who has a gun with him. They go in to interrogate and in a fight, Vikram gets shot. They find photographs of young kids who have been tied up. What does Vikram do?

episodes.name: Khooni Paani
episodes.overview: A kid is terrified after he sees blood in the swimming pool. CID is called in to investigate and they find 4 unidentified dead bodies from the pool.

episodes.name: Raaz Sar Aur Haath Ka
episodes.overview: A head and a hand cut off are found in a park. Dr. Salunkhe reveals that the parts belong to different bodies. A bracelet found on the hands of one of the bodies leads the CID to continue their investigation further.

episodes.name: Raaz Latakti Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A man is found dead hanging between two buildings from a rope. CID assess that the killing seems symbolic and a reminder of something which happened in the past and even more bizarre as they find out that the victim has a fear of heights.

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 1
episodes.overview: A man falls from a building in front of many people. The CID find out that the man died due to a gunshot but there is no gunshot on the body. A jewellers bill is found from his pocket that leads them further into their investigation.

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 2
episodes.overview: A dead body falls down from the building. Upon investigation, CID finds two more dead bodies on the terrace of the same building who have been shot by the same bullet. Who killed them and why?

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Bullet Part 3
episodes.overview: A girl is shot at point-blank range by her cousin and the murder is witnessed by her housemaid and society members. For CID, it looks like an open and shut case until the autopsy and forensic analysis proved otherwise.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Tarika
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe receives a jar of blue bottle flies at his house and he is alarmed that something awry is about to happen. His suspicions prove true when Dr. Tarika goes missing from the forensic lab.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat Part 1
episodes.overview: Raja is killed in the makeup room of a dance bar. A bar dancer named Julie witnesses this and informs CID. CID is in in a fix as they do not find any bullet inside the body. Episode continues to C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat (2012).

episodes.name: C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat Part 2
episodes.overview: Continuing from C.I.D. Viruddh Adaalat (2012), the DCP has been given a life sentence but CID finds the DCP's driver's dead body in the warehouse along with RDX that can prove DCP not guilty.

episodes.name: Khoon Khabri Ka
episodes.overview: CID's informants are getting killed one by one and no one knows the reason why and a rift takes place between Daya and Abhijeet. Will they solve their issues and catch the culprit?

episodes.name: Gayab Pati Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Asha escapes from Ambulance seeking for CID's help. Later she faints outside in the bureau. CID are finding out about a missing man named Rajesh. In the hospital, Asha reveals to Abhijeet that her husband Jagdish is kidnapped.

episodes.name: Raaz Qatil Auzar Ka
episodes.overview: CID are informed about mysterious deaths on a highway near a wildlife sanctuary. On reaching there, they find 3 dead bodies: 2 have been killed with a mysterious weapon, while the 3rd has died of poisoning.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein C.I.D. Officer Part 1
episodes.overview: A heating argument takes place in a disco. Next morning, a kid finds some blood on the road and the CID are called in. They find a hair attached to the skin near the blood and an empty bottle of alcohol lying on the road.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein C.I.D. Officer Part 2
episodes.overview: Further investigation leads CID to a local booze shop where they find the same cheap brand bottles like the one found earlier. They show Sanjana's photo and booze shop owner stuns cops by telling that she didn't come to buy the booze.

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Laash Ka
episodes.overview: Shilpa notices drops of blood falling on the window glass. Before she can think any further, suddenly a body appears hanging upside down outside the window. She asks for help but when the neighbours arrive, there is nobody to be found.

episodes.name: Khooni Raksha Bandhan
episodes.overview: As Rakhi celebrations are going on in Raja's sprawling mansion, the family hears a shriek of Raja's daughter Deepika. As everyone rushes to the first-floor bedroom they find Deepika lying dead.

episodes.name: Raaz 14 Saal Ke Qaidi Ka
episodes.overview: Dev, a prime suspect in the murder of his wife Priya had disappeared since then. However, he resurfaces in the city again and CID nabs him. They get to know that Dev was held captive for 14 years and he has no idea who kidnapped him.

episodes.name: Raaz Kidnapped Birthday Girl Ka
episodes.overview: Two masked men barge inside a restaurant and kidnap Saloni who was celebrating her birthday with her friends. Cops find a dead body of a girl wearing the same dress Saloni was wearing in her party.

episodes.name: Aakhri Saboot
episodes.overview: A group of youngsters loitering on a seashore find a bottle with a blood-stained note inside. They call the CID. For the cops, it's a rather twisted case as all they have is a blood-stained note from the sea.

episodes.name: Freddy Ki Biwi Ek Khooni?
episodes.overview: A woman is murdered in the parking lot near her office. As CID investigate, it turns out that the victim is Freddy's wife's boss. Freddy's wife also goes missing and the CID think that she has run away because she's guilty.

episodes.name: Raaz Laal Raincoat Wali Ladki Ka
episodes.overview: A superstar dies on the day of his film's premiere in front of his fans. CID, after looking at the footage, spot a girl in a red raincoat reaching close to him to his shock. CID nab her but realize that she's not the killer, then who?

episodes.name: Target 15 August
episodes.overview: A journalist comes to CID and informs them that he's got a call from an unknown source warning him about an impending danger to the city on Independence Day.

episodes.name: Raaz Dulhan Ke Khoon Ka
episodes.overview: One of the brides at the mass wedding ceremony suddenly dies on the spot.

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Hotel
episodes.overview: Shreya is asked for help by a hotel employee while she's having dinner. She and Purvi go to meet the person in an isolated place but suddenly Purvi goes missing and there's blood near the site where Purvi was last seen.

episodes.name: Raaz Khooni Pati Ka
episodes.overview: Pramila is stabbed to death despite being under tight security. To the utter shock of the CID, her husband Maanik takes complete responsibility of the same but the autopsy report reveals something else. Who is he trying to protect?

episodes.name: Giraftaar C.I.D. Officer Vineet
episodes.overview: During a raid on the drug dealers, the CID is shocked to find Vineet at the spot with a bag full of drugs but he denies his involvement. To make matters worse, a syringe with his bloodstains and drug is also found from his house.

episodes.name: Gunehgaar C.I.D. Officer Rajat
episodes.overview: A couple of dead bodies are found floating in a well with a chemical in it. Later, Abhijeet and Daya investigate and are stunned to see a huge quantity of blood in a house nearby, a girl's dead body and Rajat himself colored in blood.

episodes.name: Bhootiya Haveli
episodes.overview: The film unit had come to shoot for their film, Raaz 3, in a supposedly haunted mansion. In the opening shot, the camera rolls and Bipasha opens a cupboard. To the horror of the crew, one of the crew members' dead body tumbles out.

episodes.name: Dulhan Pe Shraap
episodes.overview: In a cursed village where the brides get killed just when they're about to get married, the Sarpanch comes to the CID for his daughter's protection. Even before they reach there, she's killed.

episodes.name: Ice Pick Killer
episodes.overview: 2 young women are killed in a similar manner with ice picks drawn through their throats. The initial investigation leads the CID to think about a serial killer as they're an exact replication of the murders done by a psycho years ago.

episodes.name: Rahasya Bacchi Ka
episodes.overview: A watchman discovers a young girl hanging from a balcony in a flat. Cops rescue her but find Raj and Manisha killed in the same flat. Clues lead to Raju, but the girl remains the suspect. CID must uncover the truth about her involvement.

episodes.name: Nakli Chehra
episodes.overview: Arnab is murdered during his wife's birthday party. CID investigates, leading to Shiela, who Arnab was fighting with over the phone. They eventually find her dead and realize they are dealing with a con artist using multiple identities.

episodes.name: Heroine Ko Khatra
episodes.overview: Kareena gets a bomb threat from an obsessed fan. He wants her to come to him otherwise he will kill her on the day of the release of her movie Heroine. CID gets into the case and finds the dead body of Kareena's bodyguard.

episodes.name: Rahasya Locked Room Murder Ka
episodes.overview: Three contestants prepare for Miss Popularity finale when Shivangi, a contestant, is found dead in her room. Cops uncover a drug-laced iPod and new angles to the murder mystery.

episodes.name: Raaz 2 'O Clock Murders Ka
episodes.overview: Prateek and Minaali move to Mumbai, where Minaali dies in a bomb blast. CID discovers a trap for Natasha and Mahant, and police witness Natasha's death. CID seeks killer and motive.

episodes.name: Gaddar
episodes.overview: Jeevan, a gangster breaks out of jail at midnight, 3 days before he was set to be acquitted. CID are baffled on why would a man commit a crime which would put him behind bars for life?

episodes.name: Khooni Drugs
episodes.overview: CID discovers blood splatter on building terrace and suspects injury. They search apartment buildings and find a similar splatter in Vishal and Rahul's house. A forensic analysis reveals violent coughing.

episodes.name: Room No. 303
episodes.overview: Maaya reports her daughter Lakshita's death from a haunted balcony in Kothgarh. The CID team, disguised as locals, investigate under fake identities. Daya, who allegedly took the haunted balcony, faces the risk of his life.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Inteqaam Part 1
episodes.overview: A witness is to be brought to court who's going to give his testimony against a terrorist and keeping his family safe. An elaborate plan is devised, but they're still attacked. The witness's daughter is taken leaving Abhijeet injured.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Inteqaam Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet survives the attack. The hearing is postponed. The witness's daughter is kidnapped and he and his family are threatened that she will die if he gives his testimony. He still goes ahead and the terrorist is sentenced to death.

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Footprint
episodes.overview: A group of trekkers find a dead body with a huge footprint on it. CID arrive to investigate and find another dead body in the same way. In a village close by, people complain of a strange creature roaming around in the village.

episodes.name: Maut Jalne Se Ya Jal Se
episodes.overview: CID are meeting an informer, when a fire breaks out in a nearby bungalow. They rush to help and find a man's dead body but are able to rescue a girl trapped inside a cupboard. However, the autopsy reveals that the man died by drowning.

episodes.name: Laash No. 47
episodes.overview: Two wardboys are startled to find a dead body of a prisoner Munna missing, The CID find out that he accidentally died in prison due to a heart attack. But just then, a murder takes place. Is Munna back from the dead, taking his revenge?

episodes.name: Bank Locker Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Purvi and Shreya are at a bank. Suddenly, 5 robbers enter taking everyone hostage. They loot the bank and leave with the two. The CID manage to save them, but the robbers die when their van explodes. However, the case takes a strange turn.

episodes.name: Raaz Daya Ke Doston Ki Maut Ka
episodes.overview: Two of Daya's friends are found dead in an unusual condition, with their bodies sitting upright with no sign of external injuries. The CID realize that the killer is stalking Daya. Will CID be able to save rest of Daya's friends?

episodes.name: Zehreele Fruits
episodes.overview: What appears to be an innocent case of a food allergy escalates when nine people perish from food poisoning at a party, showing the same symptoms. CID delves into the case, uncovering mass poisoning as the root cause of the deaths.

episodes.name: Raaz Breaking News Ka
episodes.overview: A notorious criminal, Raghu is planning a ransom exchange for a hostage. CID apprehends him and rescue the captive. During interrogation, an unexpected accident leads to Raghu's death. ACP, suspecting foul play, suspends Daya and Abhijeet.

episodes.name: Anokha Khooni Shadyantra
episodes.overview: Rajeev complains to the CID that someone came in his room to kill him while he was sleeping, but his wife says no one came as she was with him. As cops are guarding at night, Rajeev gets killed. Will the CID find this invisible killer?

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ki Deewani
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets a phone call from a woman for help. He rushes there but he finds her dead. Suddenly, someone knocks him out. When he awakens, he finds himself tied up, where his captor, Roshni, tells him that she's madly in love with him.

episodes.name: Baby Kidnapping Ka Mayajaal
episodes.overview: A child gets kidnapped from a hospital by an unknown lady. CID are able to identify her using the CCTV footage and get to know that she's not a known criminal, but a victim of domestic violence and she seems to know the child's father.

episodes.name: Red Suitcase Murder Part 1
episodes.overview: The pieces of bodies of several police officers begin to be found across the city in big red suitcases. This is the work of a serial killer, sending a message getting his revenge on the police.

episodes.name: Red Suitcase Murder Part 2
episodes.overview: CID team up with the fearless Inspector Shekhawat, digging into cases that he has worked on in the past involving similar serial killings. They realize that the person behind this may be caught by the Inspector a few years ago.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Painting
episodes.overview: A painting exhibition is being held at a farmhouse by 2 business partners, Sumit and Vimal. Things turn sour when a guest finds blood on one of the paintings. Forensic analysis reveals that somebody made the entire painting with blood.

episodes.name: Chocolate Murder
episodes.overview: A young couple find a woman's dead body covered in chocolate. CID discover that she was drowned in a chocolate tub. Using forensic evidence, they trace the chocolate to the factory where it was manufactured.

episodes.name: Filmy Murder
episodes.overview: Vicky, the son of a film star Mukul, in the twilight of his career is found dead at the Mahurat party of his debut film. It seems like a suicide as the weapon is found in the victim's hand. But CID find out that Vicky was in fact murdered.

episodes.name: Raaz Jali Laash Ka
episodes.overview: A newly married couple are mysteriously burned alive in their home. What seems like an accident is revealed to be a murder by CID's investigation; a murder committed by carrying out an intricate plan.

episodes.name: Khooni Kitaab Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: An author is at the release of his new book, reading out a passage in which a character is murdered. Suddenly, the lights are turned off. When they come back on, the publisher of the book lies dead, killed in the same way as in the book.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Ki Kidnapping
episodes.overview: Abhijeet, Sachin, Vineet and Daya wake up in a closed room and realize that they have been kidnapped. Back at the bureau, the ACP receives a CD from the kidnapper, showing him the situation his team are in.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman saves a newly married woman running away from a group of men carrying swords and takes her to her home. However, she refuses his help. The next day, he's shocked to find that she doesn't live where she told him she did.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 2
episodes.overview: When the woman dies because of ACP Pradyuman's mistake, he resigns out of guilt. The CID protest, but he sticks by his decision. 2 new cases arrive: A bride murdering her groom and running away and a newly married woman going missing.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman joins a marriage bureau for an undercover investigation that could solve the mystery of Jasmine's case. Meanwhile, the CID get a tip off on Amar and Priya's location, that could help them save Sanya.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Par Grahan Part 4
episodes.overview: DCP Chitrole breaks the news to the CID that ACP Pradyuman is working at the same marriage bureau where illegal activities were an under handed affair. Shocked, they confront the ACP and he reveals what happened when Jasmine was killed.

episodes.name: Anjaan Laash
episodes.overview: A man gets killed in a flat in the middle of the night, but the strange part is that no one knew about the murder. Only when the family members get up in the morning, they come to know about the murder.

episodes.name: Bhoot Ka Khel
episodes.overview: After a gun fight Daya and Abhijeet manage to save ACP Pradyuman. Though in a terrible state, he manages to provide some info. Abhijeet reaches the place where Mahesh had committed the crime, while Nikhil and Fredricks have their own plan.

episodes.name: Khooni Kitaab
episodes.overview: A woman trying to steal a book from a library at night, mysteriously dies. It happens as soon as she opens the book and as a result she bleeds to death. There seems to be another person who witnessed her death and did nothing.

episodes.name: Raaz 5 Looteron Ka
episodes.overview: Five criminals, misunderstanding each other, accidentally shoot each other at each other during a party. The organizers find them dead on the terrace, prompting CID to investigate the cause of the multiple murder.

episodes.name: Heere Ki Chori
episodes.overview: A jewelry store owner is checking a diamond but leaves to spend time with family. While returning to pick up a gift, he finds the guard murdered on the floor and his boss murdered inside his cabin, posing a classic case of jewel theft.

episodes.name: Raaz Ungli Ka
episodes.overview: A woman suddenly receives a package at her door. As she opens it, to her surprise, there's a chopped human finger in it. However, the package was dated two years before its arrival. CID are called in to investigate the matter.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Virus Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: A group of masked men attack a Government Research Centre in search of something unknown. A number of guards lose their lives that night but what they attempted to steal is the mystery. Can the CID get to the bottom of this?

episodes.name: Khatarnak Virus Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: With Daya injured and the criminals on the run, it's a race against time. They figure that the gang attacked them and took the virus. CID find out that there will be an auction for the virus amidst various terrorist organizations.

episodes.name: Dancer Ki Rahasyamayi Maut
episodes.overview: Mohini, a Bharatnatyam dancer, prepares for her first solo performance, but suddenly gets immolated, causing panic among the audience. CID are called in to investigate the incident.

episodes.name: Nakli Chehra: Part 1
episodes.overview: A man named Bakul is found dead in his farmhouse. The witness sees Arnav, his best friend with blood-stained clothes, escaping. However, he proves his innocence. CID get proofs against a woman, but Dr. Salunkhe is convinced it was a man.

episodes.name: Nakli Chehra: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID find out that Rashmi was involved in the killing but they also get know of her split personality disorder. Which explains why, Dr. Salunkhe was insisting that a man had committed the murder.

episodes.name: Sammohan Se Hatya
episodes.overview: Siddhanth and Maamvi, a married couple, are going for a dinner on their wedding anniversary. Siddhanth receives a call from a mysterious number, goes numb, and rams his car into a truck, killing himself and his wife. The CID are puzzled.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: CID get a distress call from a victim. They reach the location and realize that the killer had orchestrated the scene in such a way that such that the cops end up killing the innocent victim unknowingly.

episodes.name: Raaz Haddiyo Ki Crockery Ka
episodes.overview: A couple have lunch in a hotel with everyone around them. Suddenly the wife chokes and dies on the spot. The husband panics and calls CID. Initial assumption seems to be poisoning but a closer look reveals something else.

episodes.name: Mohabbat Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Two skeletons wearing clothes are found hanging from a tree, with a letter threatening their parents to agree to their relationship or else they will meet the same fate. The boy and the girl are missing and in possible danger.

episodes.name: Salunkhe Ki Hatya
episodes.overview: While examining a dead body, Dr. Salunkhe gets injured by a blast from a bomb planted in it.

episodes.name: Maut Ka MMS
episodes.overview: People are being sent scary and terrifying videos through MMS warning them of their impending death. They disregard it but some actually end up dead. The deaths are made to look like accidents, but CID find proof that they were murdered.

episodes.name: Zehreeli Hatya
episodes.overview: A couple gets killed and all their valuables get stolen. CID reach the location and does a thorough scan. Dr. Salunkhe reveals that there was some sort of sedative in the deceaseds' systems.

episodes.name: Car Murder
episodes.overview: A man is shot dead in a moving car, but no one witnesses or hears the gunshot. CID find another dead body in the trunk, and the mystery deepens when the car belongs to a girl named Homika who doesn't know either of the two men.

episodes.name: Khooni Natak
episodes.overview: Maanas, a renowned painter, dreams of two brutal murders by a bride and paints them on canvas. However, these murders come true in a theatre group office where he has had a tiff with the employees and the owners.

episodes.name: Bhootiya Haveli
episodes.overview: Rahul is missing and his wife reaches out to the CID for help. Just as they get a tip and break into an abandoned asylum, they find Rahul's body with his neck twisted behind his body in a bizarre manner.

episodes.name: Lightbox Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Sanjay's dead body is found in his office's lightbox. CID wonder what could be the reason for it to be found there. Sanjay's wife Pooja tells the cops that Sanjay attempted to kill her. Cops find a key of a bank locker in his shoe.

episodes.name: Divider Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: A car is accidentally crashed to a divider revealing a skeleton buried inside it.

episodes.name: Behrupiya Khooni
episodes.overview: Two women kill their husbands on their wedding nights, but the reason is unknown. CID are called in to investigate. Is it a coincidence or a planned murder?

episodes.name: Wax Ka Putla
episodes.overview: Reporter Ronita goes missing while she was on her way towards the Mayors House. Senior Inspector Daya and Purvi spot reporter Ronita's car in the middle of the jungle. One of the employees of a service center Mahesh has yet not returned back to his office. AC…

episodes.name: Maut Ka Safar
episodes.overview: Team CID comes across a strange case where all the passengers who were travelling in the Bus were dead. Fortunately, both the Girls who got inside the Bus mid-way survive. Dr. Salunkhe, Sachin, Freedy, Shreya and Senior Inspector Abhijeet check out the Bus. D…

episodes.name: Main Hoon Qatil
episodes.overview: A woman walks into the CID bureau to surrender herself for the murder of her husband but when CID goes to take custody of the body, the body is missing. Where is the dead body?

episodes.name: Mahabharat: Part 1
episodes.overview: A theatre group perform in every small town in India but there's a strange layer of crime related to them. In whichever town they perform, a wealthy family is killed.

episodes.name: Mahabharat: Part 2
episodes.overview: A theatre group perform in every small town in India but there's a strange layer of crime related to them. In whichever town they perform, a wealthy family is killed.

episodes.name: Shaatir Chor
episodes.overview: The secretary of a businessman is found dead in his own house and his body is found in the locker. A thief named Monty is the main suspect of the case. Will CID catch him?

episodes.name: Talaash
episodes.overview: A young woman, Juhi, goes missing, leading CID to trace her house to an old couple who recognize her as their grandniece. Juhi's trail leads to a motel, while Preeti, also missing, has connections to the same motel.

episodes.name: Jaadui Naqaab
episodes.overview: Rich and wealthy people of the city are invited to a party with a promise of making them richer. At the party, there is a water tank that has a dead body. CID is called in and they find that the water tank has a morgue under it.

episodes.name: Commando
episodes.overview: Purvi goes missing. On her search, the CID enter a jungle and find a man who reveals he's a commando working for the government and that he didn't know that Purvi works for CID. They get together to find her. Will they succeed?

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Daya
episodes.overview: Daya is heavily injured and rendered helpless in the middle of a jungle, with a little girl who he was trying to protect. Will they both escape alive?

episodes.name: Heroine Ka Naqaab
episodes.overview: Famous film star Shanaya's enemy producer Sohan is killed and her fingerprints are found at the crime site. Upon further investigation, it is revealed that Shanaya wasn't present at the crime site, so how can her fingerprints be there?

episodes.name: Jungle Ki Ladki Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A woman is brought to the CID with an engraving on her body as "CID Help". The women doesn't remember anything about herself and also speaks a strange language. This leads the CID to a jungle with a "curse" called "Rain of fire".

episodes.name: Abhijeet Khatre Mein: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is found unconscious on the seashore. He has been shot twice in his back. When he gains consciousness in the hospital, he doesn't recall his identity. He doesn't know who he is and is charged for the murder of an innocent girl.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Khatre Mein: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are shocked to see Abhijeet's involvement in the murder. They're helpless as they have evidence against him recorded in a CD. Abhijeet is still not convinced of the crime and is hiding from the cops. Will CID catch the accused?

episodes.name: Naari Raksha
episodes.overview: A girl seeks help from the CID after she escapes a racket being run by an unknown person in which girls are sold as brides. Will CID deliver justice to these girls?

episodes.name: Naari Par Atyachaar
episodes.overview: A woman who is standing up to empower other women in her village through education gets killed. CID are called in to investigate. Will CID be able to bring justice to her cause?

episodes.name: Atyachaar Ka Badla
episodes.overview: CID deal with a case of domestic violence where a woman is burnt and thrown from her flat window. Will the CID be able to bring justice to her?

episodes.name: Apharan Nanhi Comedian Ka
episodes.overview: Parents of a famous child comedian get a threat call to stop her from performing. They contact CID and Rajat is put to the task of protecting her but things get out of hand when she gets kidnapped and an upset ACP suspends Rajat.

episodes.name: Kidnapper Ka Khel
episodes.overview: The wife of a famous and rich businessman is kidnapped and a ransom of 5 crores is asked. But the ransom demand is a bit strange as the kidnappers have asked the businessman to deliver 5 crores in 5 installments at 5 different locations.

episodes.name: Coffin Box Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Two friends, Arnav and Vansh are shopping in a mall when a woman bumps into Arnav. Arnav helps her get up, but he collapses and dies. When the body is taken back home, the body disappears. CID accuses Vansh of stealing the dead body.

episodes.name: Rahasya Paanch Laashon Ka
episodes.overview: A blind boy is found wandering on the road with bloodstains on his clothes and body. He's traumatized and can't remember what happened to him. CID trace the location where the boy came from and finds 5 friends shot to death in a farmhouse.

episodes.name: Raaz Na Sadne Wali Laash Ka
Rahasya 26 Kankaalon Ka
episodes.overview: A land baron illegally takes over land for a farm resort, but CID discovers 26 human DNAs in the soil. Cops uncover human skeletons and find out about a massive massacre, revealing the land was once a construction site.

episodes.name: Keedey Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A woman's decomposed body, infested with maggots, is found in a jungle, leading to a sensational twist where a killer with a sharp mind is involved.

episodes.name: Kati Ungli Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A finger found in a fish is believed to belong to a young girl with kidney problems. Police search for the girl Kiran but she is dead. However, Dr. Salunkhe shocks the cops by telling the finger belongs to an old man with blood cancer.

episodes.name: Phone Booth Murder
episodes.overview: Raunak, a renowned movie star, dies in a phone booth during filming. CID investigate, suspecting it to be a murder. Forensic results show he was murdered, but no weapon is found.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Zeher
episodes.overview: A distraught mother who reports her son missing for three weeks, suspects an aspiring model named Shaina. The mystery deepens as the CID team delves into the circumstances surrounding the man's disappearance and his connection to her.

episodes.name: Jail Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Two murders occur during an annual day celebration in jail. CID investigate the incident. Despite checking the cell, no clues are found. Forensics reveal the bullet was shot from inside the cell. Everyone wonders how's it possible.

episodes.name: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 1
episodes.overview: Three men, who don't know each other, go missing while river rafting in Rishikesh. Their families complain to the cops. The shop owner of the raft tells the cops that the three had come with a foreigner named Garvin.

episodes.name: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 2
episodes.overview: Cops are stunned when they come to know that DCP Chitrole has called Dhenchu to Rishikesh. There's a gunshot which misses Dhenchu. Cops wonder who wants to kill Dhenchu and start following the leads.

episodes.name: Rishikesh Mein Apradh: Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP and Daya nab one of the suspects of a series of murders as others escape. They find that a guy named Chandan was supposed to meet the group at 5pm to pay them for the job. Meanwhile, a girl collapses which seems to be a case of poison.

episodes.name: Haridwar Mein Khoon: Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP notices a strange man meeting DCP and he recounts that the man is the same one who attacked Dhenchu. Cops get suspicious of DCP and his intentions. On the other hand, cops also discover a dead body in the Haridwar to Mumbai train.

episodes.name: Haridwar Mein Khoon: Part 2
episodes.overview: Dhenchu goes missing. The cops are looking for him at the Chandi Devi Temple entrance when they stumble on to a case of a missing woman. Meanwhile, there is a bomb explosion in the market and cops find evidence linking both the cases.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: DCP Chitrole continues to appear suspicious in his tracking of kidnapped Dhenchu and the lives of the mysterious remaining two men. Cops come to know that DCP has been tracking the secret government agents.

episodes.name: Khooni Daayan
episodes.overview: A group of girls are telling each other ghost stories in their hostel dormitory. The next day, one of the girls disappears from the college. Is it just a coincidence or is the legend of a girl's ghost true?

episodes.name: Neend Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: A housewife wakes up in the morning to find her husband beside her shot dead. Cops feel the wife is the main suspect as the murder weapon has her fingerprints and her blood-soaked nightdress is also found dumped in the washing machine.

episodes.name: Raaz Heroine Ki Maut Ka
episodes.overview: On set, a heroine's car from an action movie goes haywire and explodes, instantly killing her. But how could such a skilled driver make such a grave mistake? Is there any foul play?

episodes.name: Aasmaan Se Giri Laash
episodes.overview: A media event at a hotel is sparked by an upcoming movie's music launch. A celebrity is interviewed when a body falls from the sky onto her car. Initial investigations reveal the body is of the movie's hero. Was it an accident or murder?

episodes.name: Saheli Ke Khoon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Natasha hears Madhu screaming in her room after they come back from the party where she had a fight with her ex-lover. She calls the CID who finds that Madhu has gone missing. Eventually, Madhu's is found dead along with the murder weapon.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Bureau Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: There is a unit training with high-tech weapons. The leader of the unit is Dragon. CID has been after him for a long time. Daya has a personal quest with him as he wants him alive. His friend was once caught up with him.

episodes.name: Jungle Ka Darinda: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called to the jungle by a woman who says she's in danger. They find a group of kids playing paintball and realize it was a hoax call. But they find a dead body of a forest officer seemingly attacked by a wild animal.

episodes.name: Jungle Ka Darinda: Part 2
episodes.overview: Forensic analysis reveals that some sort of chemical has been injected into the victim's body to change their genetic code. Meanwhile, Shreya seems to have gone missing, and the rest of the team go searching for her.

episodes.name: Teen Mujrim
episodes.overview: Sukhi, Manpreet and Mintoo are caught in the middle of a CID case, when they turn up at an MNC where CID are about to capture two infamous con artists named Aryan and Shimona. The MNC owners have been shot dead in their conference room.

episodes.name: Ek Aadmi Teen Haath
episodes.overview: A bag is found under a movie theatre seat by the bomb squad. Inside is a severed human hand, which DNA tests reveal belongs to a famous businessman named Saurabh. Upon checking, Saurabh is found safe with both hands intact.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Nasha
episodes.overview: A TV actress grappling with trauma following her fianceé's demise and persistent stalking takes a drastic step by hiring a killer to end her life. However, her plans take a dark turn when the assassin mistakenly targets her family instead.

episodes.name: Murder In Matheran
episodes.overview: A man whose family is threatened is killed in a Mumbai mall after a confrontation. Most of the family members are either dead or in the hospital except one person: a woman on her honeymoon in Matheran.

episodes.name: A.C.P. In Danger
episodes.overview: During a shootout between CID and a band of criminals, ACP Pradyuman gets shocked after seeing the face of the ringleader. Who was this man? Has he really seen him before?

episodes.name: Bhootiya Colony
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in an abandoned cottage, with a strange symbol in blood near it. CID locate the colony where the man lived to find it abandoned. They find out that all the residents left because of a spirit supposedly killing people.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Telephone: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya, Sachin and Shreya are in the town of Kikkar for a seminar, when one night, all three of them receive calls from a panicked stranger telling them that in the span of the next 24-48 hours, three murders will take place.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Telephone: Part 2
episodes.overview: The three CID officers wake up in an enclosed room and realize they've been kidnapped. They manage to contact the others and guide them to their location using sound clues. But still there's work to be done.

episodes.name: Azaadi Ki Jung
episodes.overview: The CID is called in to an Independence Day function at a jail. They soon find out that an explosive is planted. The explosion takes place, killing several prisoners and injuring even more. The blast also helped 3 prisoners escape.

episodes.name: Sonakshi In Danger
episodes.overview: A film's press conference is happening at a 5-star hotel. While everyone is waiting for Sonakshi Sinha to join, they hear her shriek from her room. Everyone rushes there to find a man lying dead inside, shot.

episodes.name: Raaz Video Game Ka
episodes.overview: A huge horror game contest takes place, and 5 people win prizes. But things turn sour when soon after that, the prize winners start getting killed one by one, seemingly by the fictitious villain of the game they won.

episodes.name: Rakhi Ka Bandhan
episodes.overview: Cops discover a mutilated body in the woods, but DNA evidence suggests a human was responsible. Geeta, the victim's estranged wife, is suspected, but Rajat, Geeta's Rakhi brother, denies her involvement.

episodes.name: Haunted Haveli
episodes.overview: A group of friends go to an old, haunted mansion to make a documentary, when suddenly they realize that one of the friends, Kunal, has gone missing. They search the house and soon find him dead locked inside a room.

episodes.name: Baby In Danger
episodes.overview: CID receive a call about a woman's hit-and-run murder, but the case becomes bizarre when they discover the victim had a baby hidden in a fruit basket near the crime scene.

episodes.name: Junglee Manav
episodes.overview: People in the city are turning into zombie-like creatures after being bitten by infected people. CID discovers a dead infected person's body with traces of an extinct virus, posing a threat.

episodes.name: Shreya Ka Shaitaan
episodes.overview: Shreya's college friend Divya's family has been missing, who Divya says had a tattoo on his hand. CID manage to find the culprit but is found dead. However, they are shocked to find that the culprit was Divya and Shreya's old friend Varun.

episodes.name: Nikhil Ki Jung
episodes.overview: Nikhil needs money for his mother's operation. The amount is too much. An accident takes place in front of Nikhil and Pankaj. They take the injured man to the hospital, but he dies. The man was carrying Rs. 50 lakh that is now missing.

episodes.name: The Mouse Trap: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet turns up at a Basti in the guise of a small-time criminal where he saves a gangster's wife's life and becomes her bodyguard as a part of a plan. A parallel kidnapping of an intelligence officer's son complicates the case further.

episodes.name: The Mouse Trap: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID comes to know that IB officer Milind has to provide some critical info to Billa Dilawar. Hence his son has been kidnapped. The situation worsens when Sonal is forcibly taken away by Billa Dilawar and Abhijeet feels responsible for it.

episodes.name: Forensic Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID team is shutting a double murder case. However, a mystery clue and Dr. Salunkhe's sudden indefinite break, makes the whole investigation and conclusion look botched.

episodes.name: Forensic Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: The substitute forensic doctor Dr. Sameer along with Dr. Tarika's assistance, proves Dr. Salunkhe's forensic report to be fake. Dr. Salunkhe who had been under house arrest until now suddenly goes missing.

episodes.name: Rahasya Dweep: Part 1
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is on the run on an island as he is being chased by local tribesmen shooting arrows past him. Meanwhile, CID is looking out for him as they reach his house and realize that someone has attacked and kidnapped him.

episodes.name: Rahasya Dweep: Part 2
episodes.overview: The team is under attack at the hilltop where the fisherman who guided them gets shot by a burning arrow. The cops run down the hill to take cover where they face a hallucinating mist on the island and see a dreadful mystic animal.

episodes.name: Rahasya Dweep: Part 3
episodes.overview: ACP and team are just outside the bunker as they pick up old rusted rifles to inspect them. They see some intruders but are later reassured that it was just Daya and his team. The team reunite and discuss the mysterious incidents.

episodes.name: Rahasya Dweep: Part 4
episodes.overview: The CID are trapped on the island and in mortal danger. Will they be food for the cannibals or the terrifying monster on the island? And what is the secret of the mysterious mist? Who are the strange men on the island and their plan?

episodes.name: Satara Mein Khoon: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID team come across a stabbed dying man at the Mumbai state border. He tells them about a murder at the Satara waterfall just before his death. Armed with riddling clues and half-baked information, the team arrives at Satara.

episodes.name: Satara Mein Khoon: Part 2
episodes.overview: The key and shoe lead the CID to a wealthy family. They call Madan who has been blackmailing someone for money. The case further gets complicated when a skeleton is discovered at Waada and the family is totally clueless.

episodes.name: Chehre Par Chehra
episodes.overview: Amay sees Avantika, his wife being chased by goons and rushes to inform his friend Kunal but Kunal tells him his wife is at the salon. When Amay sees Avantika at the salon he is shocked. If she's here then who was that woman he had seen?

episodes.name: A.C.P. Murder
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets injured at a friend's son's birthday party, unexpectedly and this coincides with the CID team's hunt for a notorious arms dealer Vidhaan.

episodes.name: Khooni Keeda
episodes.overview: Diwakar, a man having obsessive-compulsive disorder dies while eating food on his dining table. People suspect he died of food poisoning but his wife calls CID because she felt it was impossible for him to die that way.

episodes.name: Bomb Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of friends go for a walk on Marine drive at night. As they walk, they hear a scream and turn their back to find a lady lying on the street screaming in pain. She seems to have been stabbed. CID gets informed.

episodes.name: Kaali Diwali: Part 1
episodes.overview: On Diwali night a man chased by goons gets shot to death. Meanwhile, Dhananjay's family throw a Diwali party. They light up the crackers but everyone faint. CID gets a call that Dhananjay's daughter is missing and they rush to investigate.

episodes.name: Kaali Diwali: Part 2
episodes.overview: Jatin gets killed before he could give any info to the CID. Was he just a pawn in this plan? Why was Ananya kidnapped and why was Bobby working at Dhananjay's factory? How are the two cases connected?

episodes.name: Raaz Boarding School Ka: Part 1
episodes.overview: A hitman is hired to do a job in a boarding school but he dies in an accident. the CID are still worried that whoever hired him will hire someone else for the job which they need to find out. Hence, Daya is sent undercover as a teacher.

episodes.name: Raaz Boarding School Ka: Part 2
episodes.overview: Daya is rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, CID learn that Shekhar ran away from the school during the kidnapping. They follow his trail leading them to a dilapidated bungalow. Daya starts to find out the reason why Rishab was kidnapped.

episodes.name: Daya In Danger: Part 1
episodes.overview: On their way to the bureau, an accident halts the cops' plan. A woman crossing the road with a paper bag suddenly starts suffocating. Daya takes the bag and puts it in his car. The young woman is rushed to the hospital, but she dies.

episodes.name: Daya In Danger: Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID team is shocked and traumatized by Daya's accident even though he survives; he has lost parts of his memory due to trauma. The cops decide to decode the mystery of the dead woman and the mystery of the wooden box.

episodes.name: Singh Saab Ki Jung
episodes.overview: Saranjeet Singh IAS, who is currently incarcerated, calls CID in jail to investigate a case of an old man. CID wonder why he wants them to investigate an accident case. He tells them that he's sure that old man has been killed.

episodes.name: Antariksh Yaan Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of people witness a meteor shower. They rush towards the spot and are surprised to find mangled human remains. Dr. Salunkhe discovers the victim's body fell from a height and resembles that of a 120-year-old man.

episodes.name: Mrut Maa Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Siblings find their dead mother alive in the mall. A shoot-out happens and a security guard dies. CID arrive to investigate. The father and the siblings tell the CID that the mother died in an accident 8 years ago. How is it possible?

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Boogie Woogie
episodes.overview: Ravi enters an abandoned house, wondering why Naved called him for a Boogie Woogie launch. Ravi enters, finds Naved tied to a chair and semi-unconscious. Breaking open the house, he finds the chair empty and Naved nowhere.

episodes.name: Invisible Gun: Part 1
episodes.overview: Moon Space Company plans to send Manish to space and he's undergoing a flying training but accidentally dies. Meanwhile, another man is shot dead while cleaning his own gun. CID are called in to investigate both these murders.

episodes.name: Invisible Gun: Part 2
episodes.overview: Nikhil is put under flying training to see how Manish died. He gets shot but is saved because of the bulletproof jacket. CID investigate the room and find the evidence for Dr. Salunkhe to investigate.

episodes.name: Khooni Stage
episodes.overview: A musician Rocky is killed in a fire during a stage show, and CID are informed. A band member reveals Rocky has been receiving blood-written threats, raising suspicions about the connection to the murder.

episodes.name: Khauffnaak Haveli: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID come to inspect a mansion for a kids function. While playing a game there's a power cut in the and a man is found dead. CID suspect something fishy about the mansion and begin their investigation.

episodes.name: Khauffnaak Haveli: Part 2
episodes.overview: Nikhil and Fredricks are caught in the web of the game and they end up harming people at the mansion. Out of the 13 people, 1 is dead and the other's life is in danger. Will CID find the culprit and get rid of the game?

episodes.name: Zinda Laash
episodes.overview: Dr. Tarika enters the forensic lab but to her surprise, the dead body is missing. She finds Dr. Salunkhe wounded on the floor. Meanwhile, a witness who is supposed to give a statement against Rocky dies mysteriously.

episodes.name: Zehreela Saap
episodes.overview: Shanti Devi is at a press conference with artist Mukesh, where she dies after being poisoned. CID suspect the people who were thrown away from her land. Dr. Salunkhe finds the reason of death of another victim which is connected but how?

episodes.name: ACP Aur Nakul Ka Raaz: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya and Abhijeet are trying to nab a suspected criminal named Nakul who is on the verge of committing suicide. ACP Pradyuman saves him. This does not go well with CID and they question ACP's morals. Why was he trying to save Nakul?

episodes.name: ACP Aur Nakul Ka Raaz: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID has put Nakul under their watch. ACP is not convinced that Nakul is the killer and goes against his team. CID continues their investigation and looks for Karan who can prove to be a valuable asset for the case.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Sangharsh
episodes.overview: CID goes to investigate the murder of a rich businessman named Raj. They interrogate his secretary and staff and find out that he did not have any enemies. The body did not have any mark and hence the reason for death was unknown.

episodes.name: Vichitra Mariz
episodes.overview: Lisa, a foreigner has an accident as soon as she arrives in India, and goes into coma for a long time. She suddenly awakens one day, and starts saying something in Telugu, a language she has absolutely no knowledge of.

episodes.name: Ahmedabad Mein Daya Faraar: Part 1
episodes.overview: Daya is absconding, at the popular Kite Festival in Ahmedabad. The rest of the CID team is frantically trying to chase him down, while the local ACP has even passed shoot-at-sight orders against him.

episodes.name: Ahmedabad Mein Daya Faraar: Part 2
episodes.overview: Shreya gets severely injured and Daya searches for Pakya. ACP Pradyuman tries to collect more information about Sarthak who got shot by Daya. Team CID is shocked as they get to know about 3 innocent People who got killed by Daya.

episodes.name: Khooni Laash
episodes.overview: A group of friends are staying in a hotel. The next day Sagar and Mihir are found dead and their friend Anisha is found on the road. Who killed them and why?

episodes.name: Lift Mein Anhoni
episodes.overview: Purvi is working undercover on a case to nab a gang but is attacked and kidnapped by them. CID is on the hunt for her. Meanwhile, she's stuck in the lift of her building with the kidnapper Makarand and the lift crashes. Will Purvi survive?

episodes.name: Khooni Joker
episodes.overview: A nanny puts a girl to sleep and watches TV. She notices a man dressed in a clown uniform. The joker kills the nanny and escapes. CID arrives at the crime site and investigates the murder. Will they catch the joker?

episodes.name: Khauffnaak Laash
episodes.overview: Mrinal encounters a strange-looking man in a jungle who claims to be a spirit and is looking for his killer. He asks him for help but he runs for his life and dies. CID arrives at the crime site and finds only half the body of Mrinal.

episodes.name: Chudail Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Two women enter Dhruv's house but get hit on the head and they find themselves stranded at a deserted place. Meanwhile, one of them named Shikha is dead with strange marks on her neck. How did she die?

episodes.name: Khooni Makdi
episodes.overview: A woman in a mall is killed by a spider and another man Siddharth is scared of a spider wanting to take his life. CID are informed about this. Will they solve the mystery?

episodes.name: Raaz Horror House Ka
episodes.overview: Pratik, a boy gets kidnapped from the Horror House in an amusement park. There's no ransom call and the CID investigate the kidnapping. They find another decomposed dead body in a lake. While investigating, they uncover a sinister plot.

episodes.name: Paudhe Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: CID are baffled at a murder where there are no witnesses, and all clues lead to dead ends till they come across a witness. A plant who witnessed the murder. Is it possible for the plant to identify the killer? Can the plant talk?

episodes.name: Shark Attack
episodes.overview: Two unnatural shark attacks on two men have made the CID to investigate this case as an engineered shark attack. They soon find out that both the victims were connected to each other. Will CID find the culprit behind this?

episodes.name: Piranha Fish Attack
episodes.overview: Param, a swimmer meets an ugly end at the hands of a mysterious water carnivore that almost tears his body apart. Meanwhile, a similar attack happens on a photographer in another lake. Forensics reveal that they were preys of Piranhas.

episodes.name: Mumbaicha Dabbawala
episodes.overview: A battered wife decides to put an end to her misery once and for all. On the very same day, her husband dies of poisoning. The obvious suspect is the wife, who used to have his lunch delivered to him everyday.

episodes.name: Naari Suraksha
episodes.overview: Team CID come across yet another strange case of Kashish, an NGO worker who was found dead in Shyam Nagar's sky walk located in Mumbai. Fredericks is shocked to see Kashish as her face was covered with coins.

episodes.name: Mission Mumbai: Part 1
episodes.overview: A man gets uneasy and faints in the middle of a busy marketplace. When another man tries to revive him, he finds the letters 'CID' written on his chest in blood. Who could have done this to him?

episodes.name: Mission Mumbai: Part 2
episodes.overview: Animal's viruses are found in Human Body. Team CID tries to collect more information about the virus from Dr. Sankalp but he suffers from massive heart attack. Abhijeet, Daya and Nikhil try to solve the puzzle located near Asiatic Library.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Holi Dhamaka
