episodes.overview: Dhenchu gets to know about a contract killer Anil who has planned to kill Abhijeet in a Holi party. He tries to escape when comes to know that Dhenchu knows their plan. Dhenchu succeeds in informing Daya and he searches for Dhenchu.

episodes.name: Diamond Robbery
episodes.overview: A family gets together at their mansion, where they're entertained by Sunny Leone. Their patriarch will announce that he'll be distributing his wealth among some members of the family. Later however, he is found dead in his chambers.

episodes.name: Raaz Kanheri Caves Ka
episodes.overview: CID is up to nab a tourist guide who is upto some illegal activities. They don't find the guide, instead, they stumble upon a dead body of another man.

episodes.name: Mumbai Ki Chawl Ka Rahasya: Part 1
episodes.overview: One by one, several residents of a chawl are disappearing overnight. Their neighbours realize that they do not even have any relatives left to visit, and that a similar incident had taken place at a neighbouring chawl as well.

episodes.name: Mumbai Ki Chawl Ka Rahasya: Part 2
episodes.overview: The investigation of people going missing from their respective chawls continues. The CID are searching for Sangeeta and Nalini's killer all over the city and also visit Ambawadi chawl to collect more information about Ketan.

episodes.name: Bus Hijack: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID are called on a case of bank robbery with all employees drugged and customers locked in the vault. They investigate the case and find out that the robber's getaway vehicle was towed and that is why they hijacked a BEST bus.

episodes.name: Bus Hijack: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID manage to track the bus down and ask the robbers to give up. In retaliation they throw the conductor out of the bus right in the way of the jeep of the cops.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 1
episodes.overview: CID had planted 10-12 undercover cops to infiltrate the underworld but they're getting killed one by one. ACP sends Abhijeet to pick up one of them but gets kidnapped. He wakes up the next morning lying on the road with a memory lapse.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops find the identity of the two victims. They're underworld goons. As cops follow the trail they make a startling discovery. The goons themselves were undercover cops working for ACP.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 3
episodes.overview: Based on inputs given by a doctor who had operated on Daya, CID trace the location only to find that he's been shifted to a new hideout. Forensics also find out that that the bullet in Daya's body was fired from Abhijeet's gun.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 4
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is trying to prove his innocence. He reaches the location where he and Daya were drugged and held captive only to be arrested and brought back to the bureau. The cops get a phone call from Daya saying that ACP shot him.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 5
episodes.overview: CID are stunned to hear that ACP shot Daya and before DCP could confront ACP, he runs away to save the remaining agents. But ACP gets shocked when they're not ready to come out because they claim that the DCP sold the list of their names.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Giraftaar: Part 6
episodes.overview: Goons attack ACP, Daya and Abhijeet and try to kill them. They fight back defeating the goons. Now cops plan their fake death which makes Don to come out of his hiding. The Don celebrates his win by throwing a party.

episodes.name: Khooni Taxi
episodes.overview: People are disappearing and dying mysteriously on a stretch of a road. The locals report the sighting of a haunted taxi which is being driven without a driver that seemingly disappears without a trace.

episodes.name: Choro Ka Khooni Kaun?
episodes.overview: Two masked thieves rob a bank and escape in their car. Somebody notices the number and calls the CID who now give them a chase. During the chase, the thieves loose control and dash against a tree and are found dead.

episodes.name: Box Mein Hatya
episodes.overview: In a resort, while taking a steam box, Rachit is killed. Cops come to the crime scene and they find that the entire body except the head is missing. It is discovered that the body has been melted with the help of a newly invented acid.

episodes.name: Jurm Ki Aag
episodes.overview: A big-time criminal is kept in the ICU on grounds of ill health and placed under high security. City cops are trying to collect evidence against him. As the doctor enters the room for the checkup he is shocked to see the body on fire.

episodes.name: Khatarnaak Keeda
episodes.overview: People are dying without any injury marks. The victims were sleeping when they were killed. CID are unable to find any lead. Forensic reveal that there's some kind of chemical being used to kill the victims without any external wounds.

episodes.name: Gumshuda Parivar
episodes.overview: Juhi's family had gone missing ten years back. Investigation revealed nothing and the case was closed. Now all of a sudden, she discovers her father's hat which she had not seen for ten years.

episodes.name: Khooni Chaku
episodes.overview: Jasmine gets kidnapped in the midst of her wedding anniversary party. She wakes up in a deserted farmhouse where she is shocked at the sight of blood-stained knives and many dead bodies.

episodes.name: Fridge Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Shishir, a meditation guru, is found mysteriously dead in a fridge on display in a crowded mall following a 2-minute power outage.

episodes.name: Anu Malik Par Hamla
episodes.overview: An arrogant stuntman invites Anu Malik to witness him doing a big dangerous stunt so that he can appear on TV. However, he mysteriously goes missing during the stunt and Anu Malik is the main witness.

episodes.name: Khooni Doll
episodes.overview: A woman is found murdered in her house. The only person present at the home was her daughter playing with her toys in another room. As CID investigate, they realize that there was a doll in the house, which has now gone missing.

episodes.name: Khooni Sapne
episodes.overview: A girl in a college hostel suffers from nightmares in which she feels as though someone is trying to kill her. Soon, she is murdered in the same manner as in her dreams.

episodes.name: Sabooto Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A notorious terrorist sends CID an evidence bag containing a severed finger, a blooded knife, a handwritten letter in Russian, a child's photograph and a windchime. He challenges the CID to find a crime scene using them.

episodes.name: Painting Ki Chori: Part 1
episodes.overview: People have gathered at a hotel for an art exhibition held by Raj. Soon, Raj reveals that he's going to propose to his girlfriend. But as he's about to, a group of armed masked men break into the hotel and steal all the paintings.

episodes.name: Painting Ki Chori: Part 2
episodes.overview: On the trail of the gang of art thieves, CID are also trying to find out about a mysterious assassin, 'X'. Who was his intended target? They also find out about Viren's murder and realize that he was X's high-profile target all along.

episodes.name: Copy Cat Serial Killer
episodes.overview: Famous authors in the city are found murdered in very unusual crime scenes. CID figure out that the murders are done by the same person, a serial killer. CID learn that there were similar crimes around 5 years ago by another serial killer.

episodes.name: Rahasya Chamatkari Talab Ka
episodes.overview: A group of teenagers are camping in the woods, when one of them wanders off and never returns. CID are called to investigate and find that several people have gone missing in these woods over the years in precisely the same way.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 1
episodes.overview: A bomb explodes at a function. The CID are shocked to find out that Shreya, a young deaf and dumb girl who is Abhijeet's friend, is involved. It's revealed that she's been forced to commit these crimes and kill 3 targets.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 2
episodes.overview: Abhijeet manages to track Shreya and arrest her after her second attack but then he and she both disappear. He doesn't arrest her and bring her to the bureau. Upset, CID track him, but he allows her to escape before he gets shot by Daya.

episodes.name: Trishakti: Part 1
episodes.overview: A fight is going on in a local bar when a man named Tez suddenly enters and murders everyone present. When CID check the CCTV footage, they realize that Tez is extraordinarily fast, almost superhuman.

episodes.name: Trishakti: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID are now after two culprits. Their investigation reveals a hidden document in one of them: Tez's hideout, which leads them to his childhood village.

episodes.name: Trishakti: Part 3
episodes.overview: CID now encounter a third culprit, Meera who escapes right in front of the cops. CID seem to have uncovered multiple individuals with 'superpowers'. Who is behind this conspiracy?

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Magician Ka
episodes.overview: Ajinkya, a debt-ridden magician, organizes a magic festival, requiring him to disappear in a car's boot and walk through the audience. But he disappears. Soon, blood is found in the car, but there still is no sign of Ajinkya.

episodes.name: Raaz Magic Trick Murders Ka
episodes.overview: KC a well-known magician, is conducting a three night show in which he shows never-seen-before acts. The first night as he shows a 'water tank act' in front of millions, a woman is killed in exact same manner on the other side of the city.

episodes.name: Jadoo Punar Janam Ka
episodes.overview: Tillotma is a woman who claims to be able to send people to their past lives. She sends one such person, named Aakash, but things turn sour when she's unable to bring him back. His wife Natasha approaches CID for help.

episodes.name: Masoom Dost: Part 1
episodes.overview: Niharika, a billionaire's daughter comes to Mumbai with her fiancée Ketan for a business trip. During the trip, she gets shot and injured at by snipers while at an inauguration. Her advisor dies in the attack. CID are called onto the case.

episodes.name: Masoom Dost: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID search for the ACP but to no avail. Meanwhile, Niharika is once again attacked. They begin to explore the possibility of Saker and Mita being involved in this, when they stumble upon evidence suggesting that Ketan might be the culprit.

episodes.name: Raaz 3 Bullets Ka
episodes.overview: A man has been shot while in a moving vehicle on a busy road. Upon investigation it's found that 3 bullets were fired at him, out of which one killed him.

episodes.name: Ek Villain
episodes.overview: Shraddha Kapoor and Sidharth Malhotra are driving to their film's press meet when they hear a child's scream. When Sidharth goes to investigate, he finds a gang of masked men taking a group of children somewhere.

episodes.name: Shahi Talwar Ki Chori
episodes.overview: A young boy goes missing from his house. CID investigate and find out that he had overheard a plot to steal a royal sword from a museum. They go to the museum to find the sword already stolen. But it reveals the theft was a diversion.

episodes.name: Khooni Khel
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's friend calls him over for a dinner party at his home. At the party, while playing some games, one of the guests dies. The CID arrive with DCP Chitrole. To their dismay, all of the evidence points to the ACP.

episodes.name: Raaz Kate Haath Ka
episodes.overview: The CID are having a picnic with some underprivileged orphans. But 2 of the kids, Tara and Chintu go missing. Shreya begins to search for them and comes across goons taking them into the jungle. She attempts to fight them but they escape.

episodes.name: Mahasangam: Part 1
episodes.overview: Dayaben finds the ACP's wallet and brings it to the CID bureau. It turns out that it's fake. The person carrying the wallet has been killed. CID suspects that someone is masquerading as the ACP with his face by plastic surgery.

episodes.name: Mahasangam: Part 2
episodes.overview: A couple return home and are shocked to find blood on their children's beds, with them missing along with an unknown woman's dead body. Meanwhile, Jethalal's photo has been found in a man's home, pinned to a wall with darts pinned into it.

episodes.name: Zehreelay Bichhoo
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets bitten by a scorpion, but his life is saved in time. Soon, when three bodies are found killed by the same kind of scorpion poison, it is revealed through forensic analysis that it is not a natural scorpion bite.

episodes.name: Mahasangam: Part 3
episodes.overview: A woman's ghost is picking random people and killing them after cutting one of their body parts. CID is skeptical about the idea of a ghost. Is it a serial killer? Or some personal vendetta?

episodes.name: Mahasangam: Part 4
episodes.overview: Tarot Card Reader Vishakha Sulekha had predicted Soham's death. Soham gets murdered by a football player. Bhide reveals a shocking truth to Abhijeet. Vishakha Sulekha also gets killed and Amya is also found dead in her house.

episodes.name: Bandh Kamre Mein Laash
episodes.overview: One of the most wanted thieves, Takiya well-known for opening any safe in the world, gets murdered while opening one of the lockers kept in the room which was closed and had no ventilation of air.

episodes.name: Raaz Sudden Attack Ka
episodes.overview: Paranormalist Aliya gets murdered in a mansion where a hotel was supposed to get constructed. CID investigates and questions her group who were keeping an eye on her movements on camera. Dr. Salunkhe reveals about a sudden heart attack.

episodes.name: Rahasya Serial Killer Ka
episodes.overview: Just when Daya was about to express his feelings to Shreya, he gets a call and rushes to the spot where a murder had occurred in the house. On the other side, a couple Prashant and Prema were attacked by a serial killer.

episodes.name: Raaz Jungle Ke Bhoot Ka
episodes.overview: 3 brothers of an influential industrialist go missing from a hiking trip. Just when the CID are thinking it as a normal trek-disappearance the tour guide of is mysteriously killed. Cops understand that the disappearance is well-planned.

episodes.name: Salman Ki Kick: Part 1
episodes.overview: Anna attacks the cops but disappears into the darkness when confronted by Abhijeet and Daya. However they manage to recover the ghost Anna's lantern. Salman Khan and his team are at a resort for promoting his film Kick.

episodes.name: Salman Ki Kick: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops discover that Koena is none other than Anna as they confront her. However, she tells them how she was forced by her husband Ashok to do everything.

episodes.name: Raaz Bus Ke Qatilon Ka
episodes.overview: A journalist Arnab, boards the 'BEST' bus to his office. On the bus, he has a small altercation with another passenger, soon he flies into a rage and he strangles the passenger and jumps out. He falls and collides with another truck.

episodes.name: Glass Room Murder
episodes.overview: The CID are called to solve a crime in an impossible situation. A man Ankush is shot in his cabin with his whole staff outside and not one of them being aware of this crime. The killer escapes without being noticed or even stopped.

episodes.name: Gayab Biwi Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Rahul is working at his home, right when a doorbell rings and a cook is saying he was appointed by his wife Namrata. After an hour another doorbell rings and a woman enters the house claiming to be Namrata but according to Rahul she isn't.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 1
episodes.overview: Corruption charges are levied against DCP Chitrole and DCP Singham has come to handle the case as it deals with black money. DCP Singham enters the CID bureau to get to the bottom of this case with the help of CID.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 2
episodes.overview: DCP Singham and CID cops manage to fight their way out of the trap and find that DCP Chitrole was framed to take the blame. He was innocent and DCP Singham and the CID team trap the real money launderer.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Singham: Part 3
episodes.overview: Further investigation reveals that DCP Chitrole sold CID's plan to Marco. The cops go with the flow to foil their own murder plan, arrest Marco, and the resort owner Anwesha who tried to kill cops due to personal revenge.

episodes.name: Azaadi Ki Jung: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID gets info on a plan for a terrorist attack on the Independence Day Parade in Mumbai. They investigate and are shocked to find out that this person carrying the info isn't aware and is about to board a train to Delhi.

episodes.name: Azaadi Ki Jung: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID's mission continues. They're unaware that the terrorists have also sent their team on the train to get rid of this person and destroy the evidence as it could hamper their plan.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 1
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets a call from Bunty's hostel that he's been behaving strange from past few days. He reaches there and speaks to Bunty who tells him that the problem is not with him but his roommate Rahul.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP promises Rahul that he will find out what happened to his father Vishal. Bunty is relieved. However, Bunty's life also comes in danger's shadow as a few people turn up at the bureau and the hostel claiming to be his distant relatives.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom: Part 3
episodes.overview: CID succeed in arresting the Bunty and Rahul's kidnappers. Shreya shares her problem with Abhijeet. Bunty reveals a shocking truth to ACP Pradyuman in the bureau. Will Daya be able to express his feelings to Shreya?

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Bachpan
episodes.overview: A man collapses and dies in the middle of a crowded street. CID arrives and finds that the man was behaving strangely shortly before his death and was constantly mumbling a set of numbers. What do these numbers mean and how did he die?

episodes.name: Khatre Mein A.C.P.
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman is on the edge of a building as he is asked by the mysterious stranger to jump, or else innocents will lose lives.

episodes.name: Daya Bana Dulhan
episodes.overview: Murders are happening at the wedding. As cops investigate, they find out a shocking history of the village which connects the killer and these brides.

episodes.name: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 1
episodes.overview: A woman gets kidnapped in the middle of a crowd during Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations.

episodes.name: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 2
episodes.overview: The CID are puzzled about how did the culprit take the victim through such a huge crowd. There are other people who have also got kidnapped. Who is the kidnapper and what does he want from CID?

episodes.name: Ganesh Utsav Mein Apaharan: Part 3
episodes.overview: Just then CID starts receiving calls about random people disappearing suddenly from the city. There seems to be no connection between them but about a hundred have gone missing without a trail.

episodes.name: Bipasha Par Hamla
episodes.overview: Bipasha is doing her regular workout in the gym, when a goon attacks her but somehow she manages to dutch him and then complains to CID. They come across a murder which is connected with Bipasha.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Video
episodes.overview: People in the city are dying under strange circumstances. The cops find out that each of them committed suicide in a certain manner. All of them had received a mysterious video some time back from a loved one who had died recently.

episodes.name: Kankaal Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A group of excited youngsters from the nearby neighborhood decide to dig up the fortune/treasure, and when they do so, they are in for a shock. They find five skeletons embedded in earth to form 5 alphabets that read as a word together.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Kabaddi
episodes.overview: Vishal dies in the middle of a Kabaddi tournament. His friend Deepali confesses that she gave his contract to a contract killer. The opposite team players are suspects but Dr. Salunkhe has some shocking revelations about the death.

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Maut
episodes.overview: Shreya finds out that a bomb was planted in the locker to kill Vishal. Abhijeet suspects an inside job. The CID catch the killer in an interesting way by taking part in the kabaddi tournament opposite to killer's team.

episodes.name: 40 Crore Ki Chori
episodes.overview: 40 crores have been shifted to the main headquarters of a bank for transfer tomorrow. The manager goes to his cabin to complete the formalities and back to check the vault. To his shock the vault's monitor shows that it's completely empty.

episodes.name: Naari Shakti: Part 1
episodes.overview: Shreya, Purvi and Dr. Tarika are attending a charity function. There, they meet a social worker Saakshi Kumar. After the function, she gets a fit. Her PA and her bodyguards control her and tell them that she's a patient.

episodes.name: Naari Shakti: Part 2
episodes.overview: Keerti's husband is involved in child trafficking and Keerti discovered this about him. Meanwhile, Saakshi is missing and CID is on the lookout. Saakshi was given medicines so that she could never be in her senses.

episodes.name: Shreya Ki Sagai
episodes.overview: On the engagement day of Shreya, her fiancée Siddharth goes missing and a dead body is found in his room. CID gets on the case to find him and the kidnapper and for that Daya has to do a task which is not simple. What is the task?

episodes.name: Ichcha Purti Haveli: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhishta arrives in Chanda's mansion to make a wish of coming first in the exams as she wants to defeat her competitor. Abhishta gets terrified there. Will Chanda make her wish come true? How will CID solve this horrifying case?

episodes.name: Ichcha Purti Haveli: Part 2
episodes.overview: In a desperation to top in the exams, Abhishta falls in a stairwell trap where she asks a wish after reaching at a particular step. She finds her competitor dead, but the CID find no such staircase in that house.

episodes.name: Barf Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is blinded and in action he has heard 1 bullet, but the dead body has 2 bullets. How will he do the autopsy in this blind state? How will he help the cops solve the mystery?

episodes.name: Zehreela Baal
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe finds a clump of hair in the dead body which contains traces of poison but the hair doesn't belong to the victim. Why was he killed? How will Dr. Salunkhe solve the case with just a help of hair?

episodes.name: Gunaah Ki Seedi
episodes.overview: Some kids have been kidnapped. Cops don't have any clue of the kidnapper and also come across a murder. In forensic, Dr. Salunkhe has only a ladder brought by the kidnappers to kidnap the kid.

episodes.name: Zehreela Dawa
episodes.overview: A leading dentist of the city is found guilty of murder when all he had done was prepared customized dentures for his client. Is the poison in the dentures? How will Dr. Salunkhe track the killer by the dentures?

episodes.name: Haddi Mein Code
episodes.overview: A video is sent for Dr. Salunkhe showing a few people in black plastic hoodies, blowing up a car and shouting Dr. Salunkhe's name. How is this related to Dr. Salunkhe?

episodes.name: Samundar Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe gets a driftwood with bullet in skull. He finds a derivation of various coloured sea salts and its similarity with the deposits on the skull make the cops investigate to find the source of the skull.

episodes.name: Naakun Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A finger is the only clue that Dr. Salunkhe has of the victim to find the killer. What are the secrets that the nail holds? It is an impossible case as the cops are searching in the dark for the killer.

episodes.name: Daya V/S Daya
episodes.overview: Daya wakes up in the woods, remembering a night before. Villain Daya calls to save ACP and Abhijit, and Daya sends the CID team to find and help them.

episodes.name: 10:45 Murder
episodes.overview: A joker predicts his death at 10.45, causing chaos in an operating theater. After ten minutes, he dies simultaneously, prompting CID to investigate the bizarre case of a man predicting his own death.

episodes.name: Khoon Ka Badla
episodes.overview: A get-together ends with the host dead and friends Mohit and Ganesh unconscious. Police investigate, discovering Ganesh's cryptic conversation and his escape. Mohit is found hanging from a fan, but Dr. Salunkhe reveals it's a murder.

episodes.name: Phone Booth Murders
episodes.overview: Two women are murdered by a mystery killer, while Roy and Jiyaa stop at a phone-booth. Roy calls a man who claims to know the killer, leading to his girlfriend's murder. CID investigate all three murders, but the call was made to a motel.

episodes.name: Khooni Bag
episodes.overview: Pritika behaves strangely with her friends and is stubborn on leaving for home even though her friends insist her to stay. When she catches a rickshaw to go home, it already has a woman sitting inside. The woman tells Pritika that she should have given everyt…

episodes.name: Shikaari Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Vipul, stressed, locks his wife Kiran in a room after hearing a doorbell ring. He receives a gun and and a phone call. The man asks Vipul to shoot a man in a red cap. Hesitantly, he shoots but a woman comes in between and gets shot.

episodes.name: Masoom Baby Ka Rahasya
episodes.overview: A thief steals a baby girl, and her parents are found murdered. Cops find a baby boy in the house, who doesn't match the dead couple's profile. The case raises questions about kidnapping or other factors.

episodes.name: Kyun Maalik Bana Chor?
episodes.overview: A man runs into a mall to save his life from a woman who tries to shoot him. He was carrying some rare paintings. The next day, Dhanraj, is found dead in his living room, in the guise of a thief with the robbery of the SAME paintings.

episodes.name: Bai Ka Sangharsh
episodes.overview: Shanti, a maid is trying to help Veronica, a victim of domestic violence. Veronica's husband Tarun realized that Shanti is danger to him and gets her arrested in a robbery case, but Veronica saved her. Eventually, Shanti is found murdered.

episodes.name: Faisal Par Humla
episodes.overview: Faisal is the top contender and star of a dance show. However, a lot of tension and ego battles are going on. Eventually, all the 3 judges are found dead. Faisal disappears and comes back. He doesn't react much to the news of the deaths.

episodes.name: Pied Piper
episodes.overview: A number of robberies are taking place in the city and cops are surprised to find the culprits to be kids around ten years of age. A Pied Piper kind of a character is kidnapping children and using them to commit crimes.

episodes.name: Brave Kids
episodes.overview: School kids playing cricket in the playground discover that terrorists have entered the premises and are holding teachers and kids as hostages. They manage to hide but get stuck in different rooms. They decide to call CID for help but how?

episodes.name: Happy Ending
episodes.overview: Armaan and Yudi are discussing a script when Yudi notices that a young chap poisons a middle-aged person by putting some drops in his juice. The twist in the tale comes when forensics finds out that the man didn't die due to poisoning.

episodes.name: Mumbai Chawl
episodes.overview: Vijay comes across a dying man Deepu who hands him a bag. His killers are after him and Vijay escapes. CID investigating Deepu's murder find out that he returned from Dubai. The killers realize that Vijay has the bag. What's in the bag?

episodes.name: Chawl Mein Murder
episodes.overview: Vinay and Kishore shoo away a man for assaulting Sheetal. She attempts suicide but fails. Next morning, Vinay is found dead in a tank.

episodes.name: Bandh Kamre Mein Laash
episodes.overview: Manish, a rich businessman checks in a 5-star hotel. Gunshots are heard and when CID arrive at the crime scene they find him dead. CID find out that the 3 adjacent rooms to Manish are all booked under false names as well as that of Manish.

episodes.name: Mahabali Shera Ki Dahaad
episodes.overview: Shera, a wrestler has come to meet his childhood friend Suraj. He had called him for some urgent work. But Suraj suddenly suffers from brain hemorrhage and dies. Shera insists to the CID that it's a murder.

episodes.name: Kulhaadi Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A female thief breaks into a couple's bungalow, causing blood to flow from a table. The wife finds an antique axe inside, but the couple feign ignorance, fearing the cops will uncover hidden secrets buried in the axe.

episodes.name: Action Jackson
episodes.overview: Sameer is at his wedding reception where Ajay Devgn is a guest. He spots his parents and gets very upset about it. Meanwhile, the bride goes missing and CID encounters a new CID officer named Jaywanti hired by DCP Chitrole.

episodes.name: Double Murder Ki Saazish
episodes.overview: Mansha is stalked by an unknown man, who shoots her dead after she leaves the mall. CID investigates the relationship between the killer and the woman.

episodes.name: Bomb Blast
episodes.overview: A car blast takes place on a deserted road and CID find 3 dead bodies. They realize that there were 3 more people at the blast site. Where are they? Why did they flee the scene without informing the cops?

episodes.name: Sar Kata Manav
episodes.overview: Ravi, while returning from a party with his family faint when he witnesses the bizarre sight of a headless biker on the highway. When he comes around, his family goes missing. He calls his friend Abhijeet for help.

episodes.name: Haunted Haveli
episodes.overview: Three girls go to a mansion that is considered haunted by the people of the colony. The owner Suraj is called from America and he decides to sell it of but before he could do so, the broker goes missing after visiting the mansion.

episodes.name: Bhootiya Boat
episodes.overview: Three friends are on a boat in the middle of the sea when they spot another boat where a girl is shot dead. An unknown man appears from the water and the three friends go missing. Will CID find them?

episodes.name: Chain Chor
episodes.overview: A 50-year-old widow who lives alone in a rented flat in a Mumbai suburban society-building is known for her fearlessness. She gets attacked by 2 men in the temple. CID are called in to investigate and a blind beggar becomes a witness.

episodes.name: Microwave Gun
episodes.overview: During a wedding anniversary party, Bunty gives food to his grandparents and gets into an argument with his mother. Meanwhile, Rakesh falls into the pool and dies. How could he die of drowning?

episodes.name: Christmas Party
episodes.overview: During a Christmas party, a man disguised as Santa enters and the host's daughter goes missing. Upon finding out they find the host's secretary dead, the CID believe the Santa to be the suspect.

episodes.name: Sher Ka Shikaar
episodes.overview: Three children get separated from the rest during a school picnic in a conundrum caused by a tiger in the forest. On investigation, C.I.D comes across an ex-forest inspector who had lost his mental stability and was off the grid for a couple of years. He info…

episodes.name: Nakul Returns: Part 1
episodes.overview: The city is under a terrorist attack as reported by Interpol and there is chaos in the CID bureau. The prime suspect is ACP's son Nakul who he shot 8 years ago.

episodes.name: Nakul Returns: Part 2
episodes.overview: A couple in a beach find a coat. They check the coat and finds a wallet inside it. He is shocked to see ACP Pradyuman's ID card in the wallet. Is ACP Pradyuman alright?

episodes.name: Happy New Year
episodes.overview: Ambika is embroiled in a drug deal and after escaping crossfire gets murdered in a storehouse. CID soon realize that it's not about Ambika or drugs, but a harbinger to a crime that is about to take place in the orphanage on New Year's Eve.

episodes.name: Lift Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: A very vexing case has come to the attention of the C.I.D. A wealthy businessman died in an elevator in a luxrious hotel. The elevator was ascending, when it started to malfunction, and by the time the security opened the doors of the elevator, the man inside…

episodes.name: Auto Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Hemant and Mona are the landlords of Reema and her daughters, Anu and Era. Reema's husband and Anu and Era's father is found dead in their own home by two unknown people. Things get worse when Anu, disguised as a taxi driver, goes after the ones who killed he…

episodes.name: 3 Bullet
episodes.overview: Ajit's stepmother, Kamini, is ill treated by him, so she decides to get him killed. Kamini hires Ronny, a college student, and gets a bomb fixed in his brain. Ajit kidnaps Ronny and shoots at him, but he survives the shot. Devastated, Ajit then pushes him ont…

episodes.name: Bhootiya Mehmaan
episodes.overview: A solitary owner of a supposedly haunted house, Tarun, is found dead in the morning after his family hires a servant the night before and the rest go missing along with the servant. On investigation, C.I.D. finds traces of blood on the floor which has surreal…

episodes.name: Theatre Mein Bhoot
episodes.overview: A group of actors are doing a routine rehearsal, when they come across a strange woman dressed in red. The woman appears to be a ghost, exhibiting a few supernatural powers, and promises that all of them will die. Eventully they discover the corpse of Pooja.…

episodes.name: C.I.D. Ka Sankatkaal: Part 1
episodes.overview: The confines of the submarine held a lot of marine engineers in captive. After the killing and abduction of marine engineers, the C.I.D comes into action but their strive to locate the submarine and the criminals are all in vain. A.C.P. Pradyuman devices a pl…

episodes.name: Desh Ke Dushman
episodes.overview: When the whole country is celebrating Republic Day, a pack of terrorist captures a mall arena and all the citizens present in it, in demand to release a deadly terrorist. Elsewhere a school bus is being seized by other brothers of the same terrorist gang, kid…

episodes.name: Daya Khatre Mein
episodes.overview: While helping a poverty-stricken family, Inspector Daya gets into trouble as the cash, he donates for the well-being of the family are fake. It turns out that Daya had borrowed the money from his friend Vijay, but when Daya along with his senior inspector vis…

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Milly Aur Tina
episodes.overview: When a housewife commits suicide, ACP Pradyuman guesses right away that it is a pre-planned cold-blooded murder and later Dr Tarika's autopsy report states the same. The CID team then sets out to investigate further into the matter which leads them to the dis…

episodes.name: White Mask
episodes.overview: Rakesh and Nirmalya, with a noble thought of re-establishing a 10-year-old orphanage, visits India. Soon they spot the age old orphanage to be haunted. The story takes an unusual turn when their son disappears during a masquerade event leaving behind a pair o…

episodes.name: Shera Ki Dosti
episodes.overview: The sudden entry of a wild tiger in a city locality becomes terrifying for the society. As death starts knocking the door of one house after the other, the situation turns intense when a small boy named Tinku goes missing. CID takes charge of the investigatio…

episodes.name: Shark Ka Hamla
episodes.overview: A treacherous friend Raunak invites his newly married friend Preet and his wife for a mid-sea boat ride only to get Preet killed by the sharks. Two years later when a fatal incident occurs at the same place while shark viewing supervised by a tourism company,…

episodes.name: Varun Dhawan Khatre Mein: Part 1
episodes.overview: Varun Dhawan gets attacked by a strange-looking creature at the promotional event of one of his films. Varun saves his team but is taken away by the creature.

episodes.name: Varun Dhawan Khatre Mein: Part 2
episodes.overview: Varun Dhawan manages to escape from captivity by fighting off the goons, and rushes to CID, to try and help them with the case.

episodes.name: Fashion Show Mein Murder
episodes.overview: CID team come across a strange murder case which is linked to a fashion show and its models. The episode begins with a model, Meher, committing suicide from a roof top leaving a clue about a 'Shapit dress' and information about another model Juhi, whose life…

episodes.name: Jaadui Kalabaazi
episodes.overview: The episode begins with a magician entertaining the guests with his magic at the birthday party by floating a man, Pritam in the air. Later, the magician dies because of a heart attack leaving Pritam in the air. Soon, Pritam's dead body is recovered by the CI…

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Jaadugar
episodes.overview: A famous child magician goes missing during his act, and instead of him; his father's dead body appears onstage. The secret behind the trick was only known to the father and his child, hence nobody knows how the father ended up onstage.

episodes.name: Naqaab
episodes.overview: Two friends Mayank and Vishal meet a strange girl who commits suicide from a roof top of a deserted construction site. The duo meet the same girl alive next morning when they go to meet Vishal's to be bride, Shruti. Vishal's mother ignores Vishal and get him…

episodes.name: Beherupiye Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: On his way to meet Abhijeet, Daya helps an injured man and admits him in a hospital who later goes missing from the hospital. Daya meets the same injured man at an inauguration ceremony and on interrogating he claims to be a completely different person named…

episodes.name: Gaayab Jaadugar
episodes.overview: It's strange to hear that a dead man comes alive again. This is what happens in this case where a magician loses his life while performing his best magic trick. The magician vanishes and appears from all three sides but his dead body is found on the fourth si…

episodes.name: Prithviraj Chauhan Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: The episode begins with a play where Sanyukta's 'swayamvar' is organised. Suddenly a strange man comes in the place of actor Sameer as a Prithviraj and stabs a man playing Jaychand and elopes with a girl playing Sanyukta and claims to be the real Prithviraj C…

episodes.name: Dance C.I.D. Dance
episodes.overview: CID team gets their next assignment at the Sheesh Mahal where they enrol themselves as participants for a dance competition with other three groups. One of the participants named Era was haunted earlier and later goes missing from the venue without leaving an…

episodes.name: C.I.D. V/S Super Villain
episodes.overview: The episode takes us to the movie premier of Super hero No.1 where a superhero dummy murders the movie director and elopes from the eyes of all the guests and media. CID team arrives at the crime location and begin their investigation, but couldn't get any le…

episodes.name: Adhrushya Manav
episodes.overview: A group of friends are interrupted by a strange, and rashly driven car. When they proceed to confront the driver, they encounter a hooded man, who gently smiles, and then vanishes into thin air. Within a short duration, they see the car again, and this time,…

episodes.name: Khatarnak Bikers: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sheena pays a visit to the racing track and is terrified to see Gulando's racing skills. She storms off, when he doesn't pay heed to her advice of slowing down. She then encounters a racer on her way, who chases her with a gun, and falls down, when she tries…

episodes.name: Khatarnak Bikers: Part 2
episodes.overview: A group of bikers use their biking skills, to try and pull off the biggest heist of their lives. They intend to complete 'Mission ABG' on the 21st of March, but soon find themselves being chased by the CID. The CID are on their way to arrest Gulando, the lead…

episodes.name: Khooni Jungle
episodes.overview: A family's peaceful lunch is disturbed, when a severed hand falls out of the air, and lands in one of the plates. Terrified, they report it to the CID, who start investigating the initials 'R.V.' inscribed on it. Meanwhile, a lot of people are reported missin…

episodes.name: C.I.D. Ki Daud
episodes.overview: The CID group finally decide to take a break, and go on a trip to Goa, when they notice a small girl, who is badly injured. Upon further investigation, they discover a letter buried in the girl's pocket, which leads to details of the whereabouts of her father…

episodes.name: Ali Ki Khalbali: Part 1
episodes.overview: Actor Ali Asgar is horrified, when he sees a dead body in a matrimonial costume, lying in his car. Clearly terrified and indecisive, he drives the body back to the shooting spot, but is unable to get his mind off it. He even dreams of Daya slapping him for gi…

episodes.name: Byomkesh Bakshi Ki Talaash
episodes.overview: In Mumbai, a woman is stalked by strangers and on her birthday party night, the stalker, Naina and her husband are killed. And in Bengal, an elderly man who is waiting for his nephew Byomkesh Bakshi dies seemingly by heart attack.

episodes.name: D.C.P. Chitrole Ki Shaadi
episodes.overview: CID is transferring a big criminal from Mumbai to Delhi but they get embroiled in a murder and suspended. Meanwhile DCP Chitrole has been meeting a beautiful young woman Vishakha. He shocks the cops by announcing he's marrying her.

episodes.name: Jaanbaaz Mr. X
episodes.overview: Marco, an illusion artist tells everyone that he will jump and swim in the pool, and he will reappear at the top of the terrace to prove TELEPORTATION as a fact. As Marco dives, he disappears. Marco falls off the building and he dies.

episodes.name: C.I.D. In Train: Part 1
episodes.overview: During a gang shootout, a goon survives and escapes as something explodes. Dr. Salunkhe finds a train ticket from the dead man's pockets which leads CID to go to the platform in disguise. They find out that a drug deal was on the books.

episodes.name: C.I.D. In Train: Part 2
episodes.overview: A drug deal on the train journey from Mumbai to Goa. But they don't know who the criminals are and where and when the drugs would be exchanged. Is it only a drug deal or is it something more?

episodes.name: Telekinesis
episodes.overview: Amyra has a fight with one of her colleagues Meera when a chandelier mysteriously almost comes crashing down on her. That night, her roommate sees Amyra being flung towards the ceiling from her window.

episodes.name: Khatre Mein Masoom
episodes.overview: Sr. Inspector Abhijeet finds a young boy named Sunny in a forest whose parents are missing after a tragic car accident. Sunny also describes about a mysterious woman with a knife who tried to stab him earlier in his house. There are many unanswered questions…

episodes.name: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sanjana disappears mysteriously and the last person she contacted was her boss. When CID reach the spot, they're told that she never worked there, and no one recognizes her. They find a secret access card to a vault on the 13th floor.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 2
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe manages to save Daya after the building collapsed. Abhijeet, Daya, Sachin and Purvi have suffered various injuries but insist on staying in the field. They find a dead body inside the vault and an entrance to a long tunnel.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Chakravyuh: Part 3
episodes.overview: Sanjana managed to escape but her brother has been captured and she's asked to hand over a briefcase because of which she was kidnapped. Abhijeet and Daya break open the briefcase to find a photo of a man who had come for a competition.

episodes.name: Maut Ki Baarish
episodes.overview: During an event, a white cloud forms out of nowhere and it rains fire raindrops on people melting them to death. CID realize that it's a planned acid rain attack using the technique of cloud seeding. Will they find the culprit?

episodes.name: A.C.P. In Hospital
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman gets admitted for a minor operation and the attending nurse Gayatri disappears. He begins to look for her and stumbles upon the dead bodies of Gayatri and Dr. Sameer. Daya and Abhijeet discover an organ trade racket.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Daraar: Part 1
episodes.overview: A robbery has taken place in a Jewelry Shop and a man is found dead. DCP Chitrole has divided the CID into teams telling them to solve the case differently. Amidst the investigation, DCP also tries to create difficulty for them.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Mein Daraar: Part 2
episodes.overview: Priya, who shot the DCP is caught and she confesses to stealing the diamonds. Further investigation shows the real culprits responsible for the robbery. Did DCP survive the gun shot? Will the CID be able to recover the stolen diamonds?

episodes.name: Khauffnaak Apradh
episodes.overview: Rekha has returned back home from her business trip. She was very excited and wanted to surprise her father Deen Dayal. However, Rekha has arrived few days earlier than her scheduled business trip itinerary. She went on searching for her father but he was not…

episodes.name: C.I.D. In Delhi
episodes.overview: Sonali and Kundan get attacked in Haus Khas in Delhi by a group of goons. They kill Kundan but Sonali manages to escape and boards a train to Mumbai. CID find out about it when the train reaches Mumbai and the girl is found dead.

episodes.name: C.I.D. In Agra
episodes.overview: CID get an info that a contract killer named Keshav, living in Agra, has a new target, but they don't know who the target is. When the cops catch him, he informs them that he has passed the contract to another killer, Ravi who is murdered.

episodes.name: C.I.D. In Mathura
episodes.overview: A kid asks CID for help and informs them that his parents Ajay and Natasha are missing in Mathura and they could be in trouble. When they reach Mathura, they find out that Natasha and Ajay are searching for Natasha's parents.

episodes.name: Hostel Mein Ragging
episodes.overview: A young boy dressed in a woman's clothes is found hanged in the college. CID find out that he was brutally ragged before he killed himself. They interrogate everyone behind the ragging, but is ragging really the reason behind his death?

episodes.name: Daya Abhijeet Ki Dosti
episodes.overview: 3 dead bodies are found tied down in a jute sack. It is revealed that all 3 of them were partying in the same club the night they were killed. When the CID interrogate everyone from the club, they find out that Daya too was present there.

episodes.name: Hawai Jahaz Par Maut Ka Keher
Behrupiya Biwi
episodes.overview: While Karan is on-stage during a press conference, a woman named Radhika meets him and claims to be his first wife, though Karan does not recognize her. Later, Karan's second wife, Anita, is found dead.

episodes.name: Khalnayak
episodes.overview: Kushal saved an unknown girl who later turns out to be one of his friend's girlfriend, Roshani. Kushal's friend and Roshani's boyfriend, Sid, planned a way to defame Kushal and made Roshani a part of it. Later Roshani is killed.

episodes.name: Lift To Death
episodes.overview: A residential building's lift gets stuck. A boy and a gravely injured man with a gun are trapped in it. CID manage to save the boy, but the lift plummets to the ground. The boy tells CID that the man said someone will die tonight at 10 pm.

episodes.name: Jhagdalu Aurat
episodes.overview: Shobha lives in an apartment with her family. Her bad temperament has stained her family's name and people of her society despised her. One day Shobha is found dead in her house. Who killed Shobha? Was the family involved?

episodes.name: Coffin Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Kilori lives with her husband Vikram. She finds out that her ex-husband Jagan, who was living in London with their 3 children was dead. The children were flying the body back to India, but only the coffin arrived. Where are the children?

episodes.name: Samundar Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Sunil was assigned to kill a woman named Ankita while she was partying on a boat in the sea. However, he missed and hit Ankita's husband. Moreover, when CID nabbed him, they were shocked to know that he was forced to do it. Who forced him?

episodes.name: Forensic Clue
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in a car belonging to Harish. CID questions him regarding the body but he repeatedly pleads that he is innocent. Meanwhile, Dr. Salunkhe is trying to unveil this murder mystery with the help of his forensic expertise.

episodes.name: Hotel Red Star
episodes.overview: Shera, a criminal was on the verge of revealing dark secrets about the underworld and details about an attack plan. On the day of revelation, Shera feels an intense pain in his head and collapses. Who could be behind Shera's death?

episodes.name: Ek Anokha Qatil
episodes.overview: A friendly picnic turns deadly when one of the friends Naman is found dead in the vicinity of the farmhouse. The CID find out that he was heinously attacked by poisonous bees which resulted in his death.

episodes.name: Chamakta Kankaal
episodes.overview: Anurag and a young girl meet in a restaurant and exchange a package and a brief case. After leaving, he was on his way to execute the deal but he meets with an accident midway while driving. Anurag's wife suspects it to be a murder.

episodes.name: Ghayal
episodes.overview: The CID find Akhil injured at his own house. Before dying, he takes the name Ajay Mehra. Ajay Mehra is protecting a girl named Malini who's being chased by Akhil's killers. Why do they want Malini's bag? Which code is in Akhil's house?

episodes.name: Dongara Ki Wapsi
episodes.overview: A business tycoon in London receives a call from a private number that his wife's life is at stake. He rushes but gets killed in a car explosion. Back in India, a famous actress's husband gets murdered outside an airport.

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: An old enemy of CID Harpes Dongara comes back. On the other hand, the CID team gets strict orders to solve any case within 24 hours. Will CID catch Harpes again?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe is dying because of some contagious viral infection. He gets infected through a dead body in which some chemical tubes are implanted.

episodes.name: Khooni Haveli
episodes.overview: Princess Ashima returns to her ancestral property to turn it into a heritage hotel. However to her shock, she is told that the mansion is cursed. In between, everything goes for a toss for the cops when Katori Damta shoots himself in jail.

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A man named Ravi's dead body is found hanging in the air, in a container yard tied with heart-shaped balloons. Moreover, team CID has come to know about the love triangle. Could this be one of the possible motives behind the murder?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A drug smuggling racket is busted. The smugglers have abducted a young boy named Ashu and murdered Meena. Ashu's sister Aanya had a map which was hidden in her teddy. Will CID save Ashu?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: An apparition of a Rani tries to scare everybody. As the story unfolds, the valuable necklace of the Rani is stolen. Meanwhile, recurring murders intrigue the interest. CID digs deeper into the investigation. Will they catch the culprit?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Daya and Abhijeet are accused of theft. They are on a run to save their lives and seek refuge at a couple's house. Meanwhile, a local goon who has hijacked a bus blackmails the duo in return of a box they had stolen.

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A couple requests a man to let their child go but is soon shot at. The child of the couple agrees to kill a CID Inspector. After Daya is attacked, he loses his memory and the CID gets concerned about it. Will Daya get his memory back?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A man is stabbed to death by a sharp knife. However, Team CID has reached the spot and they have started investigating the case by considering it to be their top priority. Will they find the killer?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: Firgun Darchi, a sculptor had been handed Nebratamba for safe-keeping. Katori sends his man Vicky to look for it but Firgun fights them and makes them into love statues. Meanwhile, Ninja warriors attack the studio and Vicky gets killed.

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A group of friends enter a restricted area where they're attacked. They somehow escape. Meanwhile, CID is investigating the precious thing that Katori wants and as soon as they open it the entire room gets filled with a white light.

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A young woman named Ayesha is murdered after she is approached by a man in a restaurant where she was impatiently waiting for someone. CID is called in to investigate and find the murderer of Ayesha. Will they find him?

episodes.name: Karo Ya Maro
episodes.overview: A fake princess Tilottama reports that her niece Ayesha has been killed. However, after thorough investigation CID gets to know that Ayesha was trapped by Dolly. Moreover, it is revealed that Katori and Tilottama work for each other.

episodes.name: Khufia Gang
episodes.overview: A dead body is found in a jungle. The dead body had a secret mark on his arm. Natasha and his Fiancée Vishal both are the witnesses of the case and also the target of Chaku Daku Gang.

episodes.name: Bahadur Bacche
episodes.overview: Two school children are abducted by miscreants but with their valour, they manage to escape the trap and inform CID about this who then begin their investigation to nab the culprits.

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Aurat
episodes.overview: Vikram is followed to his building by one of his neighbours and he doesn't look normal at all. Within moments, he reaches the top and jumps. When the CID investigate, they come to know about the mysterious woman who foretold his death.

episodes.name: Rahasya 150 Saal Purani Kitaab Ka
episodes.overview: Fishermen find an unconscious man on a boat, who tells them someone has been behind his life since winning the Diary of a Spanish Ship Captain. CID are called to solve the mystery.

episodes.name: Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: Four youths make a master plan to rob a bank after getting inspired after watching a movie. The robbers has held the employees captive and looted the bank. They have also fired a bullet on a woman, who is an employee of the bank.

episodes.name: Dream Murder
episodes.overview: A writer dreams regularly in his sleep about a girl getting killed while partying in a pub. Mentally disturbed, his friends suggest him to go to Goa to relax. To his horror, there he spots the same waiter and the girl who he dreamt of.

episodes.name: Thak Thak Gang
episodes.overview: Ajay gets shot dead in his own automobile in broad daylight. Team CID discovers that Ajay may have been fatally shot at close range. Daya is informed by Jyoti that Ajay has pledged to wed her. Unexpectedly, ACP Pradyuman now believes Jyoti was responsible for…

episodes.name: Raaz Anjaan Bacche Ka
episodes.overview: Manju, a maid at Vishal's house, becomes suspicious after seeing a boy in his house. She and her colleagues investigate, finding the boy in a pool of blood, leading the CID to suspect Vishal being involved in child trafficking.

episodes.name: Raaz Apaharan Ki Saazish Ka
episodes.overview: Surekha kidnaps Muskan to steal money from her husband, but the CID discovers her husband's extra-marital affair, leaving Muskan missing. The CID must find her.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Jungle
episodes.overview: The CID are called to investigate a murder case involving a group of friends, Sameer and Vanshika, who accidentally lost their way in the jungle and found a charred human arm.

episodes.name: Daya Ka Ateet
episodes.overview: CID investigate Kavita's death, finding a letter on her body. They find Daya, who doesn't recognize colleagues, and question his identity and the murderer of Kavita.

episodes.name: Raaz Bandh Kamre Mein Khoon Ka
Tohfa
episodes.overview: Anita asks Gaurav to hand over a parcel to Niyati. She and Gaurav get shocked to see a human hand in it. CID reach her house after hearing of her death. Gaurav tells them a demon has killed her. They find out that she's Shamsher's sister.

episodes.name: Kanchola Ka Darr
episodes.overview: Shivani and Vansh, a young couple adopt an orphan named Abeer. One day, Abeer goes missing. Shivani requests team CID to find him. However, they find Vansh, dead. They're soon contacted by an unknown person who demands a ransom for Abeer.

episodes.name: Wapsi
episodes.overview: Siddhant's three friends get murdered while jogging in a garden. Forensic analysis reveals that they were killed by arrows. CID meet Siddhant's new neighbour Rupa, who informs them that her husband had brought a box of arrows.

episodes.name: Raaz Khopdi Ka
episodes.overview: Kanika, Sheena and Mehek meet with an accident while travelling in a car. Mehek rushes to a nearby post office to ask for help, but instead gets shocked to see a lone human skull. Who does the skull belong to and why was it there?

episodes.name: Rahasya Adrushya Khooni Ka
episodes.overview: Alok dies mysteriously in his house. CID are surprised to discover that he was allegedly killed by an 'invisible person'. They rush to Karjat, to Alok's farmhouse but only find another dead body there. Who is behind these strange murders?

episodes.name: Dulhan
episodes.overview: Sushila finds a mysterious woman dressed up like a bride walking in her house and calls for help. Avinash rushes to the scene, revealing that the woman is his wife, Rashmi. Soon, Sushila finds Avinash's dead body outside of her house.

episodes.name: Do Masoom Shikaar
episodes.overview: Anjali is found dead inside her house. Sudha informs the CID that she had kept 2 newborn babies in Abhijeet's car. Daya and his colleague find the car in a jungle. Abhijeet saves the babies from a few goons.

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Beti
episodes.overview: Bhushan and his relatives gather in a farmhouse for Himani's death anniversary. They get shocked to see her alive assumes her to be a look-alike of his daughter.

episodes.name: Laash Mein Hathyar
episodes.overview: Tina shouts at her husband Danny's funeral and tells everyone that he was not a good man and had an affair with his secretary. Suddenly the dead body in the coffin starts moving. How is it moving and, who did this to him?

episodes.name: Muqabla
episodes.overview: Anshul and his friends prepare for a swimming competition. A villager finds Anshul's dead body floating in a pond. Team CID finds out that Anshul had jumped into the pond in search of diamonds.

episodes.name: Raaz Adrishya Padosi Ka
episodes.overview: Three men, Amar, Ruhan and Sanjay's dead bodies are found in an apartment, next to a woman named Kinjal, who is sitting beside them with an iron rod in her hand. CID learn that Kinjal suffers from split personality disorder.

episodes.name: Cop Ya Qatil?
episodes.overview: Team CID suspects Abhijeet in Ghanashyam's shooting death, citing past threats. Despite claiming innocence, ACP Pradyuman must uncover the truth to prove Abhijeet's innocence.

episodes.name: Sahi Timing
episodes.overview: CID catch a gang of robbers who kill with iron rods and interrogate them. They insist that someone else killed two of the people they've been accused of killing. Forensic analysis reveals that someone else is trying to copy the gang.

episodes.name: Happy New Year
episodes.overview: The CID team come to a New Year's Eve party. DJ Dash suffers a heart attack in the party. CID find a pen drive while investigating. They listen to a phone conversation recorded in the pen drive which leads to a startling revelation.

episodes.name: Kaanch Ke Paar
episodes.overview: Nirjar is an overbearing businessman. When his servant Monu breaks an expensive glass by mistake, Nirjar insults him. Nirjar suddenly gets murdered by wounds on his neck. Nirjar's family blames Monu for Nirjar's death.

episodes.name: Bhavishyavani
episodes.overview: A famous astrologer Bhanukar is found dead in his office. The CID learn that Bhanukar used to predict accurate future for his clients. Bhanukar's colleagues inform that a client called Bindu was present at the time of his death.

episodes.name: Statue
episodes.overview: A chef collapses to his death during shooting for a 'mannequin challenge' in the restaurant.

episodes.name: Rahasyamay Aatmahatya
episodes.overview: Viraj is a social activist who is under constant threat of being killed by his enemies. A couple watch him jumping off a bridge into a river. They assume that it's a suicide. However, CID somehow find out that Viraj has been murdered.

episodes.name: Band Aankhen
episodes.overview: Rohit invites his girlfriend Megha to his bungalow. Next morning CID find Megha's dead body near Varun's construction site. They investigate and learn that Varun is Rohit's close friend. Rohit clears it to CID that he has not killed Megha.

episodes.name: Raaz Nakli Pistol Aur Asli Goli Ka
episodes.overview: Kyra is a famous actress who is in a mall for the inauguration of a shop. An anonymous person guns down Kyra in the mall. CID learn that Kyra was killed by a ghost gun.

episodes.name: Khooni Courier
episodes.overview: Monika receives a courier from an anonymous person. When her husband comes home, he gets shocked to see her lying dead in the living room.

episodes.name: Maut Ki Dastak
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman's friend Kunal is a crime journalist. One day, Kunal falls unconscious in a hospital. The ACP learns that a martial arts practitioner had secretly injured Kunal in the past.

episodes.name: Apradh Ki Awaaz
episodes.overview: CID find Rajiv's dead body in his house. Rajiv's wife tells them that Rajiv had suspected paranormal activities in his apartment. Rajiv's neighbours inform the CID that Rajiv had seen Lallan's ghost in his house.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Muqabla
episodes.overview: Akash invites Daya to play football with his friends. Akash's opponent Dino dies after a brawl with Daya on the field. Dino's sister blames Daya for Dino's death.

episodes.name: Filmy Murder
episodes.overview: Director duo Abbas-Mustan host premiere of their new movie 'Machine' in a theatre. While screening of the movie, a person called Ayan gets murdered inside the theatre hall.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Video
episodes.overview: Dhiraj is a famous social media enthusiast. An anonymous person kills him in front of camera and broadcasts the video on his social media account.

episodes.name: Vasiyat Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: A rich businessman dies under mysterious circumstances. CID learn that he had feared that he might get killed by his family members for his property. Will CID be able to prove it as murder by investigating his ashes?

episodes.name: Jungle Ka Kehar
episodes.overview: Senior forest officer Kartik allegedly gets killed by a wild animal. Daya meets his colleagues to investigate the case.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Saazish
episodes.overview: Dr. Ranjeet dies during his heart surgery. The hospital staff tells team CID that Dr. Ranjeet must have been murdered during the operation. While investigating, The CID learn that Dr. Ranjeet was involved in illegal organ transplants.

episodes.name: Khooni Safar: Part 1
episodes.overview: An anonymous person throws Manish off a moving train leading to his death. CID reach the place to investigate and find a few diamonds from Manish's pants.

episodes.name: Khooni Safar: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID plan to travel in a train to find out the murderer. ACP Pradyuman learns that an anonymous person had kidnapped Vishwas.

episodes.name: Samundar Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A helicopter blasts in mid-air before it crashes into a sea. Few fishermen rush to rescue the survivors. CID learn that a businessman was in the helicopter when the incident took place. While investigating, they find the fishermen dead.

episodes.name: Durghatana Ya Aparadh
episodes.overview: A speeding car rams into a tree on a busy street. CID find a dead body in the car. They soon learn that the death is not due to the accident. While investigating, they find out that the man was drugged before the incident.

episodes.name: Bhootiya Lift
episodes.overview: Amit goes missing after he enters the lift of his apartment. Residents think that a spirit of an old woman who was found dead in her house six months ago has killed Amit.

episodes.name: Rahasya Gayab Logon Ka
episodes.overview: Pankaj's friend Snehal goes missing while travelling by her car. He requests the ACP to help him find her. Team CID learn that the GPS of Snehal's car was hacked by an anonymous person. Will CID be able to find Snehal?

episodes.name: Agni Pariksha
episodes.overview: Dilip's family get shock of their life when he gets burnt to death in a party. Team CID learn that Dilip and his business partner Rohan were responsible for a nine years old criminal case. Will CID be able to find the murderer?

episodes.name: Khooni Sapna
episodes.overview: Raima and her husband Sunil are in a hotel to attend a wedding. Raima while trying to sleep sees a murder and she informs CID. Sunil tells them that she has sleep paralysis. Team CID go undercover in the hotel to investigate.

episodes.name: Phone Ka Dhamaka
episodes.overview: An actor holds a mobile phone near his face while shooting for its ad. The mobile explodes and catches fire leading to his death. The mobile phone company head blames the rival company.

episodes.name: Pocket Maar Gang
episodes.overview: A few pickpockets mysteriously get killed. CID recover a radioactive detector machine from one. They meet a person who portrays himself as a RAW agent. He tells them that a pickpocket has stolen nuclear secrets from a government agency.

episodes.name: Raaz Dhamake Ka
episodes.overview: A lunatic student explodes a bomb in front of his college. CID recover a skeleton from the scene. Salunkhe informs the ACP that the deceased died about 2 years ago. How is it possible?

episodes.name: Teen Katil
episodes.overview: Nikhil's friends find him dead in a resort. Salunkhe informs the ACP that Nikhil was killed by three people. Nikhil's friends inform the CID that Nikhil had organized a party in the resort. Was it someone from the party who killed Nikhil?

episodes.name: Haveli Ka Shraap
episodes.overview: A woman calls the CID and informs that her fiancé, Raj, is dead due to bee sting and suspects that he was killed. CID arrive at the mansion where Raj died. They discover that he had received a death threat. Who wanted to kill Raj and why?

episodes.name: Aalap Alpviram
episodes.overview: KD mysteriously dies during his recording inside the studio. The CID team learns that KD was addicted to narcotics and suspect that his addiction might have caused his death. Dr. Salunkhe finds the presence of poisonous substances.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Sandesh
episodes.overview: Tina receives a text message warning that the taxi in which she is travelling is not safe. Panicked, she asks the driver to stop but in vain. The next day her dead body is found on the road and CID are called in to investigate.

episodes.name: Smartphone Khooni
episodes.overview: Kartik, an entrepreneur is killed in a car accident. CID however find out that his death was a cold-blooded murder. Kartik had designed the world's cheapest smartphone, aimed at the masses thus having multiple suspects in the case for CID.

episodes.name: Qatl Ya Khudkhushi
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman receives a phone call from Bala, who has been on the run for over a decade. He offers to surrender on one condition that CID must reopen the case of his daughter's death which was declared a suicide. Will CID help Bala?

episodes.name: Bala Ki Wapsi
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman suspects that Bala's life is in danger. While investigating a murder, meanwhile, Abhijeet behaves indifferently due to a chemical and Bala has come to surrender. How will CID solve the mystery?

episodes.name: Pyaar Ka Junoon
episodes.overview: Riya receives messages on social media where she's threatened with dire consequences if she doesn't reciprocate his feelings. She seeks help from the CID. But before they can dig deep into the case, Riya is found dead with her throat slit.

episodes.name: Juaari
episodes.overview: A gambling conman Siddharth is killed in a bungalow. His pictures were put out on all the newspapers. Three people come forward saying they had lost money while gambling with him.

episodes.name: Raaz Bandh Building Ka
episodes.overview: An old building is about to be detonated, when suddenly a man, sneaks into the building seconds before the detonation to look for his missing cat. To his horror he discovers a corpse hidden in a corner.

episodes.name: Apaharan
episodes.overview: A young woman wakes up to a disturbing social media news feed from Anchal, which informs about her murder and her daughter Aria's kidnapping. The lady calls the CID. They discover that Aria is having critical health issues.

episodes.name: Antim Khushi
episodes.overview: An argument breaks out between 2 men during a stand-up comedy event. Next day, a man is found dead in his office. When the CID comes, they discover that the dead man is laughing. What could have led to his death with a grin on his face?

episodes.name: Khooni Safar
episodes.overview: The CID is baffled with an intriguing mystery proving impossible to solve. Meanwhile, another murder mystery takes the CID team into its vortex. A woman is found dead. The autopsy reveals that the woman was suffocated.

episodes.name: Bhayanak Raat
episodes.overview: The CID see a stabbed woman in the middle of the road. Daya and Abhijeet look around in the nearby bungalow and find more corpses and a woman claiming to be Sunny's sister who tells him he's trying to kill her.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Preeti, a computer science teacher stumbles upon a dangerous game of death on the internet. She tries to investigate the game to help a friend, but in the end becomes a victim of the game itself. Will CID be able to solve the mystery?

episodes.name: Reth Mein Chhupa Raaz
episodes.overview: Kamal, a well-known novelist, is found buried in sand on a beach. Kamal's wife tells CID that he used to go to isolated beaches to write his novels. On examining, Dr. Salunkhe finds two types of sand on Kamal's body.

episodes.name: Ajeeb Gawah
episodes.overview: Sarika suffers from a rare brain disorder in which she can only see half side of a person. The CID is called after her aunt is killed and she's attacked, and they suspect her family members. Sarika is the sole witness in the case.

episodes.name: Forensic Gutthi
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe's friend Keshav's wife and son hear an explosion and immediately run towards the bathroom and find him dead in his bathtub to their shock. Autopsy reveals Keshav had a broken spine and internal organs were ruptured.

episodes.name: Apaharan
episodes.overview: 3 top executives of a renowned MNC are kidnapped by two masked men who are demanding 50 crores in uncut diamond. One of the executives gets killed. Daya finds out that the video of one officer being killed is shown in every news channel.

episodes.name: Adrishya Khooni
episodes.overview: Abhijeet's old friend from crime branch gets murdered in front of his eyes but there is no killer in the room. Very soon another old co-worker of his gets killed by an invisible killer in an art house.

episodes.name: Baal Chor
episodes.overview: A 'Mysterious Force' is cutting off womens' hair. Women are terrified to venture out at night. The attacks continue to escalate and finally result in a young woman's death.

episodes.name: Aanko Ka Raaz: Part 1
episodes.overview: 2 youngsters are killed after they find a mysterious shortwave radio station. The murder case leads CID into the shadowy world of Numbers Station, an antiquated method used in the World War era by military forces to transmit coded orders.

episodes.name: Aanko Ka Raaz: Part 2
episodes.overview: CID get an inkling of a bomb explosion. The trail leads them to a place called Black Forest. However, when they arrive at the said spot, no such explosion takes place. Something very strange occurs as cops discover an abandoned shack.

episodes.name: Saaza E Maut
episodes.overview: Two judges are in a clubhouse. Someone sends them a package with something mysterious that ends up killing both of them. CID have to find out from a plethora of disgruntled lawyers and criminals who had the strongest motive for the murder.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Sandesh
episodes.overview: Sameer is chatting with a mysterious woman who has added him recently. Just before they're about to meet, she sends strange pictures of his girlfriend Tina. Sameer rushes to her house in panic but finds her murdered. Who is this woman?

episodes.name: Pankaj Ka Faisla
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman accuses Pankaj as the only suspect in a murder case. Abhijeet gets furious on ACP. But ACP always doubts them when they're related directly or indirectly in the case. Will ACP lift his accusation on Pankaj?

episodes.name: Ped Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: ACP, Daya and Abhijeet are in for a shock when they find graffiti scrawled across the walls of their homes. They begin their hunt for the person who wrote it, and for this allegedly murdered Sanjana Prakash. Who is Sanjana Prakash?

episodes.name: Khatarnak Abhijeet
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has been behaving very strangely after returning from a work trip in Delhi. He realizes he's suffering from a strange form of amnesia and hires a private detective to keep an eye on him 24x7. Will Abhijeet find out the truth?

episodes.name: Khooni Ghar
episodes.overview: Two high-profile tycoons have been killed by a kind of smart home run by a programmed voice that control electronics and appliances. CID realize that someone has tampered the system to be able to murder these people. But why?

episodes.name: Daya Ek Hatyara
episodes.overview: At the ransom exchange to save a kidnapped child, Daya shoots and kills the kidnapper by mistake, putting the kid's life is in danger. To make things worse, Daya is arrested for killing the man, though he insists that he didn't kill him.

episodes.name: Woh Kaun Tha
episodes.overview: Ranjan, a wealthy man, and his wife Sulekha are accused of dumped a dead woman in a lake, leading Ranjan to call CID for investigation. He's confused about if he's telling the truth or playing strange games.

episodes.name: Akash Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Three people are involved in a private plane crash which kills all three and the pilot is nowhere to be found. The wives of the three dead approach CID to investigate the case after they tell CID that they were getting death threats a few days before the flig…

episodes.name: Putle Ki Maut
episodes.overview: A headless body of a woman is found in the workshop of a boutique. CID identify the woman and begin to investigate her private life and find that she apparently lived several secret lives under different names.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Din
episodes.overview: CID finally has a lead on the head of The Eye, the identity of their best hacker, Ajinkya. CID trail him and are about to catch him when, Ex-CID officer Shreya shows up with an IB team, also trying to catch Ajinkya.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Bees Saal Baad
episodes.overview: CID team has finally found and arrested the leader of The Eye but it is not over yet. They plan to transport him to a secret safe house to question him. But still, they are ambushed en route. Can CID overcome this obstacle after 20 years?

episodes.name: Waapsi
episodes.overview: A Mumbai colony experiences terror as a headless kidnapper returns after 12 years of death. CID investigates, finding residents convinced of the supernatural killer's identity, questioning if there's more to the story.

episodes.name: Paryavaran Prem
episodes.overview: Someone is wandering around the city, murdering people. CID find that the victims are people who were harming the environment. The killer disappears without a trace every time he's about to be caught.

episodes.name: Drugs Ki Taskari
episodes.overview: A couple staying in a hotel for their honeymoon is arrested by the police after drugs are found in their suitcase. The same day, CID inspects the dead body of a man who died in a club after a drug overdose. How are the incidents connected?

episodes.name: Chaal
episodes.overview: An old man witnesses a young girl being stabbed in the building opposite, but upon investigation, no signs of death or violence are found, raising questions about the victim.

episodes.name: Khooni Chaal
episodes.overview: Four young goons kidnap a wealthy man, who is later found dead. CID investigates murders of the kidnappers, questioning motives and potential innocence.

episodes.name: Darr Ki Awaaz
episodes.overview: A suicide helpline receives a call from a pregnant woman claiming to have committed suicide, but CID's forensic analysis reveals a murder being disguised as a suicide.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Qatil
episodes.overview: CID investigate a sinister cult targeting vulnerable individuals online, causing random murders without connection. They must find perpetrators before innocent people are massacred, as no one knows who has been targeted.

episodes.name: Khel Suraag Ka
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe receives a gift card to a murder scene but discovers that it's evidence from stolen cases. Suspended, he pleads innocence, and CID wonders if they can solve the case without Salunkhe's help.

episodes.name: Khooni Aasmaan
episodes.overview: A paraglider and a trekker get shot while paragliding. CID are particularly confused by this case, because at such a height, there's no vantage point to take aim at the victims from. No chopper, no cable car, no plane or any flying object.

episodes.name: Muft Delivery
episodes.overview: Delivery boys of shopping websites are getting killed. CID find out that the victims are all being killed after being called to an abandoned location, leaving no clues for them to investigate.

episodes.name: Sach Ya Sapna
episodes.overview: Komal has been having strange nightmares about a woman, a house, a man and a murder. Her parents think it's some kind of mental illness but she insists that it's going to happen. She paints all the nightmares and takes them to the CID.

episodes.name: Chor Ke Khoon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Tony is killed mysteriously in his office by an unknown assailant. Dr. Salunkhe discovers strange coins in his stomach which the killer had fed him for some reason before killing him.

episodes.name: Mukhota Mein Khooni
episodes.overview: A masked man imitating from a popular TV show is stabbing random people in the city. The CID team find two young men are puppets, with someone else controlling their actions.

episodes.name: Nadi Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A group of fishermen are out on a fishing trip at a river. They cast their net and are surprised to find stacks of currency notes. They cast their net wider and to their shock, find 2 dead bodies as well.

episodes.name: Andher Nagari
