episodes.overview: A new, murderous presence haunts the city, mystifying the CID after leaving a dead industrialist in its wake. The CID suspect a skilled, purposeful assassin using an ancient weapon and a Japanese connection.

episodes.name: Khooni Tasveer
episodes.overview: A wealthy couple anonymously receive a photoshopped family photo frame on their wedding anniversary. It has been sent by a photographer who is brutally killed. CID are on the case and realize that there is a dangerous family secret in it.

episodes.name: Daya Lapata
episodes.overview: CID investigates a double suicide case, where a husband shoots his wife and kills himself. Daya goes missing, and cops trace him to a baby trafficking ring.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Cops find a strange man covered in blood. They find strange tattoos and symbols on his body pointing to 4 missing people. Cops need to solve these clues and find these people before it's too late and find who's behind all of this.

episodes.name: Hawai Jahaz Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is on board a plane where a man is killed by a deadly nerve agent. There is a killer on board and every passenger is in danger. CID must race against time to solve a mystery and find the perpetrators and save the many lives.

episodes.name: Apaharan
episodes.overview: When a young boy goes missing for days, CID spring into action, only to find the kidnapper himself murdered in an ambulance. Soon after, the boy returns with a long stitch across his abdomen, but none of his organs are missing.

episodes.name: Jaadui Khooni
episodes.overview: A famous illusionist Zoravar is proven a fraud at his own show by a mysterious man by the name of Ilesh and hours later, the man is killed in a supernatural way. Everyone is baffled. CID has to prove that it's a human murder only.

episodes.name: Majboor Khooni
episodes.overview: Two murders: one in a disco and another in a café. The common thing in them is that when they were being killed, the murderer told the victims to run away. Why?

episodes.name: Chalti Gaadi Mein Maut
episodes.overview: A woman was shot in a moving vehicle, and her ex-husband was unaware. CID discovers she was shot from a nearby building, using a delaying tactic for a perfect aim.

episodes.name: Ichchadhari Saap Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: CID have been called to investigate a very strange case where the victim's mother believes that the killer is a dead snake's spirit. The cops don't believe it, but all their investigations lead back to this mysterious snake.

episodes.name: 100 Saal Baad
episodes.overview: Behram was a dreaded serial killer who killed hundreds of people a century ago. Now after all these years, a ruthless, psychotic killer who considers Behram his guru, is replicating his horrific crimes.

episodes.name: Adrushya Khooni
episodes.overview: A man with an organ transplant is murdered in broad daylight, seemingly driven by a genie. The case escalates when another organ transplant recipient is murdered, with the donor's younger brother claiming the killer is a genie.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Ghar
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has a terrifying experience in a haunted house which leaves him shaken. He remembers seeing 2 dead bodies inside but when the cops check the next day, there's no trace of anything suspicious.

episodes.name: Khooni Daya
episodes.overview: A man says that Daya has stabbed him and wants to kill him. CID realize that he has a condition which causes him to see Daya's face in everyone caused by excessive chemicals in his brain. Will CID find out why?

episodes.name: Daya Ki Shaadi
episodes.overview: A family is blown up in their house, leaving the daughter behind but no clues no trails. A new twist appears when a woman claims to be Daya's wife with evidence. Daya denies it all and somehow both the cases are linked.

episodes.name: Khooni Dhun
episodes.overview: A deadly serial killer escapes while being transferred to another prison. CID are baffled as he kills 3 people in quick succession, but his sister is sure that he's not the killer. Is it really the serial killer or a copycat?

episodes.name: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is being troubled by a mysterious entity, who warns him that the entire CID is going to die. Even as he prepares for a toughest case that'll test the very limits of CID, on the other end is CID's most formidable foe.

episodes.name: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 2
episodes.overview: After the CID walk into a trap laid by the Eye, they're seen as fugitives from the law. John Harris has been found murdered and the CID are the prime suspects. Meanwhile, the cops realize that the conspiracy is not limited to a murder.

episodes.name: Khooni Dimag
episodes.overview: People are hearing voices in their heads that are forcing them to kill specific people and then commit suicides. CID are baffled as they can't pinpoint if this state is natural or induced by a mastermind.

episodes.name: Nashe Ki Pathshala
episodes.overview: A student union leader dies due to drug overdose in a medical college. Someone signals the local cop that it's actually a murder. CID go undercover in the same college and discover a large racket of exam paper leak. How will they stop it?

episodes.name: Cricket Dhamaka
episodes.overview: The star batsman of a domestic cricket league team is killed in a blast in the middle of the game. The CID suspect a betting angle. However, they soon realize that the victim was a brash, arrogant player who had more enemies than friends.

episodes.name: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID come to know that a released prisoner Krakato has a plan to take down ACP Pradyuman for arresting him. Meanwhile, a dead body is found and the dead man is found to have a direct connection to Krakato.

episodes.name: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops confront Krakato but he challenges ACP to kill Abhijeet and Daya in exchange for his grandson. They try to outwit him but he outwits them by telling them that he doesn't know where ACP's grandson is.

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Gaadiyon Ka
episodes.overview: A number of cars are stolen in the city and one of the owners is brutally murdered. The CID realize that the killers have targeted all five cars which were sold on the same day for a particular reason.

episodes.name: Khooni Jungle
episodes.overview: A dead man's skin has been removed and kept in 3 bags. The CID investigate his death which leads to another death in front of them from the poisoned garland around his neck. They try to save another victim but find her hanged.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Taiyari
episodes.overview: While shooting for a film in a forest, a dead body is found buried. CID realize that he wasn't killed in the forest as the trail leads the cops to a flat with blood stains all over the floor.

episodes.name: Imtihaan Ki Ghadi
episodes.overview: Two men on the run are found in strange circumstances. One of them is dead and the other suffering from a mysterious condition. CID find a strange glow from their bodies and discover that a deadly nuclear weapon has entered the country.

episodes.name: Behosh Khooni
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives voice notes with instructions while on a flight. He then discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats.

episodes.name: Sazaa-E-Maut
episodes.overview: In the garb of the kidnapping of school kids, CID is in for a shocking journey when Daya is kidnapped during the investigation by a man who swears on hanging Daya to his death, just like his own brother who is being hung due to CID.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Insaaf
episodes.overview: Abhijit ends up killing a criminal during an interrogation. CID receives huge backlash for misusing their powers and Abhijit is suspended by ACP. A furious and heartbroken Abhijit is kidnapped by a mysterious vigilante group. They make him an offer to join th…

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Gawah
episodes.overview: Cops are intrigued when a 17-year-old orphan suffering from a rare condition reports two murders. The problem is that she doesn't know when and where it happened and who was murdered. How will the cops solve this challenging case? Is the orphan saying the tru…

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 1
episodes.overview: An investigation of a murder leads to death of Jimmy. Sheetal blames ACP to involve Jimmy in the case and ACP resigns from CID. Will ACP come back? Who will lead the team?

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP is in the hunt to find Jimmy's killer but due to certain circumstance, he himself surrenders to the killer and then it's a race against time for the CID to save the ACP.

episodes.name: Aakhri Chunauti
episodes.overview: CID learn about the mysterious death of an internet celebrity named Siddharth. Daya and Abhijeet take up the case as ACP Pradyuman is busy with Jimmys birthday celebrations. Later, ACP Pradyuman is dejected learning that the case might be transferred to IB. T…

episodes.name: Satark Rahe
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets a message on his phone. The message claims that information stored in a pen drive will lead the CID to the eye gang. The CID decide to find the pen drive. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman is in talks with a hacker to find out the trail of the eye gang.…

episodes.name: The Final Challenge
episodes.overview: CID is called to investigate a strange murder case. A decapitated head is found in a bowling alley. CID find the body and Dr. Salunkhe finds out that the victim was shot dead before his head was decapitated. Also found at the crime scene is a briefcase. CID f…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: India's favourite crime thriller show is back! Abhijeet, Daya and other CID officers, led by ACP Pradyuman, join forces with forensic expert Dr Salunkhe to track down the perpetrators who have committed heinous crimes, using every small clue they can find.

episodes.name: Sniper Rifle Murderer
episodes.overview: During a critical rescue operation, Abhijeet tragically loses his daughter Shreya due to a minor error by Daya. Three months later, a mysterious shooting incident occurs on a metro, leaving a woman injured. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the trut…

episodes.name: A Mid-Air Murder
episodes.overview: On a mid-air flight, Abhijeet receives voice notes with certain instructions. He soon discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats. How will team CID aid Abhijeet solve the case and catch the culprit before the flight lands?

episodes.name: Body In The Red Suitcase
episodes.overview: During a journey from Nagpur to Mumbai, Richa's husband, Alok, vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Shockingly, his dismembered body is later discovered inside a suitcase. Who is behind this chilling crime?

episodes.name: Chehre Par Chehra
episodes.overview: CID officer Avni investigates a case involving her injured friend uncovering a tangled web of deception, identity twists, and a tragic past Can the team bring clarity to the chaos?

episodes.name: Murder On The Island
episodes.overview: Three charred bodies are discovered in a bungalow on a secluded island by catering staff. The CID team steps in to uncover the mystery behind the gruesome deaths. What secrets does the island hold?

episodes.name: Salunkhe's Catwalk
episodes.overview: The CID team investigates the mysterious death of Digvijay, an NRI groom, at his own wedding. As the case unfolds, they uncover a web of deception, hidden grudges, and unexpected twists, leading to a dramatic revelation about the true motive behind the crimes.

episodes.name: Grehani
episodes.overview: Vishal is a tech genius, whose AI, Grehani, leads to his mysterious death. The CID uncovers secrets of betrayal, rivalry, and a conspiracy surrounding the AI's dangerous potential.

episodes.name: Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: A bank robbery in Mumbai leaves manager Rahul as the sole victim of a planned attack. As CID investigates, they uncover a web of betting addiction, kidnapping, and betrayal involving Rahul, his sister-in-law Kanchan, and others.

episodes.name: Twelfth Victim
episodes.overview: A young man, Vasu, is jailed for his girlfriend Jhanvi’s murder, but years later, a serial killer confesses. CID uncovers a web of corruption, revenge, and deception tied to Jhanvi’s workplace, ultimately preventing a sinister plot and delivering justice.

episodes.name: Jungle
episodes.overview: A foreign photographer’s mysterious death in a forest sparks a CID investigation. As they uncover corruption, illegal activities, and local rituals, the team faces unforeseen challenges.

episodes.name: Gumnaam Hai Koi
episodes.overview: Tragedy strikes when a dancer suddenly collapses and dies while performing a hoola hoop routine on stage.

episodes.name: Ready to Eat
episodes.overview: The CID investigates a series of gruesome discoveries: fingers with numbers found in sausage packets. Tracing the source to a factory, they uncover a smuggling ring using victims to transport diamonds to Dubai.

episodes.name: Charcoal
episodes.overview: A corporate party turns deadly when a mysterious poison causes multiple deaths. The CID races against time, following clues to uncover the culprit and stop the poison's spread.

episodes.name: Katputli Ka Khel
episodes.overview: CID investigates a dancer's murder, uncovering a series of killings tied to an artistic pattern and a dark past. As they race to stop the next crime, the case leads to a dramatic showdown in an abandoned theatre.

episodes.name: Killer Route
episodes.overview: A series of gruesome murders targeting bus conductors on a specific route every Sunday baffles the CID, as victims are found beheaded with no trace of blood or their missing heads. Going undercover as conductors, the CID team hunts for the elusive killer.

episodes.name: The Last Fight
episodes.overview: The sudden death of a very famous underground fighter, Vikram in the ring. His girlfriend, sensing the situation, calls the CID.

episodes.name: Flat No 403
episodes.overview: A gunshot echoes through a society, leading CID to Vikrant's flat, where they find bloodstains and a skull on the wall. What mystery lies behind this chilling scene?

episodes.name: Mechanical Trap
episodes.overview: A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. As the team investigates, they uncover a web of deception and the real mastermind behind the setup.

episodes.name: Haunted House
episodes.overview: Rajveer and his friends discover bloodstains in an abandoned bungalow and alert the CID. As the team investigates, they uncover something suspicious.

episodes.name: Murder In The House
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead in her home after a chandelier mysteriously falls on her. As CID investigates, they uncover suspicious details surrounding the incident.

episodes.name: Gilheri Rakshas
episodes.overview: A man discovers a dead body in the forest and suspects the Gilheri Rakshas is behind it. Can CID uncover the truth?

episodes.name: Death Of A Therapist
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet discovers Dr. Meera dead at her clinic. As CID investigates, their search leads them to a Softech Solutions company. Who is behind the murder?

episodes.name: Not Guilty
episodes.overview: After an accident on a jungle road, Akshita seeks refuge with Dr. Salunkhe, who tries to shield her. As CID investigates, hidden truths unravel, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodes.name: Curse Of The Burning Man
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with burning footprints leading away. As the CID investigate, they uncover a deadly plot tied to an old shipyard legend.

episodes.name: Swimmers
episodes.overview: Three state-level swimmers go for a swim, but when one of them is found dead under mysterious circumstances, CID steps in. As they investigate, dark secrets and a cunning murder plot unravel, leading to a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Room No 804
episodes.overview: A man checks into Forest Woodland Resort only to realize that the eighth floor, which existed earlier, has mysteriously vanished. Later, CID arrives to investigate the murder of a girl found in Room 408. What is the truth behind this baffling case?

episodes.name: Baby Steps
episodes.overview: A yoga instructor, Rohini, mysteriously dies while on a call with CID, with only her baby present. Soon, another instructor, Puja, also dies. CID discovers both were killed remotely using Bluetooth hacks. How will CID solve this case?

episodes.name: The Talking Skeleton
episodes.overview: CID investigates a restaurant staff member’s death and uncovers hidden remains in a statue. As more victims emerge, they follow clues leading to a smuggling operation. How will CID get to the bottom of the case?

episodes.name: Men's Premier League
episodes.overview: The CID team is thrown into action when a biker hurls a duffel bag onto their car, raising bomb concerns. Upon inspection, they find cash and a tape recorder exposing a syndicate linked to match-fixing, with clues tied to cricket.

episodes.name: Nakabposh
episodes.overview: While Inspector Abhijeet pursues a criminal, he meets a man at a bus stop who claims to have a vision of a girl being murdered, with her hair being cut off. Soon after, CID investigates a case that matches his eerie prediction. Is this coincidence or somethin…

episodes.name: The End Of The Watch
episodes.overview: CID uncovers a bomb plot, only to realize it’s a trap by Barboza of the Golden Eye Gang. He hijacks the bureau and successfully kills ACP Pradyuman. Is this end of CID and ACP Pradyuman?

episodes.name: The Aftermath
episodes.overview: Barboza makes a threatening call to Daya, revealing ACP’s death. As the team reels from the loss, they prepare to take down Barboza and his gang. Meanwhile, Sachin remains in the ICU and Avni battles her injuries.

episodes.name: Ticket To Heaven
episodes.overview: Rajeev, a shopkeeper, is found dead on a bus under alarming circumstances - his face had turned cherry red with signs of rapid rigor mortis. CID officers Purvi and Pankaj are joined on the case by a couple of other officers, who doubt the team's capabilities…

episodes.name: Purze
episodes.overview: ACP Ayushmaan arrives as the new ACP and sets boundaries before the team. Team CID then investigates the cases of gruesome, organ-harvesting murders, where the victims are abducted and are operated on when alive.

episodes.name: Murder At The Studio
episodes.overview: Podcaster Aniket, who had recently uncovered the identity of the culprit behind a two-year-old murder case, is found dead in his studio with his throat slit. ACP Ayushmaan and the CID take charge of the investigation to uncover the truth behind this chilling…

episodes.name: Murder At The Railway Tracks
episodes.overview: A girl is found dead near the Mahim railway tracks, prompting CID to take charge of the investigation. Meanwhile, Sachin notices something suspicious about the victim's footwear and urgently asks to speak with Inspector Daya,

episodes.name: Death In The Car
episodes.overview: A company prepares for a grand launch of its latest car, meant to showcase the future of automobiles. But during the big reveal, a corpse is discovered in the driver's seat. How will CID solve the case?

episodes.name: The Silent Den
episodes.overview: A mysterious murder takes place inside a silent den, leaving Team CID with no clear leads. As suspicion spreads among the staff and guests, will they be able to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight?

episodes.name: CID Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: Team CID arrives at a school under threat from an unknown man. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman and ACP Ayushmaan clash over the Barboza case, with Ayushmaan suspecting a mole within their own team

episodes.name: Accidental Death Or A Planned Murder?
episodes.overview: Two celebrities from a reality show meet a mysterious end, sending shockwaves through the industry. As the investigation unfolds, team CID is soon alerted to yet another tragic incident - the accidental death of rising star Dhwani. Are these deaths truly acci…

episodes.name: The Last Stroke
episodes.overview: A painter is found dead in his art gallery while working on a painting. As CID begins their investigation, they discover a lipstick mark on a cup, a diary, a photograph, and a mobile phone. Can these clues lead them to the killer?

episodes.name: Missing Flight
episodes.overview: Team CID is left baffled when they discover a corpse strapped to a seat, resembling a pilot who appears to have crashed. What is the mystery behind this strange death?

episodes.name: The Mysterious Death Of A Businessman
episodes.overview: A successful businessman is found dead while swimming in his pool at his farmhouse. Team CID investigates the case and is unable to find the cause of the death of the businessman. Soon after, another man is murdered. How will the team crack the cases?

episodes.name: Skeleton At A Construction Site
episodes.overview: CID team takes on a new case involving a skeleton found buried in the ground. With no initial clues, how will the team unravel the mystery?

episodes.name: Case Of Real Diamonds
episodes.overview: Two men are brutally murdered on the same night, one at home and the other at his office. The CID begins investigating and finds a diamond studed vase in both the crime scenes. Could there be a connection between the two cases?

episodes.name: The Last Call
episodes.overview: Unknown calls trigger deadly phone explosions across the city. CID discovers chips secretly installed in phones via a fake repair campaign. Linked to the old EchoNet project, the mastermind remains unknown.

episodes.name: Jewellery Theft
episodes.overview: A raid turns shocking when CID uncovers stolen jewellery in a godown - alongside Inspector Daya's badge. As suspicion clouds the team, a second daring heist strikes another jewellery store, carried out by masked men. Is Daya truly behind it, or is someone fra…

episodes.name: ACP Pradyuman Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Daya tells the CID team that ACP Pradyuman is alive-but in a shocking twist, he reveals that the ACP failed to recognize him and opened fire. As the team reels from the news, Daya exposes a dark secret about Barboza and his gang that shakes them to the core.…

episodes.name: ACP Pradyuman Tricks CID
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman escapes with Barboza, deceiving the entire CID team. When he walks into the bureau, Abhijeet refuses to believe his story. Later, ACP reveals the shocking truth behind how he survived the bureau blast.

episodes.name: Accident Or Murder?
episodes.overview: Purvi comes under suspicion as the team believes she's the mole, until the DIG arrives just in time to defend her. Meanwhile, CID investigates a minor car crash with a shocking twist. Was the driver killed in the accident, or was he already dead before the im…

episodes.name: Behind the Glamour
episodes.overview: Ira, an actress who had bagged a coveted role, is found hanging in her apartment. Team CID investigates the case as they find out about Ira's rival. Who killed Ira, and why?

episodes.name: Death In The Jungle
episodes.overview: While trekking, four friends stumble upon a headless body deep in the jungle. When CID investigates, they find something even stranger - the body has no blood. With no clues and rising fear, can CID uncover the truth behind this eerie mystery?

episodes.name: Dead Men In Uniform
episodes.overview: A group of kids find a gun in their society. Soon after, a policeman falls to his death. A young girl silently sees someone who looks like Daya behind a mask. Later, two more police officers are murdered. What is this case really about?

episodes.name: Janamdin Par Maut
episodes.overview: Officer Daya tampers some of the evidence of a case. Parallelly, a man is murdered as he enters his house for his surprise birthday party. Notably, while waiting for Salil to return, Dodo makes a statement about the incident of a man being killed on his birth…

episodes.name: Omkar Sawant Joins The Team
episodes.overview: Daya shoots Inspector Milan on a moving bus. As CID begins their investigation, Superintendent Omkar Sawant joins the team. While interrogating the passengers, they uncover four distinct personalities within the same man. Can they reach Daya in time and will…

episodes.name: Omkar Sawant Has A Breakthrough
episodes.overview: Superintendent Omkar Sawant announces that the death of Officer Milan has resulted in a breakthrough in the case. Soon after, he states that he has been tracing Officer Daya's moves. Meanwhile, team CID is notified about murder cases that lead to similar, tor…

episodes.name: Officer Daya Is On The Run
episodes.overview: Officer Daya disguises himself and boards a flight. The same flight happens to get hijacked. With team CID on the hunt for Officer Daya, will he be able to save the passengers, conceal his identity, and get away without drawing any attention towards him?

episodes.name: An Encrypted Message
episodes.overview: Team CID raids Officer Daya's house and discovers that he has escaped in disguise. While Officer Daya takes Shreya's help once he lands in Delhi, some of the members of Team CID decrypt his secret message left behind. What will the encrypted message lead to?

episodes.name: Purvi Receives A Message
episodes.overview: While team CID surrounds the Governor's residence, Daya succeeds in sending an encrypted message to Purvi. Daya and Shreya continue working on their operation. Will Purvi be able to decipher Daya's message?

episodes.name: Double Agent Daya
episodes.overview: When Omkar Sawant exposes Daya's truth, Abhijeet defends him and reveals the real mastermind. As Purvi and Abhijeet enter the building to rescue Daya and the Governor, will their mission succeed?

episodes.name: Team CID On A Vacation
episodes.overview: While team CID is on vacation at a resort, they discover that a comedian's manager named Mohan has been murdered after being hit on the head by a coconut. Can they solve the case while still on holiday?

episodes.name: Officer Purvi's Narrow Escape
episodes.overview: Team CID finds out the cause of Tanya's death. Soon after, Officer Purvi narrowly escapes acid being flung towards her. On further investigation, the team narrows down the list of suspects. Will the culprit outwit team CID?

episodes.name: Ekk Anokha Case
episodes.overview: Sarthak, a man who is found dead, writes in his suicide note about murdering somebody else. Team CID has 72 hours to crack the case and save the life of the victim. Who is the victim and why did Sarthak kill him before dying?

episodes.name: Dr Salunkhe Goes Missing
episodes.overview: With only 42 hours left, Dr. Salunkhe is missing. Meanwhile, the man impersonating him is found dead inside the jail. During the investigation, it is revealed that someone posing as Daya had visited Dr. Salunkhe in jail. Will CID be able to find the real Dr.…

episodes.name: CID Ke Naam Ek Gift
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman receives a mysterious call about a gift from someone calling himself the Chessmaster. CID finds themselves caught in a real-life game of chess as they race to solve the case. What danger lies ahead for the team?

episodes.name: Ekk Insaan, Do Maut
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the death of a man and finds out that he has died twice. How will the team uncover this curious mystery, and what is the cause of the death?

episodes.name: Accident Ya Murder?
episodes.overview: A bike accident takes a shocking turn when the autopsy reveals hidden truths. The team begins to suspect foul play. Was it really an accident or a cleverly planned murder? The race to find out the truth begins.

episodes.name: Officer Abhijeet Witnesses A Crime
episodes.overview: While recovering at home from an injury, Officer Abhijeet believes that he has witnessed a crime take place in the apartment opposite his. Officer Daya arrives at the aforesaid apartment and finds the apartment bare. Team CID investigates whether a crime has…

episodes.name: Failed Transactions
episodes.overview: Multiple payment transactions fail across the city. Meanwhile, CID probes an accident involving a doctor set to receive an award on 15th August, only to discover he was responsible for YPI transaction security. What mystery will this investigation uncover?

episodes.name: Shraap
episodes.overview: CID investigates a case in a chawl where young Prasad collapses during Dahi Handi practice, his body twisted backwards from the waist. While an old lady calls it a curse, will CID uncover the real cause?

episodes.name: Dead Principal
episodes.overview: The principal of a college is found dead under mysterious circumstances. When CID investigates, they find red powder in his nails and deep scratches on his neck. Their suspicion falls on Professor Ajit, but is he really behind the murder or is there more to t…

episodes.name: Do Minute, Do Khoon
episodes.overview: As the organisers at Lunaro Art Gallery gear up for their most anticipated exhibition, Dr Myra and Vikram are found murdered. Team CID investigates the case but gets trapped at the gallery when the anti-theft alarm goes off. Will they solve the crime with dep…

episodes.name: Manch Par Maut
episodes.overview: Amid Ganpati celebrations, the CID team is called in to investigate the mysterious death of a famous dance teacher. While it appears to be a heart attack, suspicions of murder grow stronger. Will the truth come out?

episodes.name: The Headless Dead Body
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the case of a headless dead body found in a trunk on top of a bus. Who is the victim, why was he murdered and who is the culprit?

episodes.name: An Author's Murder Mystery
episodes.overview: While Team CID is busy playing a game of chess, they receive news of the murder of renowned novelist Surya. The case appears to be a natural death at first, until they discover a burnt paper with details about the murder in his room. How will CID unravel this…

episodes.name: A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.",shortDescription:"Chaos erupts w…

episodes.name: Shooting Stars
episodes.overview: Arpan mysteriously dies moments after proposing to his girlfriend through a video under a shooting star. When the CID begins its investigation, they discover his charred body at the very spot of the attack. Was Arpan truly killed by a celestial phenomenon, or…

episodes.name: High Security Murder
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives a threat that his friend Dhanraj's life is in danger. With Dhanraj under high-profile security, can Abhijeet reach him before it's too late?

episodes.name: Haunted Amusement Park
episodes.overview: A social media experiment to revive an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer dies mid-stunt. Can the CID team uncover the dark truth hidden inside?

episodes.name: Bureau Mein Murder
episodes.overview: A man walks into the CID bureau to report a threat to his life and warns ACP Pradyuman about an impending attack in Mumbai. But before he can say more, he suddenly dies right there in the bureau. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind th…

episodes.name: Influencer Ki Maut
episodes.overview: On being called by Shanaya's concerned manager, team CID smashes Shanaya's door and finds her murdered. The top suspects involve Shanaya's current boyfriend and her ex-boyfriend. Based on the postmortem results, team CID hunts for an important clue. How will…

episodes.name: Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodes.overview: CID takes on a baffling case where people act possessed, speak of a fairyland, and then die by suicide. With no substances found in their bodies and all deaths occurring at the same time, what is really behind this mystery?

episodes.name: A Poisoned Necklace
episodes.overview: Shreya arrives to attend the engagement ceremony of Rashi and Aman. Soon after, Rashi is found murdered after having wom a poisoned necklace. Team CID investigates the case and finds out that a slow poison was being administered to Rashi since a while. Who is…

episodes.name: Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.overview: Cricketer Neerav's daughter is kidnapped from school, and CID steps in to investigate. They discover that an unknown person picked her up claiming to have Neerav's permission. How will CID crack the case?

episodes.name: Murder At The Resort
episodes.overview: Team CID reaches a resort to investigate the mysterious death of a young girl. Upon inspection, they discover she was stabbed in a fit of rage. Will CID uncover the truth behind Surbhi's death while questioning her friends?

episodes.name: Deadly Overtime
episodes.overview: A woman is murdered under mysterious circumstances while working late in her office. The CID team notices something strange in the CCTV footage. Motion sensors detect movement but no body appears. Forensics reveal unusual entry and exit wounds. Can the team s…

episodes.name: Bungalow Mein Maut
episodes.overview: CID investigates a shocking case where a man named Kunal is found dead, but the police discover that Kunal himself had reported his own death before it happened. What is the mystery behind this eerie case?

episodes.name: An Obsessed Fan
episodes.overview: Neha is found dead in actress Aisha's green room, stabbed in the back with a pair of scissors. During the investigation, Pankaj discovers a strange necklace with Aisha's photo made from blue hair. What dark secret lies behind this eerie clue?

episodes.name: RJ Ki Maut
episodes.overview: Pankaj is on a call with RJ Rishabh when suddenly, the RJ calls out for help and is then found murdered. When team CID investigates the case, they find a few dead honeybees in the room. Who is the culprit and why was the crime committed?

episodes.name: Karmo Ka Phal
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with his face crushed by a stone and a message scrawled in his blood at an isolated spot with no CCTV. Was his death a personal vendetta, or is there a darker motive behind it?

episodes.name: Death Of A Fortune Teller
episodes.overview: A crowd gathers to hear messages from their ancestors through a woman, but suddenly the woman collapses and dies right before their eyes. When CID arrives to investigate, they discover someone else's blood stains at the scene. What dark truth lies behind this…

episodes.name: Buried In Cement
episodes.overview: A unique case comes up for the CID team when a body is discovered buried in cement inside an abandoned bungalow. What clues will the team uncover from this corpse that has been lying there for months?

episodes.name: Cursed Mirror
episodes.overview: Actress Reva is found unconscious after a mysterious accident that appears to be deliberate. When CID takes charge of the investigation, they discover that Reva possessed a cursed mirror. What dark secret lies behind this shocking incident?

episodes.name: Death After Discharge
episodes.overview: Dhiren, a businessman, is found dead in his car after being discharged from the hospital. Team CID investigates the case and finds out more about his family dynamics and the ongoing politics in his business. Who murdered Dhiren and why?

episodes.name: Maut Ki Dhamki
episodes.overview: Businessman Kuldeep receives a threatening phone call over a bungalow dispute and is later found dead in his meditation room. Team CID investigates the case and discovers a broken window and aroma oil on his face. Who killed Kuldeep?

episodes.name: Apsara
episodes.overview: While team CID heads out for a picnic, they stumble upon a mysterious case involving a missing policeman. The prime suspect is a woman who lives by the lake and is known to lure men with her charm and jewellery. As the team dives deeper into the investigation…

episodes.name: Ekk Anokha Shadyantra
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates a case where they find a woman's body without the head. The entire team stitches various clues together and identifies the victim to be Alisha. On further investigation, the team narrows down the flow of the events leading to the murder.…

episodes.name: A Chain Of Murders
episodes.overview: The CID team stumbles upon a strange case where an auto-rickshaw driver is found strangled to death with no signs of struggle and no witnesses. Soon after, another eerily similar death is discovered not far from the first scene. Is a serial killer on the loos…

episodes.name: SOS Call
episodes.overview: Team CID follows a set of coordinates to a secluded location after receiving an SOS call. As they begin their search, they try to track down Officer Shreya and a woman named Sarla who was with her. What mystery lies behind this case, and where have Shreya and…

episodes.name: Rakshak Baba
episodes.overview: Three friends trespass onto land owned by Rakshak Baba. One escapes, but the other two are found decapitated and their bodies discovered deeper in the forest. How will CID piece the case together?

episodes.name: The Ghost Of Kalighati Village
episodes.overview: While on vacation, Daya discovers a village plagued by murders. Locals claim a witch is behind these deaths. Can he uncover the truth?

episodes.name: Murder At The Bureau
episodes.overview: When a serial killer dies in CID custody, suspicion falls on Abhijeet. ACP Pradyuman defends him as the team fights to clear his name.

episodes.name: Abhijeet's Secret Caller
episodes.overview: A truck driver named Munna is found dead and his partner is missing. CID is stunned to discover that the RDX once loaded in the truck has vanished. During the investigation, Abhijeet receives a rose and a call from a mysterious woman asking for help. Are thes…

episodes.name: Abhijeet Shoots Daya
episodes.overview: With Abhijeet suspected of having gone rogue, team CID attempts to track 400 kg of RDX across the city. The team follows a lead and tracks delivery boys in the city. Shortly after, during a shootout, Abhijeet fires at Daya before escaping. What is Abhijeet's…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Two teen cricket prodigies struggle against their overbearing father and a system stacked against them to realize their own ambitions and identities.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Intent on landing his sons professional cricket contracts on Selection Day, Mohan brings them from their village to Mumbai months before the trials.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Mohan's sons learn Mumbai cricket clubs value member fees over talent. Watching the boys play, an infamous former coach is moved to fulfill an old vow.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The boys start at Weinberg Academy, but Mohan mistrusts Tommy and investigates him while working at a new job. Anand gets stuck in a financial bind.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Mohan makes a scene at the school after one of his sons is punished. Tension builds between Manju and Javed. Anand takes a big financial risk.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: At the team’s first tournament match, Radha aims to impress a talent scout while Manju is distracted by a cryptic poem. Anand has an awkward encounter.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Javed’s envy grows with Radha’s glory. When Mohan and the boys are evicted, Anand seizes a chance. Radha gives worried Manju their aunt's phone number.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Manju feels torn between loyalty to his family and Javed’s new gestures of friendship. Mohan receives an unexpected business proposal.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Radha prepares to play in the Harris Shield semifinals. With his double life weighing on him, Manju must make a tough choice on the day of the match.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Mohan’s business takes off, while a resentful Manju has heated confrontations with Javed and Radha. Anand receives a threat.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The Harris Shield final begins with a curveball that leaves everyone gobsmacked -- and the surprises keep coming. Meanwhile, Mohan makes a confession.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Manju and Radha receive some important news. Distressed about his mother’s whereabouts, Radha crosses a line. A major accusation leads to a showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: With mere hours to go before Selection Day, Manju pays Javed a visit that could risk everything. Anand has some tough questions to answer.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As Delhi reels in the aftermath of a gang rape, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi leads a painstaking search for the culprits. Inspired by the 2012 Nirbhaya case.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After two victims of a brutal crime are found on a roadside, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi assigns only her most trusted officers to lead the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With few leads to go on, Vartika's team focuses on identifying the exact bus where the crime occurred. Media leaks trigger backlash against the police.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Disturbing details about the night of the crime emerge when bus driver Jai Singh is interrogated further. The hunt begins for his five accomplices.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The fourth suspect is captured. As public outrage mounts, Vartika and Commissioner Kumar Vijay must defend the police against rumors of misconduct.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The pursuit of the final two suspects escalates. Vartika must manage the team’s anger, her child’s fears and her own guilt. Kumar faces irate activists.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Male victim Akash is tempted to speak to the media, to Vartika’s dismay. The chief minister continues with his mission to take down Vartika and Kumar.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The fifth suspect surprises the police. Protests outside Parliament become riots. The search for the final suspect leads to a chase in Naxal territory.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When a chain of distinctly grisly murders suggests the return of a feared criminal gang, DCP Vartika heads the case under media and public pressure. Inspired by the Chaddi Baniyan Gang.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Vartika and her team are alerted about a gruesome quadruple murder. Evidence points to a crime syndicate not seen in the city for 20 years.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After another murder, veteran inspector Viren Chaddha joins the team. As case details leak to the press, Vartika suspects an informant among the police.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team's investigation of two suspects leads to eye-opening findings. Amid pressure to appease the media and the public, Vartika faces a moral dilemma.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Against a ticking clock, Vartika takes the case in a new direction. Neeti finds a common link between the murders. Another tip-off leads to a suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The team finds the suspects' hideout. But with Lata still missing, Vartika must determine if she's running or hiding — and finally uncover her story.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 focuses on human trafficking, as two different cases unfold: one with Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Vartika Chaturvedi (Shah) investigating a truck full of missing young women; and the other by Neeti Singh IPS (Dugal), who is trying to find the…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After her transfer to Assam, Vartika unearths a network smuggling young women to Delhi under the guise of jobs. Neeti probes an injured baby's case.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Vartika's investigation uncovers deeper connections as Khushi reveals startling truths about Baby Noor. Kalyani's court hearing takes a shocking turn.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Rahul's confessions about working with Kalyani help the team draw links to the bride trade. Neeti and Simran edge closer to the missing mother's location.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The hunt for Shabnam intensifies, revealing fresh leads. Kusum gets bail and meets Meena. A deeper probe into the Santro car lands Simran in trouble.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Vartika's meeting with Mithul Khanna goes awry, Shabnam has a tearful reunion with her children. Neeti searches for her missing colleague.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Shaken by tragic news, the team races to find the missing women as Vartika's career hangs in the balance. Will they catch Meena before all hope is lost?

episodes.name: A Flower for Mom
episodes.overview: All Bheem wants to do is chase a flower in the woods, but can he grab it before a hungry lion gets him?

episodes.name: Dancing Bheem
episodes.overview: When a dance show comes to town, Bheem can’t help but move to the music and make his way to center stage!

episodes.name: Spicy Surprise
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new playmate is twice his size, but he's jealous that Bheem is stronger -- and he plans a nasty prank.

episodes.name: Honey Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem loves his first taste of honey, and so does his friend. Do the bees have enough for them both?

episodes.name: Mighty Hiccups
episodes.overview: When Bheem gets the hiccups, he and his monkey friend have a forest adventure to get rid of them.

episodes.name: Bheem's Blanket
episodes.overview: When Bheem’s blanket is used to steal a carriage, he takes the ride of his life to hunt down the thief.

episodes.name: Mighty Muscles
episodes.overview: A strongman amazes the town with his feats. How will he feel when Bheem easily upstages him?

episodes.name: A Babysitter's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new babysitter has many plans for playtime, but his animal friends may be too much for her!

episodes.name: Come Out and Play
episodes.overview: When Bheem and his buddy sneak out to play with a friendly elephant, things get very messy, very quickly!

episodes.name: Follow the Laddoos
episodes.overview: While Mom’s away, Bheem spies a trayful of his favorite laddoos. Will he get to them before she’s home?

episodes.name: Dirty Little Piggie
episodes.overview: Mom wants Bheem to bathe, but he has other things to do -- like keeping a pig from eating his snacks!

episodes.name: Mister Joker
episodes.overview: Inspired by the clown in town, Bheem is all too excited to try some impressive tricks of his own.

episodes.name: The King's Crown
episodes.overview: A thief has stolen the king’s crown, but Bheem won’t make it so easy for him to get away with it!

episodes.name: Bheem with a Beat
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new drum set is way too loud. But when Mom takes it away, he finds other ways to make music.

episodes.name: Mango Run
episodes.overview: Bheem and his pal get spotted by a hungry lion -- but Bheem has some funny ways to fend him off!

episodes.name: Doctor Bheem
episodes.overview: After a health checkup, Bheem wants to be a doctor himself. His patients? His animal pals, of course!

episodes.name: The Green Ball
episodes.overview: Bheem searches for his green ball in the woods, but what he finds is quite different from what he lost.

episodes.name: Gardening with Bheem
episodes.overview: While trying to help their mothers in the garden, Bheem and his friend stir up some innocent mischief.

episodes.name: Red Balloon
episodes.overview: Separated from Mom at the fair, Bheem keeps busy chasing balloons, enjoying laddoos and playing games.

episodes.name: A Big Ball of Yarn
episodes.overview: When a big ball of yarn creates havoc at home, will Bheem and his friend get tangled up in the mess?

episodes.name: Hats Off to Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem finds a hat. But before he can claim it, he must face some tough competitors who want it, too.

episodes.name: Painting with Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem begins monkeying around with mom's paint. But will it lead to a colorful mess -- or a work of art?

episodes.name: Mistaken Identities
episodes.overview: When Bheem is mistaken for a princess and kidnapped, he uses some tricks of his own to escape!

episodes.name: Birdie Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem may not have wings, but he's in for a sky-high adventure when he encounters three eggs in a bird's nest.

episodes.name: The Swamp Thing
episodes.overview: A tumble into a swamp leaves Bheem covered in mud. Now a hunter thinks he's an exotic creature and wants to catch him!

episodes.name: The Lost Pup
episodes.overview: Titli is looking for her furry sidekick. But can Bheem help her find him before he gets to Mom's laundry.

episodes.name: Busy As A Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem's out to retrieve Mom's precious necklace from a cheeky monkey -- and the job is anything but simple.

episodes.name: Rice Rice Baby
episodes.overview: Mom wants Bheem to wait with the babysitter while she shops for rice. But he's hardly one to sit for long!

episodes.name: Sticky Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem's love for gooey treat gets him -- and a four-legged friend -- into quite the sticky situation.

episodes.name: Bheem Meets Bunty
episodes.overview: The small woodland animals don't want to play with Bunty, the big elephant. Can Bheem help them all be friends?

episodes.name: Kalia's Wagon Ride
episodes.overview: When Kalia gets a new wagon, Bheem takes him for a heart-pounding ride that neither of them will soon forget.

episodes.name: Disappearing Bheem
episodes.overview: When Bheem unexpectedly becomes a part of a magician's act, he adds a bit of his own chaos and comedy to the show.

episodes.name: Diaper Disaster
episodes.overview: Bheem must get creative to take his diaper back from a mischievous monkey, who won't return it so easily!

episodes.name: Kalia's Creepy Shed
episodes.overview: The toys and tricks inside a dark shed have Kalia terrified, but Bheem's having the time of his life!

episodes.name: Twin Trouble
episodes.overview: It's double trouble for Bheem when his doll gets swiped by a pair of twins. But can he show them how to share?

episodes.name: Bear Hug
episodes.overview: A mean hunter is out to capture a friendly bear -- unless Bheem can step in with his super strength!

episodes.name: Kalia's Birthday
episodes.overview: It's his buddy's birthday party, but Bheem has trouble parting with a gift he wants to keep for himself.

episodes.name: Bheem's Baby Owl
episodes.overview: Bheem's on a mission to help a young owl get safely back to his nest -- and his strategies are a hoot!

episodes.name: Bheem's Sick Day
episodes.overview: With everyone fussing over Bheem, who's sick in bed, an envious Kalia tries to attract some attention.

episodes.name: Let's Be Friends
episodes.overview: A big bully has intimidated all the kids. But does he really stand a chance against the ever-friendly Bheem?

episodes.name: Titli's Cooking Day
episodes.overview: Bheem and Kalia can't wait to taste what Titli's cooking up -- but will the wait be worth it in the end?

episodes.name: Caterpillar's Day Out
episodes.overview: Bheem is fascinated by a young caterpillar but must rescue it from becoming a hungry bird's lunch.

episodes.name: Bheem of Light
episodes.overview: Sleeping in the dark can be scary for Bheem. Can he create a night light that will calm all his fears?

episodes.name: Off On A Ride
episodes.overview: An evil bandit is scheming to capture a horse, but Bheem -- and an angry cow -- won't make it easy!

episodes.name: Bheem Takes the Cake
episodes.overview: When Bheem and Kalia are left alone with some cake batter, will they stir up something delicious -- or disastrous?

episodes.name: The Bull Fighter
episodes.overview: It's Bheem against an angry bull. But he isn't interested in fighting; he just wants to have some fun!

episodes.name: Sleep Crawling
episodes.overview: It may be naptime, but from riding unicorns to battling sea creatures, Bheem's having a wild adventure in his dreams!

episodes.name: Bheem's Masterpiece
episodes.overview: Bheem and Kalia break a sculpture that's meant for an important guest. Will their quick fix be a wreck ... or a piece of art?

episodes.name: A Birthday Surprise
episodes.overview: A lion is scheming to trap Bheem for his next meal. Little does he know, Bheem's got better plans!

episodes.name: A Dogsitter’s Nightmare
episodes.overview: When his babysitter falls asleep, Bheem befriends an adorable pup ... but this pooch is even more mischievous than he is!

episodes.name: Kalia vs Scarecrow
episodes.overview: Kalia believes that a scarecrow has eaten Bheem! Can he set his fears aside to battle the straw-stuffed enemy?

episodes.name: Bheem's New Tooth
episodes.overview: What’s the best teething toy for a baby with the strength of a Titan? Bheem’s babysitter is about to find out!

episodes.name: Kalia and the Carrots
episodes.overview: When a hungry Kalia refuses to eat a healthy snack, Bheem tries to convince him to give it a try.

episodes.name: A Day with a Peacock
episodes.overview: A beautiful peacock has had one of her most important feathers stolen! Now it’s up to Bheem to retrieve it — or replace it.

episodes.name: Tiger Trouble
episodes.overview: Bheem comes to the aid of a baby tiger stuck in a tree, but is he prepared for the cub’s much larger parent?

episodes.name: Bheem’s Monsoon Monday
episodes.overview: Bheem will do anything to keep the monsoon rain clouds away. But maybe they're not so bad after all.

episodes.name: Titli’s Arts and Crafts Day
episodes.overview: While playing with Titli’s bottle of glue, Bheem causes a sticky mess — then gets a smart idea!

episodes.name: Grand Indian Wedding
episodes.overview: As friends celebrate a wedding, a jealous Bheem is anything but pleased and will stop at nothing to wreak havoc at the event!

episodes.name: A Day at the Marketplace
episodes.overview: From loading trucks to taming angry chickens, Bheem’s superhuman strength and quick thinking come in handy at the market.

episodes.name: Bheem at the Playground
episodes.overview: Kalia won’t let any animal friends into the new park. Can Bheem show him that playtime is for everyone?

episodes.name: A Trip to the Moon
episodes.overview: A game of catch with the moon turns into a magical overnight adventure as Bheem heads to the skies to meet his new playmate!

episodes.name: Buttery Bheem
episodes.overview: An accidental fall into a block of greasy butter sends Bheem slipping and sliding into some unexpected fun!

episodes.name: Kalia the Wrestler
episodes.overview: When Kalia faces a much larger opponent at a wrestling match, Bheem steps into the ring to lend a helping hand.

episodes.name: Bheem’s Snow Day
episodes.overview: On a snowy winter day, Bheem helps a jolly visitor out of a tough spot — and learns that dreams really can come true.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a city of coaching centers known to train India’s finest collegiate minds, an earnest but unexceptional student and his friends navigate campus life.

episodes.name: Inventory
episodes.overview: Hoping to pass the IIT entrance exams, teen Vaibhav arrives in Kota with one goal: to nab a seat at the best coaching center in the city.

episodes.name: Assembly Line
episodes.overview: Canteen food, insomnia and studying weigh on Vaibhav, but when his friends’ tips don’t help, Professor Jeetu offers his campus-life survival strategies.

episodes.name: Optimization
episodes.overview: Struggling with Inorganic Chemistry, Vaibhav plots to have his instructor replaced, but his problem with the subject may not be the person teaching it.

episodes.name: Shutdown
episodes.overview: Given several days off before exams begin, Vaibhav, Meena and Uday each use the revision period to pursue romantic possibilities, with mixed results.

episodes.name: Overhaul
episodes.overview: Standing at a crossroads in his academic journey, Vaibhav is torn between his heart and his mind before making a big decision about his next steps.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Continuing their pursuit of a coveted IIT seat, Vaibhav and his friends try not to let academic pressure — or adolescent angst — get the best of them.

episodes.name: Reasoning
episodes.overview: With their new classes off to a bleak start, Vaibhav and his peers question the value of the IIT dream and seek inspiration from a trusted source.

episodes.name: Control System
episodes.overview: Struggling with Physics, Vaibhav attempts to bend the rules to attend Jeetu’s classes. Meena frets that teenage hormones will get the best of him.

episodes.name: Atmospheric Pressure
episodes.overview: Jeetu searches for staff for his institute, making some reluctant choices along the way. Filled with self-doubt, Vartika evades practice tests at Aimers.

episodes.name: Repair & Maintenance
episodes.overview: When a bout of jaundice slows Vaibhav down in his studying, Jeetu insists he calls his only hope to get well quickly: his mother.

episodes.name: Packaging
episodes.overview: JEE results send Kota into celebration mode and give Vaibhav, Meena and Uday glimpses into their own futures, but the occasion comes with sad truths.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As the all-important exam nears, Jeetu and the students face an uphill challenge with ambition, loss and grueling pressure taking their toll.

episodes.name: Mission Statement
episodes.overview: Jeetu struggles to cope with the loss of a student. Vaibhav doubts his own path to success when his cricket-playing cousin visits Kota.

episodes.name: Fault Mitigation
episodes.overview: Facing financial stress, Meena begins tutoring an eager student to earn extra cash. Vaibhav's attitude forces Vartika to find a new study partner.

episodes.name: Benchmarking
episodes.overview: A clash with Gagan causes Jeetu to spiral. Shivangi feels the strain of the NEET prep, while Vaibhav and Meena compete for ranks in a test series.

episodes.name: Emergency Response
episodes.overview: Jeetu receives an offer that affects the future of Aimers. Uday’s error in judgment leads to serious trouble. Exam pressure takes its toll on Vaibhav.

episodes.name: Product Delivery
episodes.overview: Prayers and prep take hold as the final countdown to the exam approaches. Jeetu makes a startling announcement to his students.

episodes.name: It's Diwali
episodes.overview: Bheem wants to help prepare for the festivities, but will he and his animal pals create a decor disaster?

episodes.name: Temple Trouble
episodes.overview: A visit to the temple is anything but peaceful when Bheem rings the bells - and danger answers!

episodes.name: Fireworks
episodes.overview: While at the palace for the fireworks, Bheem's busy chasing laddoos... and crawls right into a crime scene!

episodes.name: McLaren
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris drives the stunning, cutting-edge McLaren P1, one of the most advanced sports cars in the world, and /DRIVE visits the home of McLaren, Formula One's technology leader, at its headquarters in Wolking, UK, to see how its latest supercars are…

episodes.name: Against All Odds
episodes.overview: Host Matt Farah takes on the wickedly fast, 1,200-horsepower Hennessey Venom GT, and Mike Musto treks to a California desert for the toughest one-day off-road race in the U.S.

episodes.name: Questionable Road Usage
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris leaves the world of supercars to stop traffic in his 1957 Citroen, and Mike Musto braves the highways in a burnout machine built from junkyard parts.

episodes.name: Ferrari, Ferrari, Ferrari
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris tests the $1 million Ferrari LaFerrari on a famous Italian racetrack, and Mike Spinelli solves the mystery of a Ferrari stolen in the 1970s and found buried in Los Angeles.

episodes.name: Best Made Cars in the World
episodes.overview: /DRIVE uncovers the high-performance secrets behind a multimillion-dollar supercar, and Chris Harris travels to southern California in search of the perfect Porsche 911.

episodes.name: Opposites Attract
episodes.overview: Chris Harris travels to Spain to test the stunning Jaguar F-Type Coupe R, and find out how a pizza delivery guy built a "junk heap" Mazda that became an internet sensation.

episodes.name: Back to the Future
episodes.overview: Matt Farah goes "back to the future" in an all-electric Delorean sports car, and /DRIVE hosts find the high speed, high-tech secrets behind the Porsche 918 supercar.

episodes.name: Foreign Car Culture
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts take a death-defying ride on Panama's infamous "red devil" racing buses, and travel to South Africa's Western Cape in search of the world's best driving roads.

episodes.name: The Ultimate /DRIVE
episodes.overview: Chris Harris meets a pair of classic Ferrari poster cars from the 1980s, and gives them a racetrack workout, and Mike Musto does massive burnouts in a Cadillac hot rod.

episodes.name: Middle East Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE on NBC Sports hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli embark on an epic road trip in three modern supercars, to seek out and explore car cultures of the middle east, from the home of the Bahrain Grand Prix to the mythical "road to nowhere" on…

episodes.name: German Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli find the stories behind Germany's national obsession with speed and technology, track-test three amazing German cars, and discover the "Area 51" where sports cars of the future are tested.

episodes.name: American Speed
episodes.overview: Matt Farah, Mike Musto and Mike Spinelli test two all-American performance cars, the Corvette Z06 and Tesla P85D, and experience NASCAR history, from its humble beginnings on dirt tracks, to the science of the super speedway at Daytona.

episodes.name: American Road Trip
episodes.overview: Hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli take three great American sports cars on a tire-smoking road trip, from drag racing in downtown Detroit to setting lap times at Watkins Glen, one of the most iconic racetracks in US racing history.

episodes.name: Japan Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts explore the Japanese auto industry and car culture. They drive three quintessential Japanese sports cars on Hakone Turnpike, an epic mountain road that inspires video games.

episodes.name: Texas Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli explore Texas car culture, from the fastest highway in the U.S. to the spectacular driving roads of the Hill Country, and meet the larger-than-life characters that make The Lone Star State a best kept se…

episodes.name: The Turbocharged Future
episodes.overview: Matt and Mike argue over whether today's turbo-charged engines are any good by comparing sports car icons on a mountain road and at the drag strip. Chris experiences just how good a turbo car can be in a Ferrari 458 on a wet track.

episodes.name: BMW M
episodes.overview: Many marques offer fast and comfortable high-end cars, but it started with BMW's M division. Matt drives a couple legendary M's in South Carolina. Mike views some top secret M prototypes in Munich. Chris drives the new M2 at Nürburgring.

episodes.name: The Best Cars with the Letter "R"
episodes.overview: Chris, Matt, and Mike turn a shaky premise for an episode into an excuse to charge across Britain in some of the most hard-core street cars available today, to see which is the loudest, the fastest, and the best, on the road and the track.

episodes.name: The Autonomous Car
episodes.overview: Alex Roy and Mike Spinelli look at cars that drive themselves including the first ever autonomous track day, putting partly self-driving cars from Mercedes and Tesla to a real-world test, and how close Ford is to a fully driverless car.

episodes.name: Colorado Special
episodes.overview: Chris, Matt and Mike set out across Colorado on an epic trip in three very different vehicles, crossing some of America's most beautiful terrain to determine who has chosen the best vehicle for experiencing nature.

episodes.name: What Makes Fast
episodes.overview: Matt Farah takes a powerful Camaro 1LE to a NASCAR wind tunnel. Mike Spinelli drives a lightweight Ariel Atom 3S and gets car control tips from factory Porsche driver Patrick Long. Chris Harris goes flat out in a second generation Ford GT.

episodes.name: Miami Vices
episodes.overview: A hilarious look at the best (and worst) of Miami's car scene, with a new Lamborghini; an old Ferrari; a speedboat; and a donk limousine.

episodes.name: Cheap Racing
episodes.overview: Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli try to match lap times with a pro driver as they test the limits of a beater BMW in a grueling 24-hour endurance race.

episodes.name: Electrification
episodes.overview: The hosts explore the high-speed, high-performance future of electric and hybrid cars.

episodes.name: Italy Returns
episodes.overview: The team travels to Italy to drive the country's best cars, roads and race tracks.

episodes.name: National Parks Tribute
episodes.overview: The hosts embark on an epic burn through the great national parks of the American west, from Zion to Death Valley to Yosemite.

episodes.name: Iceland Adventure
episodes.overview: The beauty of Iceland in summer is the backdrop for a race between Matt Farah in a McLaren 570GT and Mike Spinelli and Chris Harris who rough it across the country's volcanic center in a Ford F-150 Raptor.

episodes.name: A Car of the Year
episodes.overview: Hosts Mike Spinelli, Chris Harris, and Alex Roy challenge one another to find the best car in a send-up of automotive magazine car-of-the-year awards. It's McLaren 720S versus Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk versus Audi RS3.

episodes.name: L.A. Car Culture
episodes.overview: The car culture of Los Angeles explored with a visit to Singer Vehicle Design's amazing shop by Mike Spinelli, a look at the underground racing scene with Alex Roy, and a visit to ArtCenter College of Design in Pasadena with Kristen Lee.

episodes.name: How Far We've Come
episodes.overview: Chris Harris drives a succession of Porsches representing the pinnacle of performance in their eras, including the Porsche 930 Turbo, 959 and 918 Spyder. It ends with a drive in the amazing Porsche 919 Evo race car.

episodes.name: Grassroots Racing
episodes.overview: What's the best grassroots motorsport? Zack Klapman goes drifting, Alex Roy tries the Power Racing Series, and Mike Spinelli goes to the top of Pikes Peak to find out.

episodes.name: Oregon Trail Road Trip
episodes.overview: Overlanding the original Oregon Trail, Alex Roy brings a six-figure off-road Mercedes while Mike Spinelli goes traditional in a Jeep Wrangler and Zack Klapman goes simple in an Arial Nomad.

episodes.name: French Cars
episodes.overview: The hosts learn about the global renaissance for French cars and a plan for coming back to the United States.

episodes.name: Le Mans Pilgrimage
episodes.overview: The one-hour season finale is a scenic road trip to Le Mans through Europe in a trio of extreme sports cars. Chris Harris picks up a Ferrari 488 GTB in Italy to meet Mike Spinelli in a Porsche 911 GT3 and Zack Klapman in an Aston Martin.

episodes.name: NYC
episodes.overview: A tribute to New York City. Kristen and Mike tell the story of Max Hoffman in a Porsche 718 Boxster GTS and a BMW Z4. Alex meets the NYPD Auto Crimes Division. Kristen goes for a trip in a garbage truck. Mike visits the Classic Car Club.

episodes.name: Dirty Motorsports
episodes.overview: Mike learns how to drive a monster truck and host Zack Klapman discovers the joy of rallying then tries to do it in an Infiniti Q60. Alex and Mike attempt to drive a stage of the Baja. Alex tells Mike a secret.

episodes.name: IMSA
episodes.overview: A tribute to 50 years of IMSA. Chris Harris tries his hand at the Porsche 911 GT3 RS and Ferrari 488 Pista and related race cars. Mike becomes a strategist for the Magnus Racing Lamborghini team - it could have gone worse.

episodes.name: Electric Mayhem
episodes.overview: Electric cars aren't just good for the environment, they can also be a great time. Zack drives a Tesla Model S powered sand buggy and an electric 1995 BMW M3 Pikes Peak racer. Mike and Chris review Tesla's history and test the new Model 3.

episodes.name: AMG
episodes.overview: Inside the famous Mercedes performance brand. Mike tries the original Hammer, Chris drives the wheels off a vintage Mercedes DTM race car, a GT4 race car, and the wonderful GT-R Pro. Kristen compares the new AMG C63 S to her classic AMG.

episodes.name: Morocco
episodes.overview: Our hosts take a weekend road trip to Africa in a trio of fitting vehicles: Chris in a new Ford Ranger Raptor, Spinelli in the Maserati GranCabrio MC, and Alex Roy in a Renault Kangoo Extrem. Alex buys many scarves.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A group of small-town young men run a lucrative phishing operation, until a corrupt politician wants in on their scheme -- and a cop wants to fight it.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The successful phishing scams of Rocky, Sunny and their friends pique a corrupt local politician’s interest. Tension brews between Rocky and Sunny.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: An attempt to arrest the young men is thwarted, to the dismay of the ambitious new police superintendent. Sunny brings a proposal to Gudiya’s mother.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dolly seeks a cybercrime officer’s help in her case. As some of the guys side with Sunny, Rocky plans revenge. An intrusion disrupts Sunny’s wedding.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Sunny's father comes to his aid. Brajesh wields his power. As Saurav educates the police on phishing, Sunny and Gudiya conduct a training of their own.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When Gudiya’s coaching classroom is burned down, Sunny considers drastic retaliation. A slipped note leads Dolly and Saurav to a deserted warehouse.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The boys adopt Sunny’s get-rich-quick strategy. Anas looks to break a story in the paper. As Sunny’s confidence grows, Brajesh visits him and Gudiya.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Dolly, Biswa and Saurav carry out a sting operation that goes awry. Sunny arrives at Brajesh's party, vowing payback for his treatment of Gudiya.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A tragedy sends Sunny on the run, with the police and Brajesh’s men on his trail. Dolly and Saurav hatch a plan to prove Brajesh’s link to the incident.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: An enemy intercepts Sunny’s escape. While tracking the phishing calls, Saurav makes a breakthrough. As some scammers are arrested, Sunny’s fate worsens.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Sunny acquiesces to a dubious deal to save his father. A shattered Gudiya partners with Dolly to set a honey trap in hopes of finally capturing Brajesh.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: New scams, higher stakes, same old town. In Jamtara, no one is spared from the web of corruption and treachery.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As elections approach in Jamtara, Gudiya takes a stand against Brajesh. Rocky looks to start fresh, and Sunny concocts a new scam.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Before arriving in Jamtara, a dating app scam lands Rinku in trouble, while the beginnings of Gudiya's political career are revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dolly and Saurav return to Jamtara to investigate a major phishing case. A group of schoolchildren are assembled to carry out Sunny’s new scam.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: While speaking at a rally, Gudiya encounters a masked gunman. Dolly faces pressure to crack the case, while a crooked journalist is handed a scoop.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Rinku is devastated after a loss. A raid on Brajesh’s property uncovers incriminating evidence. Biswa witnesses a shocking event.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A sudden police press conference blindsides Dolly, Saurav and Biswa. Brajesh pays a visit to the chief minister, while Rocky opens a new shop.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The scammers’ wives join Gudiya’s operation, while a mob attack leads to a brutal assault. Saurav makes a big discovery in Noida.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ahead of election day, Sunny, Gudiya and Rocky devise a scheme to woo voters. Brajesh learns the abductor’s identity, while Rinku is caught in a web.

episodes.name: The "What the Love!" Singles Party
episodes.overview: A rocking party, cheeky games and a few special guests help Karan select six people he wants to help find love from a roomful of hopeful candidates.

episodes.name: The Unsuitable Bride
episodes.overview: Rejected by 11 suitors, pathologist Aashi dreams of Bollywood-style love. But first, Karan must help her through the pain behind her bubbly exterior.

episodes.name: The Eager Beaver
episodes.overview: Rabanne hungers for a monogamous relationship as a gay man in Mumbai, yet he must learn that finding real love means being true to himself first.

episodes.name: Mr. No Time for Love
episodes.overview: Workaholic Vaibhav lacks the time and swagger to make dating work, but Karan’s got strategies — and a surprise guest — to take him from shy to suave.

episodes.name: Ms. Date Me Not
episodes.overview: Lingering physical and emotional scars have fashion designer Geetika running from romance. Karan urges her to lower her defenses to let love in.

episodes.name: Ms. Heartbroken
episodes.overview: Low self-esteem plagues Reena after being dumped. Karan's squad and a Bollywood gent give her a mental makeover before she gives dating another try.

episodes.name: The Planner
episodes.overview: Jet-setter Rameez has high expectations for a life partner. Karan challenges this man with a plan to see that love isn’t about checking off boxes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A timid, small-town comedian's long-awaited big break takes a dark turn when he realizes committing murder is the only way to keep his onstage mojo.

episodes.name: Pakodey Thande The
episodes.overview: After years of being denied a chance to open for his vile mentor, aspiring small-town comedian Hasmukh takes drastic action for a coveted turn onstage.

episodes.name: Ek Tha Azmat, Ek Thi Kismat
episodes.overview: Hasmukh’s past haunts him as he continues his vicious pre-show ritual. Amid scandal in Mumbai, TV executive Sinha seeks new talent for his comedy show.

episodes.name: Jimmy The Maker
episodes.overview: Newly discovered by Alpha TV, Hasmukh is brought to Mumbai. As Jimmy’s confidence swells after a successful meeting, Rhea offers a word of caution.

episodes.name: Bambai Main Bambu
episodes.overview: A betrayal against Hasmukh is thwarted. At a party, Jimmy spots their potential next victim. Ahead of his performance, Hasmukh faces an unexpected snag.

episodes.name: Case Closed
episodes.overview: The initial Comedy Baadshaho results spark surprise and anger. A sudden death raises suspicions. A meeting with don Jameel Indori inspires Hasmukh.

episodes.name: Hum Acche Aadmi Nahin Hain
episodes.overview: As the police question Hasmukh and Jimmy, Promila steps in. KK receives a threat from Indori. Hasmukh makes a potentially disastrous confession.

episodes.name: Machalte Huye Hormones
episodes.overview: After another death, planted evidence leads the police to Indori. When movie star Rahul Kapoor arrives to judge the show, Hasmukh seizes an opportunity.

episodes.name: Peti Killer
episodes.overview: Following a mishap with Kapoor, Hasmukh is blindsided when his act is stolen and performed by his rival. Left to perform without a script, he goes rogue.

episodes.name: Ek Writer Ki Maut
episodes.overview: Low on morale, Jimmy shuts Rhea out. Naik makes a discovery about Hasmukh’s ex-mentor. Ajinkya tries to prove his loyalty to KK, with tragic results.

episodes.name: Sab Samay Ka Khel Hai
episodes.overview: Hours before the show, Jimmy and Hasmukh catch up to Ajinkya, and Hasmukh’s past catches up to him. Hasmukh and KK go head-to-head in a shocking finale.

episodes.name: Rumour Has It
episodes.overview: Hours ahead of a fashion awards event, designer-to-the-stars Masaba is caught off guard by gossip across the city about her marriage.

episodes.name: I Got It From My Mamma
episodes.overview: Masaba deals with social scrutiny, professional pressure, and life back at her mother’s house. Neena scores a meeting with a popular filmmaker.

episodes.name: Man! I Feel Like A Woman
episodes.overview: Apartment-hunting as a single woman proves challenging, but Masaba is determined to live alone. Neena makes a brave move on social media.

episodes.name: Bringing Sexy Back
episodes.overview: Masaba and Neena venture out of their comfort zones as one shoots a TV commercial and the other stars in a music video. Masaba enters the dating game.

episodes.name: Work B**ch!
episodes.overview: Neena lands a leading role. Inspiration finally strikes Masaba for her new collection, but at her show on a luxury boat, it’s one mess after another.

episodes.name: Hot Mess
episodes.overview: Masaba deals with the fallout from her disastrous launch and faces some long-avoided truths. Neena returns to a movie set for the first time in years.

episodes.name: Baby One More Time
episodes.overview: ​​At a major fashion show, Masaba is left in the dust when a young influencer steals the spotlight. An offhand remark lands Neena in the news.

episodes.name: You Should See Me In A Crown
episodes.overview: Masaba sets out to revamp her image by launching a new wedding collection. A job opportunity forces Neena to reconnect with an old flame.

episodes.name: Set Fire To The Rain
