episodes.overview: Subbu faces mockery after a classroom demonstration goes wrong. Desperate to educate himself, he seeks help but his own guilt gets in the way.

episodes.name: The Man, The Mission
episodes.overview: A lie leads to Subbu becoming an overnight hero. Swathi and Kantha Rao help him connect with the women of Makhipur. A hazy night leaves Subbu anxious.

episodes.name: Family Planning
episodes.overview: Subbu's family surprises him as he scrambles to meet his targets and hide his profession. An unexpected development leaves him stunned.

episodes.name: The Mystery Girl
episodes.overview: Subbu's teaching efforts finally start to pay off. A heartbroken Swathi turns to him for comfort. At a celebration, Ramesh Babu makes a major claim.

episodes.name: Subbu vs Kukku
episodes.overview: A secret turns Makhipur against Subbu. As his relationships with his father and Swathi evolve, will luck finally side with him?

episodes.name: K.O.
episodes.overview: Brothers Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to hunt for the perpetrator of a brutal attack, while facing their callous father after years apart.

episodes.name: Counterpunch
episodes.overview: The brothers join forces in their search for vengeance. After returning to the scene of the crime, they stumble upon key evidence.

episodes.name: Sparring Partner
episodes.overview: A suspect's death leads to questions as Dev confronts Joyna. Raka seeks support elsewhere, while the rival boxing clubs prepare for an emergency trial.

episodes.name: Rope-a-Dope
episodes.overview: Ravi begins his training — and uses a surprise inspection to coerce a confession. Kookie toys with life and death, unleashing his wrath on Dev.

episodes.name: Low Blow
episodes.overview: Dev and Ravi's infiltration into a dangerous hideout turns explosive. A violent interrogation leads to an unexpected run from the law.

episodes.name: Underdog
episodes.overview: After breaking the rules, Ravi pleads his case ahead of the Olympic trials. Dev and Joyna search for clues and Arvind spirals after a shocking find.

episodes.name: Suckerpunch
episodes.overview: As the truth emerges, Dev must escape danger at every turn. Ravi claws his way to the final to face an old nemesis, but an attack may threaten his rise.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

episodes.name: Peace and War
episodes.overview: Flight commander Ajay Ahuja is called in to train the Golden Arrows. As the Indo-Pak peace talks begin, General Musharraf considers his next move.

episodes.name: Sada-e-Sarhad
episodes.overview: Baldy struggles to get his head in the game, but a unique bonding exercise brings the squad together. As they celebrate, trouble looms in the mountains.

episodes.name: Safed Sagar
episodes.overview: General Musharraf and the prime minister lock horns. The Golden Arrows race to uncover the infiltrators, but a shocking incident jolts the squadron.

episodes.name: Golden Arrows
episodes.overview: Panic grips the Indian forces as the Kargil War quickly escalates and Ahuja is pulled into peril. Amid nationwide outrage, a plan to fight back emerges.

episodes.name: Bombs Away
episodes.overview: A high-altitude bombing strategy brings new challenges for the Golden Arrows. As Dhali grapples with guilt, General Musharraf's plans begin to unravel.

episodes.name: Line of Control
episodes.overview: As international pressure mounts, a bold formation tactic could signal a momentous shift as the war reaches a turning point.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After their newborn disappears from the hospital, Anvita and Alok receive disturbing birthday packages each year that keep the search alive.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A potential lead forces Anvita to question her search for her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Madhu escalates her efforts to halt the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Anvita's suspicions grow as she examines an old photo for clues, while her visions intensify. A mysterious death raises flags for Inspector Khurana.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: An unexpected confession adds a new layer to the case. Apeksha's birthday party is thrown into turmoil when Anvita makes a shocking accusation.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A threatening message deepens the rift between Anvita and Alok while she seeks crucial evidence. The police track down a woman tied to Rhea's birth.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As the mystery behind Anvita's hallucinations unravels, Madhu finds herself cornered. A tragic incident disrupts the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Shreya's revelation begins to connect the pieces of Apeksha's disappearance as the truth finally comes to light.

episodes.name: Aakhri Call
episodes.overview: Months after a young woman's death, five students receive calls from her number. But the case turns murky when a decapitated body is found on campus.

episodes.name: Hotel Blood Stone
episodes.overview: After being missing for 10 days, a woman appears in a disturbing viral video taken at Hotel Blood Stone. Will the police be able to track her down in time?

episodes.name: Ek Kaatil, 15000 DNA
episodes.overview: When a woman named Naina is found dead, police question people living in the housing complex. Soon a criminal web begins to unravel.

episodes.name: 48 Ghante, Tukdo Mein Sach
episodes.overview: The founder of Pro Life Insurance, Subodh Khanna, goes missing under mysterious circumstances. When his wife presents a suicide video to the police, questions arise.

episodes.name: Garba Mein Maut
episodes.overview: Amid the vibrant celebrations of Navratri in a small Gujarat town, a devoted mother sets out to prove her son's innocence when he is accused of murdering a young girl.

episodes.name: Sard Murder
episodes.overview: When Harshdeep Kochchar's (Harry) body is found in a freezer at his brother's restaurant, the investigation spirals into a web of lies, love, and betrayal.

episodes.name: Mitti Mein Dafan Sach
episodes.overview: When the wife and daughters of a distinguished judge vanish overnight, the evidence emerges in layers-one burial at a time-the case turns into a nightmarish puzzle full of deception, misdirection, and unsettling truths.

episodes.name: Slimming Pill, Bloody Kills
episodes.overview: Superstar Randhir Raii is kidnapped, and ACP has 24 hours to save him. As the investigation unfolds, it exposes a deadly pharma scandal and a grieving father's fight for justice.

episodes.name: Ratna
episodes.overview: Sanju arrives at his home to attend his sister Ratna's wedding ; only to see a sight that will shock him forever and suffer an attack that will handicap him forever. Sanju's whole family has been killed.

episodes.name: Charu
episodes.overview: A maid is dead. But her secrets lived on in the lives of those who thought they never knew her. Her shocking ties to multiple elite residents come to light.

episodes.name: Shruti
episodes.overview: When a young woman vanishes while delivering food, her search leads the cops into the hidden mysteries of the city's largest slum. Can the cops find out the terrible truth about the young girl?

episodes.name: Salma
episodes.overview: Salma , a cook at a street-food cart is found beaten and unconscious in an auto; on regaining consciousness , she says that she got into a fight with her ex-boyfriend who has fled.

episodes.name: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 1
episodes.overview: Set in the Parsi community, Roshni, a new mother is killed and the suspects are many - her husband, her maid, her neighbor amongst many others. Cops are not able to find the killer and now an expert is empanelled to investigate further.

episodes.name: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 2
episodes.overview: Behnaaz is Roshni's best friend. Her quest for finding Roshni's murder intensified. What complicated the case further is that she herself was a victim of domestic violence.

episodes.name: Shagun
episodes.overview: Shagun Sandhu disappears the morning after celebrating her 20th birthday, just hours after her father receives a threatening call. The next day, her body is discovered in a park. Who made the call, and why was Shagun targeted?

episodes.name: Sujata
episodes.overview: Newlyweds Ramesh and Sujata arrive in Mumbai to start a new life. But joy turns into dread when Ramesh vanishes without a trace. Sujata seeks help, but the case takes a darker twist after a woman's body is found. What mystery lies ahead?

episodes.name: Kundan Mayuri, Part 1
episodes.overview: Terror grips the village when a headless body is discovered, leaving the locals stunned and fearful. As the police launch their investigation, unsettling questions begin to surface - who was the victim, and what dark secret lies behind this gruesome act?

episodes.name: Kundan Mayuri, Part 2
episodes.overview: When Naveen's severed head is discovered in his home freezer, the police launch an investigation and question his wife about Mayuri's whereabouts. As they track Dipika in hopes of reaching the culprit, the clock is ticking. Will they find her before it's too…

episodes.name: Sarthak
episodes.overview: Aspiring dancer Sarthak is found dead under a bus stop bench. As the mystery unfolds, his sister-in-law reveals a police constable had visited him a month ago. What led to his tragic end?

episodes.name: Farheen Naseem
episodes.overview: A routine fishing trip takes a dark turn when a corpse is found floating in the water. Shock and confusion follow as the police arrive to investigate. Who was this person, and how did they end up here?

episodes.name: Preeti Sunil
episodes.overview: In Nashik, Maharashtra, Preeti Deshmukh is found murdered in her home. The prime suspect, a firecracker seller, goes on the run and takes children in a chawl hostage. Can the police crack the case?

episodes.name: Shourya Dhiraj
episodes.overview: In Nashik, Maharashtra, wheelchair-bound Dheeraj is found dead in a swimming pool. While it appears to be a suicide, the police suspect foul play. Can they uncover the truth with barely any clues?

episodes.name: Kaan Kaat Killer - Part 1
episodes.overview: Discovery of a severed ear in a scrap dealer's bag leads the police into a complex investigation to find the victim and track down the culprit.

episodes.name: Kaan Kaat Killer - Part 2
episodes.overview: A missing body ? A young girl kidnapped? As police continue their investigation, they must determine whether there is a connection between the two cases

episodes.name: Ria - Sagai Se Pehle Qatl
episodes.overview: On her wedding day, a bride is found dead in a palanquin. Later, her friends' reveal she was unhappy. Can the police determine the cause of her death?

episodes.name: Kya Zindagi Degi Second Chance?
episodes.overview: A minor scrape in a parking lot leads to a harrowing ordeal for a mother and daughter when a violent man begins pursuing them.

episodes.name: Double Kidnapping Case
episodes.overview: Pari is harassed by Raman and later by Raghav at Ria's birthday party. Soon after, Pari goes missing, prompting her father to approach the police. Later, Ria also gets kidnapped. Are Raman and Raghav behind the disappearances, or is something more sinister at…

episodes.name: Ankita Murder Case
episodes.overview: During a live theatre performance, an actress named Ankita is killed in the middle of a scene. Her co-actor Kaushik becomes the prime suspect and goes on the run. How will the police track him down?

episodes.name: Dekho, mujhe kya mila?
episodes.overview: While newly divorced Gaurav Gehlot is out enjoying single life, he finds a baby in the back of his car — and decides to do whatever it takes to keep him.

episodes.name: Love nahi, lovest!
episodes.overview: Shlok agrees to help Gaurav navigate the application process. But first, he has to win over the adoption agency — and his disapproving family.

episodes.name: Dikha denge apni power!
episodes.overview: Gaurav moves out of his parents' and baby-proofs his new home. When he learns Mrs. Nehra has other plans in mind for Amul, he begs for a second chance.

episodes.name: Asli Single Papa
episodes.overview: Jatin grows suspicious of Poonam. A change in Gaurav's circumstances prompts Mrs. Nehra to issue an ultimatum — meet her demands, or lose Amul forever.

episodes.name: Chattan nahi, Parbat!
episodes.overview: Sharanya finds a nanny for Amul who isn't what Gaurav was expecting. A flurry of surprise visitors creates an awkward situation for the new dad.

episodes.name: "Papa bola"!
episodes.overview: As her big day approaches, Namrata begs her family to reconcile — but as the truth about Amul threatens to be revealed, will the wedding even go ahead?

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century: tech titan Morgan Henderson and his estranged wife, international film star Carla Duval. Each side is certain they'll win. But as…

episodes.name: It's Done
episodes.overview: As Morgan and Carla's 10-year marriage hurtles toward divorce, their respective attorneys begin to ramp up their war rooms.

episodes.name: No More Nasty Surprises
episodes.overview: As Johnny starts his first day, each team attempts to gain the upper hand during mediation. Later, Serena tries to control the narrative.

episodes.name: Chip Off the Block
episodes.overview: With the prenup thrown into question, Morgan's relationship with his stepson, Gabe, becomes central to both firms' plans.

episodes.name: Sanjay
episodes.overview: When diplomatic talks between the feuding Pandavas and Kauravas fall apart, the messenger Sanjay must deliver difficult news — war is near.

episodes.name: Vishwaroop
episodes.overview: As the battle begins, Lord Krishn reveals the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita through divine radiance as he guides a torn Arjun towards fulfilling his duty.

episodes.name: Bhishm
episodes.overview: In the story of Bhishm, Krishn recalls the abduction of Princess Amba. But her transformation into Shikhandi will lead to death on the battlefield.

episodes.name: Dronacharya
episodes.overview: Dronacharya rises to the role of commander of the Kauravas. But when his plan to stop Yudhishthir's coronation fails, he makes a deadly vow.

episodes.name: Abhimanyu
episodes.overview: Abhimanyu, the Pandava prince, steps onto the battlefield to combat Dronacharya's complex assault. But tragedy occurs at the hands of the Kauravas.

episodes.name: Jayadrath
episodes.overview: The grieving Pandavas cast blame for their loss. When Jayadrath is mentioned, Draupadi has disturbing memories. Enraged, Arjun prepares to fight.

episodes.name: Arjun
episodes.overview: With Krishn's cosmic aid, Arjun seeks revenge from Jayadrath, while attempting to counter an age-old curse.

episodes.name: Ghatotkach
episodes.overview: A nighttime battle rages, led by Ghatotkach, Bheem's half-demon son. For the Kauravas, one choice remains — a weapon reserved to fight Arjun.

episodes.name: Yudhisthir
episodes.overview: After an injury sidelines him, honorable Yudhishthir returns to a fateful crossroads — must he uphold truth or surrender to falsehood?

episodes.name: Kripacharya
episodes.overview: Kripacharya hosts a unique duel between Ashwatthama and Karn to determine the next commander, but rage and violence soon follow.

episodes.name: Kunti
episodes.overview: As he prepares to take on leadership, Karn reflects on his relationship with his birth mother, Kunti, and his vow to defeat Arjun.

episodes.name: Dushasan
episodes.overview: Haunted by Draupadi's humiliation, Bheem sets out to target Dushasan in a brutal attack for revenge.

episodes.name: Karn
episodes.overview: To defeat Arjun, Karn requests the skilled rider Shalya to take him into battle. But he soon faces the charioteer's ridicule and an old curse.

episodes.name: Duryodhan
episodes.overview: Duryodhan flees the battlefield after Shalya's death, finding a hideout within Lake Dwaipayana as the Pandavas search for him.

episodes.name: Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem and Duryodhan finally face each other in war, while Krishn and Lord Balaram argue over incidents of unlawful fighting on both sides.

episodes.name: Ashwatthama
episodes.overview: Driven by wrath, Ashwatthama leads a devastating massacre. But when his vengeance threatens the world, Krishn steps in to stop him.

episodes.name: Stree Parv
episodes.overview: A grief-stricken Gandhari meets Krishn — and leaves him with an ominous curse. The Pandava women mourn their losses in Kurukshetra.

episodes.name: Krishn
episodes.overview: After Yudhishthir's coronation, Krishn leaves for Dwarka, carrying reminders of Gandhari's words as one family collapses and another rises.

episodes.name: Four Crowns, One Kingdom
episodes.overview: Four rival families - leopards, hyena, wild dogs and lions - all try to claim a rich corner of Zambian paradise as their home. Who will succeed in ruling this precious kingdom?

episodes.name: Storm's Retreat
episodes.overview: Leopard Mutima's relationship with her mother is at breaking point, and as the balance of power in Nsefu tips towards the lions, the hyenas and wild dogs fight to raise their young.

episodes.name: The Lions Fall
episodes.overview: Leopard Olimba finds a mate, but fortunes turn against the lions. Extreme flooding leads to disaster for the hyena clan, and the time has come for leopard Mutima to leave.

episodes.name: Flint and the Crocodile
episodes.overview: Injured wild dog Flint helps care for Storm's largest ever litter of pups. Leopard Mutima searches for a home, and the lions are challenged by forces beyond their control.

episodes.name: Olimba's Last Chance
episodes.overview: The final chapter. Olimba struggles with old age, and the wild dog story takes an unexpected turn. The lions and the hyenas both enjoy a baby boom – but who has the power to rule?

episodes.name: The Secret Story of Kingdom
episodes.overview: Meet the people that made filming Kingdom possible and uncover the extraordinary acts of conservationists and anti-poaching teams protecting South Luangwa and all its inhabitants.

episodes.name: Customs vs Popat
episodes.overview: Amid mounting pressure to curb smuggling at Mumbai airport, officer Prakash Kumar takes charge and ends Arjun Meena's suspension so he can lead the team.

episodes.name: Bada Choudhary
episodes.overview: Arjun forms his A-Team with formerly suspended officers Mitali and Ravinder, as Prakash tasks them with taking down the Bada Choudhary syndicate.

episodes.name: The Priya Story
episodes.overview: Caught smuggling gold by Arjun, flight attendant Priya goes undercover for him. The World Customs Conference offers a chance to trap the smugglers.

episodes.name: Operation Longshot
episodes.overview: The customs team mounts a large-scale sting to intercept gold smugglers converging on Mumbai. Bada Choudhary senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Hum Coin Hain
episodes.overview: Prakash is sent to Bangkok, where he meets an unexpected visitor. The search of a suspect's home leads the officers to a troubling incident.

episodes.name: Darr Ka Dhandha
episodes.overview: The Choudhary syndicate strikes back with violence and intimidation against the customs officers. Ravinder's reckless move drags him deeper into trouble.

episodes.name: Kahani Khatam
episodes.overview: Arjun gets crucial information from Srikant Saxena. As the syndicate tries one final gold smuggling run, can the officers stop them before it's too late?

episodes.name: Arrival
episodes.overview: Sudha sweeps Chander off his feet, but they choose to stay friends. Now, he runs a hilltop café with Preeti by his side.

episodes.name: Stay
episodes.overview: While living with Chander, Sudha grows closer to him, but an opportunity in Mumbai may reshape their future. Preeti reveals her plans to expand the café.

episodes.name: Choice
episodes.overview: Sudha grapples with a difficult choice between her career and love life, as Chander opens up about his plans for the future.

episodes.name: Trip
episodes.overview: Rahil plants seeds of doubt in Preeti's mind, leading her to question Chander about his past. Sudha and Chander take a major step in their relationship.

episodes.name: Surprise
episodes.overview: When his mother arrives unexpectedly, Chander scrambles to hide his relationship. Meanwhile, Rahil and Chander look back on how far they've come.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overview: Preeti and Chander receive a surprising offer for the café. A conversation with her mother leaves Sudha reflecting on an important choice.

episodes.name: Distance
episodes.overview: While vacationing at a homestay, Sudha and Chander scout locations for the café, but a decision creates tension. Mark gives Chander a ring for Preeti.

episodes.name: Arrival
episodes.overview: A surprise guest unsettles Preeti, while Chander finds his past unexpectedly colliding with the present.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Opulent homes, posh parties and luxury shopping sprees - with the City of Gold as their playground, nothing is too extravagant for these wealthy Indians.

episodes.name: A Dazzling New World
episodes.overview: Newcomers Karan and Tejasswi experience Dubai's opulence. Binda catches up with an old friend and a Holi party brings reunions and revelations.

episodes.name: Hearts on the Rocks
episodes.overview: Pamala and Lailli share a tense moment. Iryna and Dyuti spar over their social lives. The ladies have a pool day while Satish hosts the men on a yacht.

episodes.name: The End of Us?
episodes.overview: Lines are drawn after the Father's Day party. Tejasswi pursues her restaurant dream. Lailli plans a drama-free wellness day - but Alizey has a surprise.

episodes.name: When the Glitter Fades
episodes.overview: Karan considers his future after a heart-to-heart with Dyuti. Binda confronts Satish about the rumors surrounding him. The twins try to comfort Iryna.

episodes.name: This Circle is on... FIRE
episodes.overview: A blow-up at the Bollywood party causes friction in the group. Pamala looks for clarity with AP. A birthday celebration goes up in (literal) flames.

episodes.name: Eeny, Meeny, Miny, Moe
episodes.overview: Tennis pro Sania Mirza heats up a padel game. Tejasswi questions her life in Dubai as Karan makes his own plans. A fishy gift leaves a bad taste.

episodes.name: The Future is Ours
episodes.overview: The Sanpals look to grow their family. The group lets loose at a glitzy launch. As Karan plans a big surprise, Binda shares her doubts.
